detail: reportwords.js picks ', most of them before noon' when share(4,12) >= 0.5 while report.js picks Night Owl first when share(21..4) >= 0.35; week 28 Sep satisfies both (64% 04-12, 36% 21-04), so the page says '5 Focus blocks, most of them before noon.' next to 'Night Owl - 36% of your Focus came after 21:00'. The 'Every Focus block' ribbon clamps a 02:28 Sunday block and a 06:20 Friday block to the 07 gridline ('Longest session Fri 06:20' in Study is drawn at 07:00).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/seed-report-0928-focus.png; js/core/reportwords.js:192; js/core/report.js:366-371
fix: Derive the headline clause from the persona (or order the tests the same way) and widen the ribbon axis to the period's real first/last hour.
rootCause: Two independent time-of-day classifiers with different windows.

title: Story player top controls: speed and close are below the 32px hit size and not the same shape as Pause
detail: On the Mac the story header's Speed '1×' button is 34x25 (a flat pill), Pause and Close 34x34; on fine pointers this is under the 32px minimum height for Speed and the three adjacent controls read as three sizes. The large 週 outline is drawn under the body text, crossing 'Collection, from Monday to Sunday.' (Mac and iPhone), and the chips '5 sessions' and '5 Focus blocks' repeat one number.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/story-1.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/story-iphone.png; eval button rects Speed 34x25, Pause 34x34, Close 34x34
fix: Give the three header controls one size (36-44 circles), keep the decorative glyph behind a scrim or lower in the frame below the text block, and drop one of the duplicate chips.
rootCause: Per-control sizing in reportstory CSS.

title: Week's plan card header wraps 'Pacing →' onto its own line and truncates every row title
detail: In the 415px column the header holds title, '23 behind', '0 of 13 · w/c 2 Nov' and an 84px segment meter, so the Pacing link drops to a second line at the left (1055,858) unlike every other card whose link is right-aligned on the title row. Each row loses ~45% of its width to the subject tag and the 'N weeks behind' pill: 'Programming constructs: s…', 'Arithmetic, relational & Boo…'; on the iPhone 'Programming constr…'. The footer then repeats three class lessons in a long run-on line.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/seed-home-mac-continue-scrolled.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/home-reports/seed-home-iphone.png; eval .k-plan-head children rects
fix: Move the count/meter under the title (sub-line) and keep the link on the title row; put 'N weeks behind' as a single header fact when all rows share it, freeing the row width; let titles wrap to two lines.
rootCause: Header packs four facts plus a link into one flex row with wrap.

title: The Seat's ⋯ menu is cut off by the stage: its Data row (Mine / Empty / Sample) is hidden and unclickable
detail: Opening ⋯ on #/governor (Status) shows a 280 x 100 popover at y=164-264; the stage starts at y=202 and paints over everything below it. Only the top of the 'HP preview' row shows; the 'Data' row (Mine / Empty / Sample) is entirely behind the hero. elementFromPoint across the popover: rows y>=204 hit .k-gv-stage (7/7 samples), rows y<=192 hit the popover. The controls cannot be reached by pointer.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/gov_menu_crop.png (2x: HP preview row sliced by the stage edge, Data row missing), gov_menu_dpr2.png; eval occlusion rows 204-252 '7/7 outside'; css/components.css:35 (.k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] {position:relative; isolation:isolate}), css/views/governor.css:31 (.k-gv-stage isolation:isolate), :65 (.k-gv-tools-pop z-index var(--z-menu) trapped inside the header's stacking context)
fix: Give the art page header a z-index above the page body (e.g. .k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] { z-index: var(--z-raised) }) or, better, build the ⋯ menu with KOS.ui.menu so the popover is portalled to the top layer like the bell. Also raise the 32px ⋯ button to 44px on coarse pointers (iPad).
rootCause: The header's isolation:isolate creates a stacking context with z-index auto, so the popover's z-index only competes inside the header; the later, isolated stage paints on top

title: iPhone Seat: showcase medals draw at 80px over each other and the XP bar, and the empty slots are 17 x 44 ovals
detail: At 402px the arc becomes a flex row of 44px slots. (1) Filled slots carry the medal with an inline --m:80px (governor-ui.js passes px:80), which beats the phone rule `.k-gv-arc-slot .k-ach-medal { --m: var(--ach-medal-sm) }`, so three picked medals render 80 x 80 at x=32/80/128, overlapping one another and rising over the XP bar. (2) The empty .k-gv-arc-note keeps flex-basis:100% while the row does not wrap (the wrap rule only applies when the note has content), so it takes 131px and the empty slots shrink to 17 x 44 (ovals); before the list() call returns, all six are ovals.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/iphone_gov.png (six ovals), iphone_gov_ovals_crop.png (2x: 80px medals overlapping each other and the XP bar, two oval empties); eval: medals [32,580,80,80,'80px'], [80,580,80,80], [128,580,80,80]; slots [44,44]x3 + [17,44]x3; note width 131 while empty; js/modules/governor-ui.js:363-366, css/views/governor.css:518-523
fix: Set the medal size through a class/attribute (data-size) or `--m` on the slot and read it with var() fallback, or override with `.k-gv-arc-slot .k-ach-medal { --m: var(--ach-medal-sm) !important }` at <=700; give slots flex: 0 0 auto (no shrink) and hide the empty note (`.k-gv-arc-note:empty { display:none }`).
rootCause: Inline custom property beats the phone stylesheet; empty flex-basis:100% note squeezes the shrinkable slots

title: Wall tabs and set deep links are not in the URL: #/achievements/<tab> and #/achievements/set/<id> open Sets
detail: router.js has no ENCODE/DECODE entry for the achievements view, so KOS.show("achievements","titles") leaves the hash at #/achievements and a typed/bookmarked #/achievements/recent, #/achievements/showcase, #/achievements/titles or #/achievements/set/focus decodes to no arg and draws Sets. Reloading on Titles returns to Sets; a badge link shared or opened after reload loses its set dialog. CLAUDE.md documents these routes (#/achievements[/sets|recent|showcase|titles|set/<id>]).
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/empty_achievements_recent.png, empty_achievements_titles.png (both show Sets selected); eval: KOS.show("achievements","titles") -> location.hash "#/achievements", data-page "titles"; js/core/router.js:45-104 (ENCODE) and 117-150 (DECODE) have no achievements entry
fix: Add achievements: ENCODE a=>typeof a==="string"&&a&&a!=="sets"?a.split("/"):null and DECODE p=>p.length?p.join("/"):null, matching the view's own split in js/modules/achievements.js:112.
rootCause: Route table in js/core/router.js omits the achievements view

title: Progress ping overflows its card when the badge name is long
detail: A ping for a long badge name (e.g. the unit badge 'Fundamentals of functional programming', 1 / 7 topics) draws the name, the count and the bar past the right edge of the 340px card: the card ends at x=568 while the text runs to ~656. The name never ellipsises although its CSS asks for it.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_governor.png and ping_long_name.png (card 228-568, '1 / 7 topics' and the bar outside it); css/views/achievements.css:275-277
fix: Give .k-ach-ping-txt grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) (a grid's auto track takes the nowrap row's max-content width, so the b's min-inline-size:0/ellipsis never applies).
rootCause: .k-ach-ping-txt is display:grid with an implicit auto column sized to the nowrap row's min-content, so the flex row cannot shrink

title: A ping shows on top of the unlock overlay (and above any dialog) when a tier and a ping arrive in the same sweep
detail: Invariant 163 says the ping never shows while a dialog is open. In boot()'s onChange, celebrate(r.earned) only queues the overlay (drain() waits for the async A().list), then r.pings.forEach(ping) runs immediately; quiet() sees no dialog yet, so the ping appears. It sits at z-index var(--z-toast) (130) above the overlay scrim (120), at the top-left over the dimmed page while the unlock overlay is up.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_governor.png (ping at top left over the 'Regular III' unlock overlay); eval: .k-ach-pings z-index 130 vs .k-ach-unlock-overlay 120; js/modules/achievements.js:760-765, 684-689
fix: In onChange, skip pings when r.earned.length (the overlay is about to open), or have ping() also check a module-level `showing`/queue.length; drainPing should re-check quiet() before each ping.
rootCause: Overlay opening is async while ping is sync; quiet() only checks dialogs already in the DOM

title: The current-badge ring in an opened set's strip is an oval, off-centre on its medal
detail: In a set dialog (e.g. Focus) the strip of badge chips marks the badge on show with a box-shadow ring on the button. The button measures 36 x 42.3 px, so the ring is a tall oval and the 32px medal sits in its top part, not its centre.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_set_focus.png, set_chip_oval_crop.png (2x zoom); eval: .k-ach-dlg-chip 36 x 42.3, inner .k-ach-medal 32 x 32; css/views/achievements.css:229-230
fix: Make .k-ach-dlg-chip display:inline-grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:1; line-height:0 (the inline <span> medal inside the button adds a line box's descent). Raise it to 44px on coarse pointers (invariant 69) and draw the ring as a circle round the medal.
rootCause: The chip button wraps an inline span medal, so its height includes line-height/descender space; border-radius:50% on a non-square box gives an ellipse

title: 'Owned' means two different things: the Wall header and the Seat say 8 badges while the set panels and the Showcase show 21
detail: KOS.achievements.counts().owned counts only badges with EVERY tier earned (8 on the seeded account), and the Wall toolbar ('Owned 8 / 254'), the Seat's glass panel ('THE WALL 8 / 254 badges') and the Governor card print it. The set panels count a badge as owned at its first tier (Time with KurenaiOS 4/6, Focus 3/6, Streaks 1/3, Study 2/11, Goals and Money 2/6, The Collection 7/11, Kurenai and the Governor 2/7 = 21), the Showcase says 'Earned 21 badges'. The same page contradicts itself; a user who earned In the zone I sees it counted in Focus 3/6 but not in Owned.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_ach.png ('Owned 8 / 254' over panels 4/6, 3/6, 1/3), seed_showcase2.png ('Earned 21 badges'); eval counts() {owned:8,tiers:44}, views with tier>0: 21, panel aria-labels sum 21; js/core/achievements.js:343-351 vs js/modules/achievements.js:220
fix: Pick one meaning. Either print 'Earned 21 / 254 · 8 complete' everywhere (counts() returning earned and complete), or make the panels count complete badges; and label the Seat 'Tiers earned 44 / 417' consistently beside it.
rootCause: counts().owned = fully complete badges; panel() owned = tier > 0; no shared definition

title: Every Wall tab (and the Seat's showcase arc) waits 1.6-6 s on 'Reading your records…' because list() re-walks the whole vault each time
detail: Each Wall draw (Sets, Recent, Showcase, Titles, every tab switch since each is a KOS.show) calls KOS.achievements.list(), which makes a fresh context and re-measures all 254 badges; the Collection badges open an unbounded IndexedDB cursor over every vault entry (1,880 rows on the seeded account) and tally them. Timed on the seeded account: list() 1.6-4.7 s; per set sequentially: collection 6.5 s, exams 1.8 s, study 1.4 s, mind 1.3 s. Showcase still read 'Reading your records…' after 1.5 s. It also conflicts with invariant 8 (never read an unbounded collection).
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_showcase.png (blank 'Reading your records…' after 1.5 s); eval list() 4744 ms then 1623 ms; per-set timings above; js/core/achcatalogue.js:70-110 (openCursor over entries), js/core/achievements.js:329-341 (fresh makeCtx per list)
fix: Cache the last evaluation's views (evaluate() already measures everything at boot and every 30 min and on owner touches) and draw the Wall from that cache immediately, refreshing in the background; for the vault, keep running tallies keyed on the vault's change notes or read counts through indexes (status/module) instead of a full cursor.
rootCause: Achievements are measured on read with no memo across calls; the Collection reader is a full-table cursor

title: Edit seat's showcase picker: 21 badge buttons with no name, visible or accessible
detail: In #/governor/edit > Showcase, the 'Earned' grid draws each earned badge as a bare medal button (showcasePicker with small:true drops the name span and the medal is aria-hidden). None of the 21 buttons has an accessible name, a title or visible text: a screen reader hears 'toggle button, not pressed' 21 times, and a sighted user must recognise badges by their art (several share a palette) with no tooltip.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_edit.png; eval: 21 [data-ui~=ach.pick-item] buttons, 0 with aria-label/text/title; js/modules/achievements.js:397-401
fix: Always set aria-label=badgeName(v) (and title) on .k-ach-pick; in the small variant add a tooltip or a name under the medal.
rootCause: The small variant removes the only text and the medal is decorative

title: Edit seat's '＋ Upload an image' uploads a new banner without the 'Your own picture' unlock
detail: Invariant 2 / roadmap 5.14: uploading a picture of your own is a gold unlock (KOS.art.canUpload). The Avatar tab honours it (bannerCropper allowUpload:false hides upload), but #/governor/edit > Background always shows '＋ Upload an image'; it calls KOS.governor.setCustomBanner(file), which opens the same cropper with the NEW file already as its source, and 'Save image' stores it. Reproduced with canUpload('banner') === false and owns('upload-all') === false: governor.bannerImg went from 19 to 52,142 chars, banner 'custom'. The cropper even says 'Uploading a new picture is an unlock in the Gold Shop' while saving the upload.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/edit_Background.png (upload tile, no lock), upload_bypass_cropper.png (cropper with the new picture, Save image enabled); eval before/after above; js/modules/governor-ui.js:745-758, js/core/governor.js:917-935
fix: In paintBg, when !KOS.art.canUpload('banner') draw the tile locked ('Your own picture · Gold Shop →', linking to the shop item) and make setCustomBanner refuse (done(new Error(...))) unless canUpload; keep picking an existing bannerImg allowed.
rootCause: The unlock is enforced only by hiding the cropper's own upload button; the seat editor's file input feeds the cropper a new source directly

title: Study cadence heatmap labels shrink to ~6px on iPhone (10px on the Mac)
detail: The Seat's Study cadence chart is a 545-unit-wide SVG (KOS.charts.heatmap, cell 15, gap 4) with 11-unit month and weekday labels, scaled to its box. On the iPhone it renders at 298px (scale 0.55), so 'May', 'Mon', 'Wed', 'Fri' are ~6px; on the Mac 509px (10.3px); the cells shrink to ~8px. Invariant 63 sets an 11px label floor for charts.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/iphone_gov_y700.png (cadence labels unreadable); eval effective label size: iphone 6.0px, mac 10.3px, ipad 12.5px; js/modules/governor-ui.js:609-611, js/core/charts.js:339
fix: On narrow widths show fewer weeks (e.g. 13 at <700, so the chart is drawn at ~1:1) or let the heatmap scroll horizontally inside a declared KOS.ui.scroller, keeping text at true 11px+.
rootCause: Fixed 26-week viewBox scaled to fit the container instead of choosing the week count from the width

title: A four-tier badge's tiers wrap 3 + 1 in the set dialog, leaving the fourth alone on a second row
detail: The set dialog lays tiers with flex-wrap; for the 14 four-tier badges (e.g. Focus > In the zone: 10/100/500/1,000 sessions) the four items need 613px but the stage is 600px, so tier IV drops alone under the other three, with empty space either side and a 655px-tall dialog.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_set_focus.png; eval .k-ach-dlg-tiers 600 x 379, items at y=228,228,228,422; css/views/achievements.css:218
fix: Use a grid: repeat(min(n,4)) at desktop when it fits, else 2 x 2 for n=4 (the phone rule at :330 already does 2 columns); key off data-n which the markup already sets.
rootCause: flex-wrap with content-sized tier captions instead of a column count chosen from data-n

title: HP preview's 'Off' button actually previews Critical (0 HP)
detail: The ⋯ menu's HP preview segment reads Live · Full · Off. 'Off' sets the preview to critical (0 / 100, 'Critical · nothing locks'); it does not turn the preview off (Live does). The label reads as the opposite of what it does.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/gov_hp_off.png (after pressing Off: 'HP preview 0 / 100 Critical'); js/modules/governor-ui.js:425 hpPreviewButton("critical", "Off")
fix: Label the three 'Live · Full · Critical' (the HP state names used everywhere else).
rootCause: Label text out of step with the value

title: 'First day' on the Seat can be later than the history it sits beside (138 days journeyed, first day 1 Nov 2026)
detail: The record reads 'Days journeyed 138' and 'First day 1 Nov 2026' side by side. First day is store.state.created, the install/reset moment, while days journeyed is the ledger's months rollup. An account whose history predates `created` (an imported backup, a sample account, a ledger older than the device's first boot) shows a first day after months of activity.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/seed_gov_s1b.png (138 days / 1 Nov 2026); js/modules/governor-ui.js:377 (since = +store.state.created), :391
fix: Show the earliest of state.created, the first session ledger entry and the earliest achievements month row.
rootCause: First day reads the state document's creation stamp rather than the evidence

title: Seat showcase medals: the focus ring is an oval (button 80 x 86.3)
detail: Each showcase medal on the Seat's arc is a .k-gv-arc-btn wrapping an inline 80px medal span; the button is 80 x 86.3 px, so its border-radius:50% focus outline is a tall ellipse hanging below the medal. Same root cause as the set dialog's oval chip.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/arc_focus_crop.png (2x, keyboard focus on the first showcase medal); eval .k-gv-arc-btn 80.0x86.3; css/views/governor.css:88-89
fix: display:grid; place-items:center; line-height:0 (or aspect-ratio:1) on .k-gv-arc-btn; ideally one shared 'medal button' rule in achievements.css used by the arc, the set strip and the picker.
rootCause: Inline medal span inside a button adds line-box height

title: A partial showcase fills the Seat's arc from the bottom-left, leaving the top and right of the arc empty
detail: Slots are filled left to right along AX/AY (bottom-left first, then rising). With three badges picked, the leading badge sits at the lowest-left point and the crown and the whole right half stay empty rings, so the arc looks lopsided; the code comment says 'highest in the middle'. The first badge also 'leads on the share card' but is the least prominent on the Seat.
evidence: shots/achievements-governor/after_save2.png (3 picked: bottom-left, left, upper-left filled; 3 empty rings to the right); js/modules/governor-ui.js:348-366
fix: Map the pick order to slots centre-out (2,3,1,4,0,5) so the first picks take the crown and the arc stays symmetric.
rootCause: Showcase index used directly as the arc slot index

title: Shop avatar previews: the painted avatar escapes its disc (drawn top-left, overflowing the card) and the disc sits empty, offset
detail: Every one of the 12 avatar cards in the Gold Shop (and the preview sheet) draws the picture at the preview's top-left corner, overflowing the card's top edge (the fox's ears are clipped), while the dark backing disc sits centred and empty behind/below it, so the avatar reads off-centre and the disc looks like a stray shadow. Measured at mac 1470x832: preview box 235x235 at (458,3078); disc 179x179 at (486,3107); img 193x193 at (458,3078) - the image's top-left equals the preview's, not the disc's.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/ef-1.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/ef-2.png (Avatars rows); eval getBoundingClientRect on .k-gv-ware[data-kind=avatar]; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1227-1228 (img(it.art) uses the default class k-gv-apv-img); css/views/governor.css:589 (.k-gv-apv-img position:absolute; inset:0) vs :602-603 (.k-gv-apv-disc has no position:relative)
fix: Give the avatar img its own class (e.g. img(it.art,'k-gv-apv-disc-img')) instead of k-gv-apv-img, or make .k-gv-apv-disc position:relative and the img inset:9%; centre with object-fit:contain. Re-check the art itself: several avatar PNGs carry a baked dark disc (koi, lamp) so a second CSS disc doubles it.
rootCause: Generic absolute-positioned image class reused inside a non-positioned disc

title: Try on panel's 'Buy · ◈ 4,500' button is illegible (dark ink on dark glass)
detail: Trying any item on shows the Trying on panel on the Stage with its primary action 'Buy · ◈ n' - the purchase call to action of the whole try-on flow. It renders with color oklch(0.2 0.03 70) (gold-ink, meant for a gold fill) on background oklch(0.14 0.01 265 / .72) (the stage's glass), i.e. near-black on near-black; the button looks disabled although it is enabled.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-tryon-outfit.png (button left of 'Stop'); eval: getComputedStyle([data-ui~=shop.buy-tried]) color oklch(0.2 0.03 70), bg oklch(0.14 0.01 265/0.72); css/views/governor.css:57 '.k-gv-stage .k-btn { background: var(--gv-glass) }' (specificity 0,2,0) overrides css/views/governor.css:567 '.k-gv-buy { background: var(--gold) }' (0,1,0)
fix: Raise the buy rule's specificity (.k-gv-stage .k-gv-buy, or :where() on the stage rule) so a gold buy button keeps its gold fill on the Stage.
rootCause: CSS specificity: stage glass-button rule beats the buy colour rule

title: A painted frame on the Seat spills over 'Level 53', the title chip and past the stage edge
detail: With a painted frame worn (Koi ring, bought in the shop), the Governor's Seat Status stage draws the frame picture 296x296 round a 180px avatar, outside the avatar's box with no space reserved: it overlaps the 'Level 53' heading by 24px (the L is under a koi's tail), hides the start of 'Pick a title' (reads 'k a title'), and is cut off by the stage's overflow:hidden on the left (frame x=228, stage x=236).
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-status-mac.png; eval: frame art [228,190,296,296], .k-gv-name [500,274,329,58], 'Pick a title' [500,340], stage [236,202] overflow hidden; css/layout.css:254 (.k-avatar-frame-art 152% + 2*--fo, absolutely positioned); js/core/governor.js avatarNode (frame drawn 'outside the box ... never changes layout')
fix: Reserve the frame's bleed where a large framed avatar sits (padding/margin on the Seat's face column equal to (frame - avatar)/2, or a CSS var the host exposes, e.g. --frame-bleed), and scale painted frames so their inner hole meets the HP ring instead of a fixed 152%.
rootCause: Painted frames are absolutely positioned overflow with no layout space reserved

title: Seals are sold as 'the topbar mark' but the topbar has no mark any more; the painted stamp art is never shown in use
detail: Every seal says 'variant of the OS mark' and the Wardrobe row is labelled 'Seal · The topbar mark'. applyCosmetics() writes the glyph into '#topbar [data-ui~=shell.brand] [data-ui~=shell.brand-mark]', but the topbar brand is now + 'Kurenai' with no brand-mark element, so querySelector returns null and nothing changes. The only place a worn seal appears is the small glyph disc on the Seat's/profile ring (k-gv-ring-seal, text only). The six 400-gold seals' stamp pictures (app.seal.yuki...hikari) are drawn only in the shop card and the Wardrobe chip, never where the seal is worn.
evidence: eval: document.querySelector('[data-ui~=shell.brand-mark']) -> null; brand outerHTML = img + 'Kurenai'; js/core/governor.js:782-783; js/modules/governor-ui.js:235-244 (ring seal glyph only); wardrobe label in governor-ui.js WARD ['seal','Seal','The topbar mark']; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-assistant-gala.png (topbar shows the bloom logo with seal-hikari worn)
fix: Decide where a seal shows and draw its stamp there: e.g. replace the topbar bloom with the worn seal's stamp (keep the bloom for 紅), and use the stamp art (not a crimson text disc) on the Seat ring and the Share card; fix the Wardrobe caption to match.
rootCause: Topbar markup changed (brand image) without updating applyCosmetics/the seal feature

title: All 10 painted shelf skins and Shrine card styles never show: their picture URL resolves to /css/views/assets/... (404)
detail: The five new shelf skins (Paulownia, Steel and glass, Library oak, Bamboo, Sakura wood, ◈800 each) and five Shrine card styles (Moon, Moth, Camellia, Lacquer, Frost, ◈900 each), 8,500 gold in all, can be bought and worn but draw nothing. books.js and shrine.js set an inline custom property --skin-art: url(assets/app/img/<id>.webp); collection.css consumes it with background: var(--skin-art). A relative url() inside a custom property is resolved against the stylesheet that uses it, so the browser requests /css/views/assets/app/img/app.shelf.sakura.webp (404), and the same for app.shrinecard.*. Worse, the painted-skin rule also strips the default shelf's board, border and shadow (border:0; box-shadow:none), so a bought painted skin makes the Books shelf look emptier than the free default (covers floating on the page background), while the cheap CSS skins (Walnut) work.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/shelf-compare.png (top: default, middle: Walnut CSS skin, bottom: Sakura wood painted skin = nothing); /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-books-shelf-sakura.png; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-shrine-gold-frost.png; eval: getComputedStyle(.k-bk-shelf).backgroundImage = url(http://127.0.0.1:9104/css/views/assets/app/img/app.shelf.sakura.webp); Shrine hero cover ::after = .../css/views/assets/app/img/app.shrinecard.frost.webp; curl 404 vs /assets/app/img/... 200; js/modules/books.js:1285; js/modules/shrine.js:954; css/views/collection.css:532-534
fix: Set the variable to an absolute URL, as dayreview.js:142 already does: 'url("' + new URL('assets/app/img/' + art + '.webp', location.href).href + '")'. Then re-check each skin's look (keep a board under the painted back panel). Add a smoke check that every --skin-art resolves.
rootCause: Relative url() inside an inline CSS custom property resolves against the consuming stylesheet's URL

title: Shop frame previews: the avatar is a small disc lost inside a big painted ring (55px avatar in a 179px frame)
detail: Every painted frame card (Sakura, Ice, Ember, Lacquer, Wisteria, Koi; ◈800 each) previews the frame at 179x179 with the avatar at 55x55 in its middle, i.e. the avatar fills ~42% of the ring's inner hole (the art's measured inner-hole radius is 0.67-0.74 of the frame), leaving a wide empty dark gap between avatar and ring. Worn, the same art is sized at 152% of the avatar, so the shop shows a different (and much worse) fit than the real thing. The preview sheet does the same at 120px.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-shop-frames.png; eval: Sakura ring frame-art [486,4375,179,179], avatar [548,4433,55,55]; image analysis: inner hole radius/half-width app.frame.sakura 0.73, ice 0.74, koi 0.67; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1229-1230 (avatarNode(big ? 120 : 64) inside .k-gv-apv-frame 76%); css/views/governor.css:604-607 (avatar * 0.86)
fix: Size the preview avatar as a fraction of the frame box (e.g. inline-size: 66% of .k-gv-apv-frame, matching the worn 1/1.52 rule) instead of a fixed 64/120px; better, store each frame's measured hole ratio in the catalogue and use it both worn and in the shop so the ring hugs the HP ring.
rootCause: Preview avatar uses a fixed pixel size unrelated to the frame's box

title: With a painted frame worn, every CSS frame card in the shop previews the WORN frame instead of its own
detail: Wearing Koi ring, the Gilt ring, Kurenai bloom, Jade band and Amethyst orbit cards all show the Koi ring. shopPreview() builds the CSS-frame preview from KOS.governor.avatarNode(64), which already contains the worn painted frame's , then only swaps data-frame to the previewed id; the rule '.k-avatar-host:has(> .k-avatar-frame-art)::before,::after {display:none}' then hides the CSS frame being sold, leaving the worn picture. The Avatar tab's frameChip removes that img (oldArt) but the shop does not.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-shop-frames.png (top row: four different CSS frames all drawn as the Koi ring); js/modules/governor-ui.js:1258-1265 (case 'frame' in shopPreview); css/layout.css:255
fix: Strip .k-avatar-frame-art from the node (as frameChip does) before setting data-frame, or give avatarNode an option {frame: id|null} so previews never inherit the worn frame; the same applies to the banner preview's avatarNode.
rootCause: Preview reuses the live avatar node including the worn frame layer

title: A painted frame on Home's hero and on the phone overlaps the greeting and is cut off by the hero's edge
detail: Same root cause as the Seat: the worn Koi ring is drawn at 152% of the avatar outside its box. On Home (mac) the frame [235,102,163,163] runs 6px under the headline 'Working late…' (h1 x=392) and the date kicker, and is clipped 1px by the hero (x=236, overflow hidden). On iPhone (402x874) the frame on Home is cropped by the hero's top-left rounded corner and sits on 'MONDAY 2 NOVEMBER'; on the phone Seat (#/governor) the frame's top is cut off by the stage's top edge and the koi cover the 'BEHAVIOURAL GOVERNOR' kicker.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-home-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-home-iphone.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/seed-status-iphone.png; eval Home: frame [235,102,163,163], avatar [269,137,94,94], hero [236,80,1210,207] overflow hidden, h1 [392,161]; css/layout.css:254
fix: Reserve the frame bleed in every host that shows a large framed avatar (Home ring, Seat face, Avatar stage, phone stage): pad the ring's container by (frame-avatar)/2 or shrink the painted frame to the HP ring (using each frame's hole ratio) so nothing spills.

title: Worn painted avatars are clipped by their circle and sized inconsistently (fox ears, crane wings, lamp head, dragon tail cut; cat and lantern float small)
detail: All 12 painted avatars drawn by the real KOS.governor.avatarNode(120) (the component used in the sidebar pill, Home ring, Seat and Avatar stage): Fox's ears and tassels are cut by the circle; Crane's wing tips cut left and right; Desk lamp's shade cut at top-left and the book at bottom-left; Dragon's tail and Owl's books cut at the sides; meanwhile Cat sits low with an empty top third, Lantern leaves dark bands left and right, and Koi / Moon rabbit are painted discs of their own that don't match the CSS disc (a dark crescent rim shows round Koi). The set looks like twelve different sizes. The art files are transparent cut-outs of varying aspect (lantern 417x640, cat 640x510, fox 546x640, bloom 532x640, others ~640x640, bbox touching every edge) and the CSS fits each one's full box to the square with object-fit: contain inside a border-radius:50% overflow:hidden disc, so anything in the art's corners falls outside the inscribed circle and narrow art leaves bands.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/avatar-montage.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/avatar-row1-2x.png; image sizes via PIL (assets/app/img/app.avatar.*.webp); css/layout.css:250-251 (.k-avatar overflow hidden, .k-avatar-art object-fit: contain); js/core/governor.js:697-699
fix: Recompose the art for a circle: each avatar keyed to fit inside an inscribed circle of ~88% of a square canvas, on a consistent ground (either all full painted discs or all cut-outs on --s2), then keep object-fit: contain. Short of new art, pad the img (inline-size/block-size ~78%) so cut-out corners clear the circle, and a per-item focal/scale in the catalogue for outliers (cat, lantern).
rootCause: Art generated as rectangular cut-outs with content in the corners, displayed contain-fit in a circular clip.

title: Worn painted frames leave a dark empty band between the avatar and the ring (the ring's hole is ~75% of the art, the avatar is drawn at 66%)
detail: On the real component (not just the shop preview reported earlier) every painted frame — Ice, Ember, Lacquer most visibly, Sakura, Wisteria and Koi too — shows a ring of bare background between the avatar and the painted band: at avatar 90px the art is drawn at 137px (152% + 2*--fo), but the art's transparent inner hole measures ~0.73-0.78 of the image (ice 239/320, ember 245/320, lacquer 239/320, gilt 248/319, amethyst 246/320) = ~103px, leaving ~6-7px of gap each side at 90px and ~13px at the Seat's 180px. Where an HP ring is present --fo adds the ring's frame-out, so the frame grows further and the gap widens. Wisteria and Koi holes are non-circular (wisteria L173/R193/T219/B237), so the avatar is visibly off-centre in them. This is exactly the user's 'avatar circle small inside a big ring'.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/frames-2x.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/avatar-montage.png (bottom rows); hole radii measured with PIL on assets/app/img/app.frame.*.webp; css/layout.css:254 (152% fixed), :260-262 (--fo)
fix: Store each frame's measured hole ratio and centre offset in the catalogue (e.g. hole:0.75, cx/cy) and size the art as avatarOuter / hole (≈133%, not 152%) positioned by its hole centre; let the art cover the HP ring instead of sitting outside it, or re-key the art so every hole is a centred circle of one fixed ratio.
rootCause: A single fixed 152% scale assumed a 66% hole; the imported art's holes are 73-78% and some are off-centre.

title: Ten of the 23 paid shop themes are near-copies of free Graphite (same near-black ground, accent within dE 2-6 of Graphite's crimson)

Ground: every dark theme sits within dE 1.5-4.6 of Graphite's #0D0E12 and every theme keeps s1-vs-bg contrast ~1.06, so cards, rail and header read identically. In the 29-theme contact sheet the only visible difference between these ten and the free default is a slightly different hero tint. The user pays 140-1,500 gold for what looks like Graphite. Recommendation: KEEP the distinct ones (Atelier Dawn, Washi Morning, Verdigris Duel, Clinic Noir, Midnight Lilies, Celestial Duality, Azure Butterfly, Solar Manuscript, Violet Requiem, Rain Cafe, Sakura Skyline, Lantern Hall, Gothic Camellia, Shattered Bloom); REMOVE or re-tint (give a real ground hue/lightness and an accent away from crimson) moss-garden, rosarium, spectral-rose, azure-corset-noir, ember-wraith, scarlet-garden-night, porcelain-sky-night, crimson-moth, lycoris-radiata, first-snow (an owned copy keeps working, as the retired CSS banners do).

title: One click on a card's Buy spends up to 12,000 gold with no confirmation and no undo, and silently re-dresses the app
detail: The shop card's 'Buy' button (shop.buy) calls buyWare directly: KOS.governor.buy then wareUse(it,true). There is no confirm step, no Undo on the toast, and no refund path, for prices up to 10,000 (Gala) and 12,000 (Every area). Buying also immediately applies the item: a theme re-themes the whole app, a frame replaces the worn frame, an avatar replaces your photo (see the prevKind finding), a scene/hall replaces the current one — none of which the user asked for at purchase time. The preview sheet shows '12,476 → …' but the card button skips the sheet. Months of earned gold can be lost to a mis-tap on iPad/iPhone where cards are dense.
evidence: js/modules/governor-ui.js:1045-1046 (card Buy -> buyWare), :893-903 (buy + wareUse + toast, no undo); js/core/governor.js:542-556 (buy has no inverse)

rootCause: buyWare couples purchase and equip, no reversible step.

fix: Replace the span with a button 'Upload a picture' that opens KOS.artSlot.open(it.area) (for 'all', a small menu of areas); drop the redundant Owned chip; let names wrap to 2 lines.

title: On iPad portrait (701-1080px) the Assistant shows no Kurenai at all, so a bought outfit (4,500-10,000 gold) is invisible there
detail: With the Gala outfit worn, #/assistant at 820x1180 renders neither the standing figure (.k-asst-presence is display:none below 1081px) nor the phone's portrait chip (.k-asst-portrait-row shows only at <=700px). Both skin elements measure 0x0. The chat column instead has ~600px of empty dark space above 'What are we working on?'. On mac (277x443) and ipad landscape (218x443) the figure shows; on iPhone a 56px face crop with a gold ring. The outfit's only other surface is the shop's own stage, so on the user's iPad in portrait the purchase is never seen outside the shop.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/assistant-gala-ipad.png (no figure, empty upper half), b4/assistant-gala-iphone.png; eval of skin imgs per size: mac 277x443, ipadl 218x443, ipad 0x0/0x0, iphone 205x398 inside the 56px portrait; css/views/assistant.css:530-532 (.k-asst-presence display:none at max-width 1080) and :338-343 (portrait row only at max-width 700)
fix: Extend the portrait row (or a compact standing figure) to the 701-1080 band so every width shows Kurenai in her outfit; use the freed vertical space for her instead of blank.
rootCause: Two breakpoint rules that do not meet: the presence is hidden from 1080 down, the substitute only appears from 700 down.

title: Washi Morning (light shop theme, 1,500 gold) keeps the dark-ground red: every overdue/alarm text is 3.2:1 on its cards
detail: Atelier Dawn restates --red for a light ground (oklch 0.525 0.18 25, 5.78:1 on --s1). Washi Morning, the other light theme, does not, so --red/--alarm stay Graphite's oklch(0.66 0.17 22) and measure 3.23:1 on Washi's near-white --s1. --alarm is the text colour of 61 rules (overdue counts, 'now' in day lists, over-budget amounts, Critical labels...). Every other role in Washi passes (amber 5.44, green 5.66, teal 6.81, gold 5.38, muted 5.77). This also breaks invariant 26a's intent that status reads the fixed red legibly in every theme.
evidence: eval resolving each token inside a [data-theme] probe: washi-morning --red 3.23, --alarm 3.23 vs atelier-dawn 5.78; themes4.json washi-morning alarmOnS1 3.23; css/themes.css:850-866 (washi block, no --red) vs :93 (Dawn's --red); grep 'color: var(--alarm)' css -> 61 rules
fix: Give washi-morning the same light-ground --red restatement as Dawn (and check --red-soft/--crit washes derive from it); add a smoke check that every theme's --alarm on --s1 is >= 4.5:1.
rootCause: Only Dawn was treated as a light theme when the fixed status colours were tuned; the newer light theme copied the role overrides but not the light-ground status restatement.

title: Picture drawer 'Rotate by season / time of day' ignores what the pictures are: First snow never shows in winter, the rooftop and First snow never show at all, the night train shows at 2 pm
detail: KOS.art.rotated indexes the owned pool by position: season -> SEASONS.indexOf(season) % n, time of day -> 0..3 % n. With all six Focus scenes owned: Jan->library, Apr->train, Jul->shrine, Oct->cafe; 08h library, 14h night train, 19h shrine, 23h cafe. Scenes 5 and 6 (rooftop, First snow, 3,600 gold) are unreachable by either period, and the mapping is arbitrary (a 'night' scene by day, snow never in winter). Same for Shrine halls (Jan lantern, Jul gold). Also in 'By condition' mode the drawer hides the period control and says 'Otherwise the season decides', but the fallback uses whatever period was set before (eval: explain -> 'Now: The night train, by the day').
evidence: eval: setCfg('focus',{mode:'rotate',period:'season'}) rotated for 15 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct -> library/train/shrine/cafe; period 'tod' 8/14/19/23h -> library/train/shrine/cafe; condition mode with period 'day' -> 'by the day'; js/core/art.js:131-137 (index by position), js/modules/artslot.js:65 (period hidden in condition mode) and :73 ('Otherwise the season decides')
fix: Give each scene/hall catalogue item its own season and time-of-day tags (snow: winter + evening, rooftop/train: night, library: afternoon...) and rotate among the owned pictures that match, falling back to all; set period 'season' when switching to condition mode (or show the period there).
rootCause: Rotation treats the pool as an anonymous list; only Home's four seasonal heroes happen to line up with SEASONS order.

title: Edit your seat > Background offers '+ Upload an image' with 0 gold and no unlock, bypassing the 3,000-gold 'Profile banner' unlock (invariant 2)
detail: On an empty account (gold 0, owns('upload-banner') false, KOS.art.canUpload('banner') false) #/governor/edit > Background shows the upload tile. It calls KOS.governor.setCustomBanner(file), which prepares the file and opens bannerCropper with the picture already loaded; allowUpload:false there only hides the cropper's own upload button, so saving sets g.bannerImg (the profile banner the shop sells as 'Upload your own profile banner'). The Avatar & profile page and the picture drawer DO gate the same thing, so the shop item is pointless and the rules disagree. There are also two separate 'own banner' stores: g.bannerImg (synced state) from this path and art.own.banner (media kv, device-only) from the drawer's 'Your own' mode.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-edit-bg-upload.png; eval on empty account: {gold:0, ownsBanner:false, canUpload:false, uploadBtn:true}; js/modules/governor-ui.js:743-758 (no canUpload check), js/core/governor.js:930-934 (setCustomBanner -> bannerCropper(source)), :920-922 (allowUpload only hides the in-dialog button); js/core/art.js:60-63,85-99 (art.own.<slot> kv store)
fix: Gate the tile on KOS.art.canUpload('banner') (show the lock with 'Open in the shop' otherwise, as the drawer does) and make the drawer's 'Your own' banner and g.bannerImg one store.
rootCause: The unlock was added to the drawer and the banner cropper's own button, not to the older Edit-seat upload path that feeds the same banner.

title: 'Try anything on before you buy' is not true for 65 of the items (avatars, frames, seals, banners, shelf skins, Shrine cards, papers, pen sets: 34,060 gold)
detail: The shop stage's Try on panel promises 'Try anything on before you buy'. Cards and the preview sheet only offer Try on for outfits, scenes, halls, finishes and themes; canTry excludes avatar, frame, seal, shelfskin, shrinestyle, banner (and unlock/paper/penset), and KOS.governor.tryItem returns early for any kind outside WEAR. These are exactly the items whose real appearance differs most from the card preview (frames that don't fit, shelf skins that never render, seals with no surface), so the buyer cannot check them without spending.
evidence: js/modules/governor-ui.js:1013 (promise text), :1039 (canTry exclusions), :1089-1090 (sheet Try on only for outfit/scene/hall/finish/theme); js/core/governor.js:826-831 (tryItem returns unless theme or WEAR kind), :805 (WEAR); eval: 65 non-retired items, 34,060 gold
fix: Either extend the transient try-on to the profile kinds (frame/avatar/seal/banner on the stage's identity block; shelf/Shrine card on a sample row) or change the copy to name what can be tried.

title: Exam and Sketch pen sets barely differ from the default, label their swatches wrongly, and silently recolour every stroke already written
detail: Resolved ink palette (Graphite) per pen set: default accent rgb(234,105,114), teal (65,193,186). Exam set ('Black pen, red pen and pencil'): accent (232,95,97) - visually the same red - and teal -> grey (131,134,142); ink stays the theme's near-white. Sketch set ('Graphite, wash and highlight'): ink (180,183,190), accent -> bloom (230,169,197) which is identical to the bloom highlighter, teal -> (235,197,115) a near-twin of the amber swatch (230,181,93). The swatches keep their role names, so the gold swatch is announced and titled 'Teal' and the pink one 'Accent'. Because strokes store a ROLE and the palette is read live (invariant 133), wearing a pen set repaints every existing page in every notebook (all teal working turns grey under Exam set) - and 'Take off' changes it back - which a shop description never warns about.
evidence: eval KOS.inkUI.palette(host) after KOS.governor.wear('penset', id): default/study identical; exam {accent:'rgb(232,95,97)',teal:'rgb(131,134,142)'}; sketch {ink:'rgb(180,183,190)',accent:'rgb(230,169,197)',teal:'rgb(235,197,115)',amber:'rgb(230,181,93)',bloom:'rgb(230,169,197)'}; css/views/ink.css:37-42; js/core/inkui.js:1265-1266 (aria-label/title from PEN_ROLES names); js/core/ink.js:56 (PEN_ROLES)
fix: Give each set distinct colours and its own swatch names (Pen/Red pen/Pencil; Graphite/Wash/Highlight) and apply the set to NEW strokes only (store the resolved set on the stroke, or have the set add roles rather than remap existing ones).
rootCause: Pen sets were implemented as CSS remaps of the shared roles on :root rather than as new roles.

title: 'Kurenai bloom' frame (◈90) renders as eight blocky pink squares, not petals
detail: The CSS frame-crimson draws its 'crimson petals from the brand bloom' as a repeating-conic-gradient masked to a ring: at 90px it is eight hard-edged trapezoid squares floating round the avatar, which reads as a loading spinner rather than petals; next to the painted frames it looks unfinished. Same for the gold studs at small sizes (barely visible ticks).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/frames-2x.png (frame-crimson); css/layout.css:272-274
fix: Retire the four CSS frames (as the CSS banners were) now that painted frames exist, or redraw the bloom as an SVG petal mask.
rootCause: Conic-gradient approximation of petals.

title: Two outfit descriptions do not match their art: 'Day off' promises a soft cardigan (art: a hoodie), 'Exam season' a blazer and lanyard (art: grey cardigan and glasses, no lanyard)
detail: In the shop's Outfits grid the Day off card shows Kurenai in a cream pullover hoodie and the Exam season card a grey knit cardigan over a white shirt with glasses; neither matches the item's description shown in the preview sheet. The 7-item grid also leaves the 4th cell of row 2 empty at 1470px.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/shop-outfits.png; js/core/governor.js:448 (outfit-exam desc 'Blazer and lanyard'), :451 (outfit-dayoff desc 'A soft cardigan'); assets/app/img/app.skin.kurenai.exam.webp, app.skin.kurenai.dayoff.webp
fix: Reword the two descriptions to what is painted (or re-brief the art in art-source/app manifest).

title: Edit your seat: the aria-hidden preview still holds three keyboard-focusable buttons (Study, Rest rhythm, 'Open full log ->'); Enter on the last leaves the editor and drops the draft
detail: The live preview box is aria-hidden and pointer-events:none but not inert, so Tab walks into invisible-to-AT controls scaled to 18x12px on iPhone; 'Open full log ->' navigates to #/governor/history with no leave-with-changes prompt, discarding unsaved seat edits.
evidence: eval on #/governor/edit: .k-gv-prev focusables n=3 ['Study','Rest rhythm','Open full log ->'], inert=false, pointer-events none; js/modules/governor-ui.js:669 (prevBox aria-hidden, no inert); css/views/governor.css:150
fix: Set prevBox.inert = true (or build the stage with o.preview suppressing the cadence tabs and log link).

title: Empty Wardrobe and Theme card waste most of the page: 12 cells of 'In the Gold Shop ->' with 120px gaps, a 2-card Theme row on a 1,200px card, and 'Rotate or your own' offered for kinds you own none of
detail: On an empty account #/governor/avatar at 1470px: the Wardrobe is a 3x4 grid where each cell is a title, a count line and one link; the Focus scene thumb makes row 1 ~170px tall so the Outfit and Avatar cells have ~100px of nothing under their link; on iPhone it is a 1,000px single column of those links. Shrine hall (0 of 3) and Painted banner (0 of 6) still offer 'Rotate or your own ->', which opens a drawer with nothing to rotate. The Theme card shows two 180px theme tiles in a 1,190px card, ~80% empty width. 'In the Gold Shop ->' and the Collection cosmetics' unowned chips open the shop at the top, never at the matching department.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-avatar-mac.png, b4/empty-avatar-mac-top.png, b4/empty-avatar-iphone.png; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1415 (unowned chip -> KOS.show('governor','shop') with no department), :1450
fix: Collapse unowned kinds into one 'Not yet owned: outfits, avatars, ... -> Gold Shop' line (each deep-linking to its department via shopSel), show 'Rotate or your own' only with 2+ owned or the unlock, and let the Theme row fill the width (theme grid with more columns or the theme toggle beside it).

title: A locked lab sends you to the top of the shop with no Buy here, never says it unlocks the whole Trace Lab, and repeats '180' on four cards
detail: With 3,500 gold, opening Stack push/pop/peek shows 'Locked by the Governor / 180 / Open the Gold Shop'. The button lands on #/governor/shop at the top of All (the 131-item list), not the Labs department, and there is no inline Unlock although the user can afford it. Nothing says the 180 buys 'Trace Lab' and opens all four Data-structures sims, each of which shows its own '180' badge, so it reads as 4 x 180. The lock's diamond is a ~10px glyph in a 48px disc. lockPanel also still carries the retired HP-suspension branch ('Labs and simulations reopen at 60 HP') although nothing produces why:'hp' any more (invariant 2).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-sims-locked.png, b4/empty-sim-locked-open.png; js/core/governor.js:596-626 (KOS.show('governor','shop') with no department; dead isHp branch; grep why:'hp' -> no producer); js/modules/governor-ui.js:849 (shopSel module var, no route arg)
fix: Add an 'Unlock Trace Lab · 180' button on the lock when affordable (buy + rerender), name the lab and the sims it opens, deep-link 'Open the Gold Shop' to #/governor/shop with the labs department, and delete the HP branch.

title: Gold is drawn with two different glyphs: ◈ in the Gold Shop, ◆ in the HUD, Seat, labs and rewards
detail: The shop's balance, prices and drawer use ◈ (goldN) while the sidebar HUD, the Seat's Gold instrument, the session ledger rewards, lab locks and 30+ other files use ◆; on one screen the sidebar says '◆ 372,620' beside the shop's '◈ 372,620'.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/shop-allowned-mac.png (◈ hero vs ◆ sidebar); grep: ◈ 17 uses in 9 files, ◆ 70 uses in 34 files; js/modules/governor-ui.js:851 (goldN '◈'), :496, js/core/governor.js:1176 ('◆')
fix: One gold formatter (e.g. KOS.ui.gold(n)) used everywhere, with one glyph.

title: Every shop action (Buy, Use, Take off, Try on, Pin) rebuilds the whole shop and drops keyboard focus to <main>
detail: Clicking 'Use Exam set' (or Buy/Try on) calls render(), which empties the panel and rebuilds 131 cards; scroll is kept (#stage stays at 9,285 / 15,438px) but document.activeElement becomes MAIN, so a keyboard or Switch Control user is thrown out of the card they just acted on and must Tab back through the department rail and every card above.
evidence: eval mac and iphone: click [data-ui~=shop.use] -> scroll before/after stage=9285/9285 (mac), 15438/15438 (iphone); focus after: MAIN; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1041,1045,1053,1057 (each onclick ends in render())
fix: After render(), restore focus to the same card's new primary control (find by data-ware id), or update the card in place instead of re-rendering the page.

title: The free default theme (Atelier Dusk) shows 'In use' with a 'Take off' button that does nothing; taking off any theme stores the legacy id 'kurenai'
detail: After 'Take off' on Lantern Hall, g.theme becomes 'kurenai' (an id that is not in the catalogue; chosenTheme() maps it to atelier-dusk). The Atelier Dusk card then reads '✓ In use' with a 'Take off' button; clicking it calls setTheme('kurenai') again: no visual change, no toast, the card stays 'on' - a dead control. The free Library scene is already excluded from Take off (governor-ui.js:1053) but the free default theme is not.
evidence: eval: buy+use Lantern Hall, click its shop.take-off -> {theme:'kurenai', data-theme:'' , Atelier Dusk data-ware 'on', take-off present}; clicking Dusk's take-off -> unchanged state and no new toast; js/modules/governor-ui.js:878 (theme off -> setTheme('kurenai')), :1053 (exception only for free scene), :1117-1120 (chosenTheme)
fix: Hide Take off on the default theme (it == 'Graphite, the default'); have taking off a theme set 'atelier-dusk' explicitly.

title: IT desk on iPad portrait: the qualification-boundary chart is crushed to 52px and its numbers overlap; the units table truncates every unit name
detail: At 820px (the user's iPad in portrait) the IT 'So far' card keeps its three-column desktop grid (220px | 1fr | 340px with 32px gaps) inside a 716px card, so the middle column is ~52px: the P M D D* ruler is 90px wide, its four boundary numbers print on top of each other ('120180240270' as one smear) and the caption 'Qualification boundaries · out of 300 across the 5 units' wraps one word per line over eight lines. The IT units table below keeps its six fixed columns (44 + 180 + 120px + gaps), so unit names read 'F200 Funda…', 'F201 Big dat…', status wraps to three lines ('Sitting · date not set') and the header 'AGAINST THE BOUNDARIES' wraps to three lines. Landscape (1180) is fine (middle column 252px).
evidence: shots/study-core/s-it-ipad.png (full page), zoom shots/study-core/s-it-agg-ipad-crop.png; eval --size ipad: it.agg 716 wide, it.target at x442 w340; k-it-name ellipsised at 95px. css/views/study.css:996 (.k-it-agg three columns), :1031 (.k-it-tr six columns), the single-column/stacked rules only at study.css:1123-1125 (the <=700 tier); tokens.css:657-661 fixed widths; js/modules/itdesk.js:109 caption.
fix: Add an 860px tier (invariant 47 breakpoints): .k-it-agg two columns (left+ruler stacked, target/need on the right) or one column; .k-it-tr switch to the stacked grid-template-areas layout already written for <=700. Give the ruler numbers a min width or drop them below the bar when narrow.
rootCause: desktop grid with fixed side columns has no tier between 1080 and 700

title: iPhone topic page: the Working and Edit buttons squeeze the tab strip to ~181px, hiding the selected tab
detail: At 402px, on every topic tab that shows Working and Edit (Specification, Notes, Flashcards, Quiz, Exam questions), the tab row holds the tab scroller plus those two pill buttons in one flex row (flex: none on the buttons). The scroller shrinks to 181px: only 'Specification' and 'Notes' fit, the Notes count reads '1' instead of '13', and on Quiz the selected tab is not visible at all (strip shows 'Specification, Notes 8 ›'). On Files/Handwritten the strip is 328px, so its width jumps as you change tab. The phone user sees about two of seven tabs.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-topic-notes-iphone.png (Notes), shots/study-core/q-quiz-result-iphone.png (Quiz selected but invisible); eval --size iphone on #/ref/compsci/4.1.1.1 Notes: .k-topic-tabs clientWidth 181, scrollWidth 621. css/views/study.css:208-213 (.k-topic-tabrow one flex row; :not(.k-scroller) flex:none); js/modules/hub.js:2746 (scroller, moreSlot, workBtn, editBtn in one row).
fix: Under 700px wrap the tools onto their own line (.k-topic-tabrow {flex-wrap: wrap} with the scroller at flex-basis 100%, or move Working/Edit into the reader row beside the page picker / the ⋯ fold), so the tab strip always gets the full width.
rootCause: tools share the tab row with no narrow-width tier

title: 'Quiz best' shows a raw count as a percentage: 6 of 11 right reads 'Quiz best 6%'
detail: The quiz engine stores a topic's best as the number of correct answers (st.best = correct), but the topic inspector and the subject desk's 'Quiz best' tile print it through pctText as a percent. Reproduced on a fresh topic (#/ref/compsci/4.2.2.1): 6/11 (lastPct 55) is stored best 6 and the inspector shows 'Quiz best 6%'. The subject tile then takes the max of counts across topics of different lengths. The seeded account has percentages in best (57), so the quiz header reads 'best 57/10'. Either way one surface is wrong for every learner.
evidence: eval: state.study.quiz['compsci:4.2.2.1'] = {attempts:1, best:6, lastPct:55}; inspector text 'Quiz best\n6%'; quiz head 'score 0 · best 6/11'. js/engines/quiz.js:159 (best = correct count), :77 (prints best + '/' + items.length); js/modules/hub.js:3224 and :2200 pctText(best); hub.js:126 max over topics.
fix: Store best as a percent (bestPct) in the quiz engine, migrate existing records once at the store gate (best/len where the deck length is known, else keep), and print '/n' only from a stored count; or keep the count and make hub.js divide by the topic's quiz length. Add a smoke check that the inspector and the quiz header agree.
rootCause: two readers disagree on the unit of study.quiz[k].best

title: Cards reviewed in an unfinished flashcard batch are never logged: no streak, no pay, 'Today so far · Reviewed 0'
detail: The flashcard engine logs its session (and so the Governor's XP/gold/HP, the study streak and every ledger reader) only when the WHOLE batch is finished. Due today opens 'Start review · all 308'; rating 7 cards and leaving (or rating 100 of 308) writes FSRS schedules and review-log rows but adds nothing to the ledger: Review's 'Today so far' still says Reviewed 0, Card stats' Reviews per day and Rating mix stay at zero, the day does not count for the streak (invariant 4) and nothing is paid. With a real backlog the user is punished for doing most of the work.
evidence: eval: on #/due rated 5 cards Good, navigated to #/review: 0 new sessions, 'Today so far Reviewed 0 Accuracy —', dueCount 308 -> 303. js/engines/flashcards.js:325-353 (sessions.log only in finish()); js/modules/due.js:222-230 and js/modules/cardstats.js:218-228 read only those session entries. shots/study-core/q-cardstats-mac.png (Total reviews 5,810 beside an empty Reviews per day and an all-zero Rating mix).
fix: Log the batch when the view is left or hidden (the page-hide / KOS.show teardown the engine already notes at :373), paying for the cards rated so far, once (a session id held by the engine and updated, never logged twice); or cap a due batch at a size people finish (e.g. 20-50 with 'Next 50'). Read 'Reviewed today' and Reviews per day from KOS.reviewLog (one row per rating) instead of session metrics.
rootCause: session logged only in finish(); review surfaces read session metrics rather than the review log

title: Assignment detail: 'Focus on this' and the Complete/Submitted/Blocked buttons sit ~1,000px below the panel's content, off-screen
detail: On the Mac, opening an assignment shows its facts, Subtasks and Attachments, then nothing: the panel is stretched to the full list height (min-block-size: 100%, 1569px on the seeded account) and its footer has margin-block-start: auto, so '◉ Focus on this', '✓ Complete', '⇪ Submitted', 'Blocked' and 'Reopen' land at y≈1577, about 1,000px under the last block. The panel is position: sticky but taller than the viewport, so it never sticks. The primary actions of the page are invisible unless you scroll to the bottom of the whole list.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-asg-open-mac.png (panel ends at ATTACHMENTS, no actions visible); eval: .k-asg-foot y 1577 (margin-top 984px), previous block bottom 577, .k-asg-panel height 1569 sticky. css/views/study.css:864 (min-block-size: 100%), :886 (.k-asg-foot margin-block-start: auto); js/modules/assignments.js:305-321.
fix: Size the panel to the viewport: max-block-size: calc(100dvh - header) with overflow-y: auto and no min-block-size: 100% (align-self: start), so the sticky panel sticks and the foot sits at its bottom edge; or drop margin-block-start: auto and put the actions right under the stats.
rootCause: stretched sticky panel + auto margin footer

title: On iPad and iPhone, tapping an assignment opens its detail at the bottom of the page, out of sight
detail: At 1240px and below the assignments layout becomes one column and the detail panel is appended after the whole list (position: static). Tapping a row only highlights it; the detail, with Edit, subtasks, attachments, Focus on this and Complete, renders 1,300-2,700px further down and nothing scrolls to it or opens it as a sheet. On the iPad (both orientations) and iPhone the page appears to do nothing.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-asg-tap-ipadl.png (row highlighted, no detail); eval after tapping row 2: panel top y=2109 (ipadl, viewport 820), 2629 (ipad, 1180), 2729 (iphone, 874), not in a dialog. css/views/study.css:1057-1059 (@media max-width 1240: one column, panel static); js/modules/assignments.js has no scrollIntoView/openDialog for the detail.
fix: Below 1240 open the detail in a KOS.ui.openDialog sheet (bottom sheet on the phone, side sheet on the iPad) or expand it inline under the tapped row; at minimum scrollIntoView the panel and move focus to its heading.
devices: iPad portrait/landscape, iPhone, Mac windows under 1240
rootCause: master-detail layout collapses to a stacked list with no navigation to the detail

title: Topic inspector and Assignments controls stay 30-32px tall on iPad touch (below the 44px minimum)
detail: On the iPad (820x1180 and 1180x820, pointer: coarse) the zero-specificity :where() touch rule in base.css loses to view-level class rules. On a topic page: the status select (k-ts-select) is 560x32, the page picker (k-topic-page-select) 304x30, the four 'Ask Kurenai / Make flashcards / Make a quiz / Test me' buttons 350x32, the progress-check rows 33px tall. On #/assignments the four filter selects are 30px tall. The phone layout (<700) is fine; only the iPad, the user's touch device, misses the target. Also on iPhone the four assignment filter selects measure 30px (148x30 etc.), Card stats retention selects 67x30, and the Handwritten tab paper chips 32px with the finger toggle 34x20 on touch.
evidence: eval on #/ref/compsci/4.2.1.1 --size ipad: asst.ctx-btn minHeight 32px, ui.status-select 32px, topic.reader-page-select min-height 0 -> 30px, label.k-ts-check 33px; #/assignments ui.status-select 148x30. css/views/study.css:414 '.k-insp-asst button {min-block-size: var(--hit)}' (0,1,1) beats css/views/assistant.css:517 coarse rule (0,1,0); css/views/study.css:231 '.k-topic-page-select {min-block-size: 0}'; study.css:428 '.k-ts-select {min-block-size: var(--rag-pick)}' (32px) override css/base.css:115-119.
fix: Add these to the study.css coarse block at :1184 (.k-insp-asst button, .k-ts-select, .k-topic-page-select, .k-ts-check, the assignment filter selects -> min-block-size: var(--hit-coarse)); or make the base touch rule a layered override that view rules can't silently undercut (e.g. a tools/smoke check that every control under pointer:coarse measures >=44).
rootCause: base.css touch rule is :where() zero specificity, so any class that sets min-block-size (even 0) wins

title: Study-space heroes are seven different heights on one shared component
detail: All seven desks use the same .k-subj-hero (same width, radius, padding, 132px ring, title size), but the height varies with what each space bolts on. Mac 1470: CS/Maths/IT 189px, Code 292, Mind 296, Japanese 339, Creatives 341. iPad portrait: CS 347, Maths/IT 297, Code 459, Mind 482, Japanese 507, Creatives 509. iPhone: CS 255, Maths/IT 205, Creatives 309, Code 379, Mind 402, Japanese 438. Switching subject with the pills makes the whole page below jump by up to 150px. The four path strips are also styled four slightly different ways (Code: 'Stage 1 Foundations' labels over boxed units; Japanese: kanji labels and ellipsised stage names 'Intermedi…', 'Upper int…'; Mind: a single row of unit chips; Creatives: unlabelled-stage section names centred over boxes), and the exam subjects have no path strip at all. The side column then stretches to the hero, so Code's 'Start here' (290px) and Creatives' 'Start here' (340px) cards carry ~120px of content over ~200px of empty card.
evidence: shots/study-core/heroes-compare-mac.png (CS, Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives cropped one above the other), shots/study-core/ipad-cs-vs-maths.png; eval scratchpad/qa/sc-hero.js at mac/ipad/iphone (numbers above). Duplicated per-space rules: css/views/code.css:162-163, css/views/japanese.css:82,172, css/views/mind.css:103-104, css/views/creatives.css:26-27 (identical grid-template-rows/path padding/border written four times); css/views/study.css:54-55 makes the side column follow the hero.
fix: Promote the path strip to one shared part of the hero (.k-subj-hero-path in study.css with a fixed row height, one label style, shared ellipsis rule) and give the bar column a fixed number of rows (pad to 4 or set a fixed hero min-block-size per breakpoint) so every desk's hero is one height; give CS/Maths/IT a path strip too (their units, as Course units already lists) or a matching fixed height. Let the side 'Start here' cards size to content and fill the rest with the next card (Due/Deadlines) instead of stretching.
rootCause: each study space extends the shared hero with its own path/bars markup and duplicated CSS; height is content-driven

title: Subject pills clip 'Study spa…' inside a nested scroller on iPad portrait
detail: At 820px the Study section nav fits, but the CS / Maths / IT / Study spaces pill group (.k-seg, overflow-x:auto) is flex-shrunk from 330 to 288px inside .k-subnav, so 'Study spaces' is cut to 'Study spa' with no arrow or fade; the outer subnav scroller (which has the arrows) never overflows, so nothing tells the user the pill can scroll.
evidence: shots/study-core/ipad-cs-vs-maths.png (top nav row); eval --size ipad: .k-seg x88 w288 scrollWidth 330 overflow auto, parent .k-subnav w716 sw716. css/components.css:52 (.k-seg overflow-x:auto, max-inline-size:100%), css/components.css:80 (.k-subnav flex).
fix: .k-subnav > .k-seg { flex: none; } so the declared outer k-subnav-scroller owns overflow (it already has arrows), as invariant 50 requires.
rootCause: nested shrinkable scroller inside the declared scroller

title: Assignment list rows draw a rule through the middle: .k-asg-sub is two different things
detail: Every row on #/assignments has a hairline between its title and its 'CS · Coursework' line, and that line is 13.5px with 7px padding instead of the intended 12px muted caption. The class k-asg-sub names both the row subtitle and a subtask row in the detail panel; the subtask rule (display:flex, padding-block, border-block-start, font-size 13.5) lands on every list row too.
evidence: shots/study-core/s-assign-mac.png, zoom shots/study-core/s-assign-row-crop.png; elementsFromPoint under the title hits .k-asg-sub. css/views/study.css:856 (.k-asg-sub as caption) vs css/views/study.css:879 (.k-asg-sub as subtask row with border-block-start).
fix: Rename the subtask row (e.g. .k-asg-subtask, and its -t/-x parts) in js/modules/assignments.js and study.css:879-883; add the pair to smoke55's collision guard like the Review/Wishlist ones.
rootCause: class-name collision between two components in one stylesheet

title: Weakest/Continue card ellipsises a word mid-title on the phone ('4.5.4.8 Norm… of floating point form')
detail: Under 700px the side cards wrap (white-space: normal) but keep overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis, so a long first word that does not fit beside the ref is cut to 'Norm…' and the rest wraps below. The title reads 'Norm… of floating point form'. The ref and the title also have no space between them in the text (the reader hears '4.5.4.8Normalisation').
evidence: shots/study-core/s-compsci-iphone-next-crop.png (dpr2); .k-subj-next-t measured 110x65 on iphone. css/views/study.css:60 (nowrap/overflow/ellipsis), :1171 (white-space: normal only).
fix: At <=700 set overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; overflow-wrap: anywhere (or a -webkit-line-clamp: 3 box) on .k-subj-next-t; put the ref on its own line in the phone layout; add a space or aria-label between ref and title.
rootCause: ellipsis rules kept when wrapping is enabled

title: A topic's tab strip forgets its scroll on every redraw, leaving the selected tab off-screen on the phone
detail: On iPhone, scroll the topic tab strip to Handwritten and select it, then any redraw (KOS.rerender: a cloud pull, a rotation crossing a breakpoint, a store change) rebuilds the strip at scrollLeft 0: the selected tab sits at x=498 of a 402px screen and no visible tab is marked as current, while the panel below shows Handwritten (also seen with Files in shots/study-core/q-topic-spec-iphone.png: Files content, strip showing Specification…Quiz). The topic tab strip is created without the scroller's keep/reveal options that the other redrawn strips use since kos-polish-3.
evidence: eval --size iphone #/ref/compsci/4.1.1.4: after selecting Handwritten the tab is at x 223-330 (scrollLeft 275); after KOS.rerender() it is at x 498-605, scrollLeft 0. shots/study-core/q-topic-spec-iphone.png. js/modules/hub.js:2746 KOS.ui.scroller(tabBar, {keepRole, prevLabel, nextLabel}) with no keep/reveal.
fix: Pass keep: 'topic-tabs' and reveal: the selected tab (KOS.ui.scroller({keep, reveal})) as the term ribbon and edge-marked tabs do, and reveal the selected tab on a tab change too.
rootCause: scroller created without keep/reveal

title: Due today's progress meter draws one pip per card: a 308-card queue is a 108px wall of 308 dashes
detail: The flashcard session meter appends a span per card (flex-wrap), so a real backlog (308 due on the seeded account) renders 13 rows of tiny dashes above the card, 560x108px, pushing the card below the fold on the Mac (card top at y=460 of 832) and carrying no readable information. It is rebuilt (308 nodes) on every card.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-due-mac.png; eval on #/due: [data-ui~=fc.pip] count 308, fc.meter 560x108. js/engines/flashcards.js:271-273, css/views/study.css:453-455.
fix: Above ~30 cards draw one continuous bar (done/total, with the current position) instead of pips, e.g. KOS.ui progress bar with a 'n of N' label; keep pips for small topic decks.
rootCause: meter scales linearly with deck size

title: Card stats' RAG column is always empty: the dot is a 0x0 inline span
detail: The Per-topic breakdown table has a RAG header but every cell looks blank. Each cell holds <span class=k-spine-dot data-band=a>, whose size rules (inline-size/block-size) do not apply to an inline element outside the spine's flex row, so it measures 0x0. The 'charts →' links sit in an unlabelled last column, which reads as if they belonged to RAG.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-cardstats-mac.png (RAG column blank); eval: table td .k-spine-dot getBoundingClientRect 0x0, display inline, data-band 'a'. js/modules/cardstats.js:357, css/views/study.css:162.
fix: Give .k-spine-dot display:inline-block (or render KOS.rag's chip with its label, 'Amber'), and label the last column ('Charts') or make the whole row the link.
rootCause: component rule assumes a flex parent

title: The spec spine drawer (iPad portrait, iPhone) opens at the top of the subject, not at the topic you are on, and does not take focus
detail: On a topic page at 820px or 402px, ☰ 'Show the spec spine' opens the overlay drawer scrolled to 4.1. The current topic (marked aria-current) is ~1,600px further down the drawer (y≈2420 in an 822px drawer on iPhone, 2424 on iPad portrait), so finding the neighbouring topics means scrolling the whole tree every time. Focus stays on <body>, so a keyboard or VoiceOver user is not taken into the drawer (no dialog semantics, no focus move).
evidence: shots/study-core/q-spine-iphone.png (drawer at 4.1 while on 4.4.1.3 Kinds of abstraction); eval --size iphone and --size ipad after clicking [data-ui~=study.spine-open]: current entry y 2416/2424, drawer scrollTop 0, activeElement BODY. js/modules/hub.js:368-375 setTreeClosed only toggles drawerOpen/applyTreeCollapsed; no scrollIntoView or focus.
fix: When the drawer opens, scroll the aria-current entry into view (block: 'center') and focus it (or the filter); trap/restore focus as an overlay (or use KOS.ui.openDialog's focus handling) and return focus to ☰ on close.
rootCause: drawer open path does no reveal/focus management

title: Card stats' Due forecast draws the coming days' bars in --s3, darker than the card they sit on (near invisible)
detail: In Graphite the 13 future-day bars of Due forecast are filled var(--s3) = oklch(0.14 …), below the card surface (~0.17-0.19), so they read as black holes rather than bars; only the red overdue bar and the numbers above show. The chart is the main reason to open the card.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-cardstats-mac.png and shots/study-core/q-cardstats-dawn-ipadl.png (Due forecast); eval: rect fill oklch(0.14 0.008 265), body oklch(0.165 0.008 265). js/modules/cardstats.js:268 bars(forecast, {color: 'var(--s3)'}).
fix: Use the scope hue (HUE[sid] / --teal, as Reviews per day does) or --muted for future days, keeping --alarm for overdue; check the result in Dawn and a shop theme.
rootCause: surface token used as a data colour

title: On iPad portrait the topic inspector is stacked under the whole tab, ~1,700-2,600px down, behind a right-pointing collapse chevron
detail: At 820px the inspector (topic status, the four checks, RAG, recall record, quick note, Ask Kurenai / Make flashcards / Test me) is laid out after the tab content at full width: the status select sits at y≈1765 on Specification and the Ask Kurenai buttons at y≈2591, below the end of a long notes page, so the state surface invariant 52 makes 'the sole state surface' is out of reach while studying. Its '›' toggle still points right as if the panel were a side column. On iPad landscape and the Mac it is a side column.
evidence: shots/study-core/empty-topic-ipad.png (Inspector heading under the notes, '›' at right); measurement --size ipad on #/ref/compsci/4.1.1.1: ui.status-select y 1765, asst.ctx-btn y 2591 (Spec), 1227/2053 (Notes).
fix: Between 700 and 1080 open the inspector as an overlay side sheet from a header button (as the spine drawer does), or as a compact strip of status + checks above the tabs with the rest in a sheet; give the stacked state a down/up chevron.
rootCause: no tier for the inspector between the side column and the phone layout

title: Unit cards print 'completed · 0 started' (a supporting zero, invariant 77)
detail: Every Course units card on CS/Maths/IT desks reads '0 / 17 completed · 0 started' on a fresh account and 'n completed · 0 started' whenever nothing is in progress. The started count is a supporting fact and should be suppressed at zero.
evidence: shots/study-core/e-compsci-mac.png (Course units row); js/modules/hub.js:2065 always appends ' completed · ' + started + ' started'.
fix: Append ' · n started' only when started > 0.
rootCause: hub.js:2065 unconditional string

title: Inspector's Quiz best and attempts do not update when a quiz finishes
detail: After finishing a quiz on a topic the inspector still shows the old 'Quiz best' (0% on a first attempt) until something redraws the page; the session has been logged and paid. The result card and the inspector disagree on screen.
evidence: eval on #/ref/compsci/4.2.2.1: after the last 'See your score', record attempts 1 / best 6, inspector still 'Quiz best 0%'; after KOS.rerender() it reads 6%. js/engines/quiz.js:150-165 finish() saves and logs but does not refresh the inspector.
fix: Have finish() trigger the topic page's inspector refresh (the same hook the flashcard engine uses after a rating), or KOS.rerender with keep.
rootCause: engine writes state without notifying the inspector

title: Streak milestone note repeats '36-day streak' once per milestone, and missing milestone records pay every past milestone at once
detail: A quiz scored 40% paid 56 gold: 2 for the quiz plus 3+7+14+30 for streak milestones the run had already passed, and the award notes read '36-day streak' four times. The note text uses the current streak (stk) instead of the milestone (ms). The retro-payment happens whenever g.milestones lacks the run's dates (seen on the seeded account; also possible after the ledger's 2,000-entry cap shortens the computed streak, which moves the run's start date and re-pays every milestone).
evidence: eval KOS.governor.lastAward(): {gold:56, notes:['36-day streak' x4]}; state.governor.milestones afterwards streak3..30 dated 09-30..10-27. js/core/governor.js:330-339.
fix: Push ms + '-day streak' (and collapse to one note), pay only the highest newly reached milestone when several are pending, and key the run by its first ledger date that is not subject to the cap (or store the run start once).
rootCause: note uses stk; milestone key derived from a recomputed streak length

title: Quiz "Next question" shows a keyboard Enter hint (↵) on touch devices
detail: On iPhone the Next question button carries a ↵ key badge; there is no keyboard. The flashcard Keys panel likewise lists Space/1-4 on touch. The flashcard front also says "press to flip" on touch.
evidence: shots/study-core/q-quiz-result-iphone.png
fix: Hide key hints under (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse), as other kbd hints should be.
rootCause: kbd hint rendered regardless of input type

title: Study editor card headers print raw ISO dates and wrap "Card 1" onto two lines on the phone
detail: Each row in the flashcard editor reads e.g. "10 reviews · due 2026-10-29" (an ISO date, and a date already past with no "overdue"). On iPhone the three 44px row buttons leave the header so little width that "Card" and "1" break onto separate lines and the due date splits as "due 2026- / 10-29".
evidence: shots/study-core/q-editor-mac.png, shots/study-core/q-editor-iphone.png
fix: Format with the app date helper ("due 29 Oct", "4 days overdue"), keep the label nowrap, and put the meta on its own line under the phone tier.
rootCause: raw card.due string in js/modules/editor.js row header
