fix: Let a hand-marked milestone count only when a work is attached (offer 'Attach a piece from the Practice Log' / 'Add your work' instead of a bare tick), or keep hand ticks for progress but pay the project only when each milestone has a saved work.
rootCause: markMilestone accepts a bare tick as evidence and pays on it.

title: Work dialog: the picture sits left with a 252 px empty strip beside it, the note is jammed under it, and nothing says when/where the piece was made
detail: Opening an Art work from the Practice Log shows the 560x420 picture flush left in an 840 px dialog (x 343-903 of 315-1155), 'Your note' starts on the image's bottom edge (top 595 = image bottom 595, no gap), and the dialog shows only the title: no track, lesson·study, date, words or check state, which the log row had. The header mark is the generic 創 rather than the track's mark used on the row.
evidence: shots/creatives/n/dense-mac-workdlg.png; eval: img left 343 right 903 in dialog 315-1155; note top 595, img bottom 595; js/modules/creatives.js:527-537 (openWork body); css/views/creatives.css:120 (.k-cr-mine-img display:block, no margin-inline:auto), :144
fix: Centre the media (margin-inline:auto) with a gap token before the note, and add the row's meta line (track · lesson·study · date · words · check) under the title using kindMark(w) as the dialog mark.

title: Lesson spine's subject switch clips the active 'Creatives' pill on iPad landscape
detail: At 1180x820 the spine header's subject group (Code · Japanese · Mind · Creatives) is 209 px wide for 220 px of pills and is not scrolled to the active one, so the lit 'Creatives' pill (238-302) is cut at 293 by the strip edge and the spine's collapse button sits on its end. Same undeclared .k-seg overflow as the stage strip.
evidence: shots/creatives/n/ipadl-lessonD11.png; eval --size ipadl: [study.spine-subjects] left 84 right 293 scrollWidth 220 clientWidth 209 scrollLeft 0; active 'Creatives' 238-302; js/modules/hub.js:439 (k-seg k-seg--fill k-spine-subjects); css/components.css:52
fix: Use the subject's short label in the spine (or a menu) when space is short, or build it as a KOS.ui.scroller with reveal of the active pill.

title: Tracks page: a track's bar says 33% while every unit row beside it says 0 / 3; an unreleased track draws a full-width empty bar
detail: With every A1-A3 lesson at 3 of 4 checks, the Art card's bar reads 33% (mean of lesson check percentages) while its unit rows read 0 / 3 (lessons fully done), two different measures side by side with no label. Editing (no released units) still draws a 1,166 px empty bar and 'later' in mono, which reads as 0% progress rather than 'not yet released'.
evidence: shots/creatives/n/dense-mac-desk.png (first capture, #/creatives Tracks page: Art 33% vs A1 0 / 3; Editing empty bar); js/modules/creatives.js:74-78 (trackPct = mean leafPercent) vs :327-329 (us.done + ' / ' + us.total); :323 bar drawn when pct == null
fix: Label the bar ('33% of checks') or show lessons done/total in the head to match the rows; omit the bar for a track with no released unit and show a 'Coming later' chip instead.

title: Palette drill: the Hue sliders are plain accent bars with no spectrum and no value, so you pick a hue blind
detail: Each colour in 'Palette and contrast' has Lightness and Hue range inputs styled identically (accent fill on a grey track). The hue track shows no colour wheel/spectrum and neither slider prints its value, so moving Hue gives feedback only in the swatch; on a drill about colour this is the main control.
evidence: shots/creatives/n/dawn-mac-palette.png; js/modules/crdrills.js:273-280 (k-crd-range, aria-label '… · Hue', 0-359)
fix: Paint the hue input's track with a linear-gradient over oklch hues at the colour's lightness/chroma and the lightness track from dark to light; show the numeric value beside each label.

title: Afternoon review: 'Place in a free block' menu opens BEHIND the review dialog, so it does nothing
detail: Daily Review > Afternoon > step 3 Time left. Pressing 'Place in a free block' sets aria-expanded=true and appends the menu panel to <body>, but the panel is z-index var(--z-menu)=110 while the review overlay is var(--z-modal)=120, so the menu is painted under the dialog's scrim and panel: nothing visible appears, and a tap where the item would be lands on the dialog (elementFromPoint at the first item's centre returns another row's 'Place in a free block' button). The item's onSelect itself works: invoking it programmatically creates the study block (15:30, 90 min, type study, assignmentId 1) with an Undo toast. Same root cause affects EVERY KOS.ui.menu used inside a KOS.ui.openDialog (the primitive never raises a menu above an open modal). Also reproduced on About to Study's 'Change ▾' task menu (preflight dialog): panel z=110, elementFromPoint at its first item returns the dialog's k-field, not the menu.
evidence: shots/productivity/dr-place-open-mac.png (menu open per aria-expanded, nothing shown); eval: panel z=110, overlay z=120, panel parent BODY, topEl at item centre = 'k-btn k-btn--sm ui.menu-button'; css/tokens.css:1031-1032 (--z-menu:110, --z-modal:120); css/components.css:334 (.k-menu-panel z-index var(--z-menu)); js/core/ui.js:813 (place() appends panel to document.body); js/modules/dayreview.js:609
fix: In KOS.ui.menu place(): when the button is inside an open dialog (btn.closest('[data-ui~="ui.dialog"], .k-dialog-overlay')), append the panel inside that overlay (or set a state the CSS maps to z-index above --z-modal, e.g. a --z-menu-modal token 130). Add a smoke test that opens a menu inside openDialog and checks elementFromPoint hits the item.
rootCause: Menu layer token (110) below the modal layer token (120); menus are portalled to body regardless of an open modal.

title: Every page header shows the PREVIOUS page's painted band after in-app navigation
detail: KOS.ui.pageHeader picks its art from KOS.store.state.ui.view, but KOS.show sets state.ui.view only AFTER the view function has rendered. So navigating Pacing -> Routines draws Pacing's band on Routines, Routines -> Focus draws Reminders' band (Routines maps to 'reminders') on the Focus Timer, Focus -> Reminders draws none (Focus has no PAGE_ART entry), etc. Only a reload (where ui.view was persisted) shows the right picture. Repro via eval navigating #/pacing,#/routines,#/focus,#/reminders,#/calendar,#/routines: header images were reminders, pacing, reminders, none, none, calendar respectively. Affects every page that uses pageHeader, not only Productivity; the art audit just released depends on it.
evidence: eval output: '#/pacing [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.pacing.webp]', '#/focus [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.calendar.webp]'; shots/productivity/focus-mac-seed.png and routines-mac-seed-2.png (sticky-note pinboard band on Focus/Routines); js/core/ui.js:589-592 (art = PAGE_ART[state.ui.view]); js/core/ui.js:1541-1543 (view rendered, then ui.view assigned)
fix: Set a module variable (e.g. KOS.ui.currentView = viewId) BEFORE calling KOS.views[viewId] and read that in pageHeader; or have each view pass opts.art explicitly. Add a smoke check: navigate A->B and assert B's band id.
rootCause: Ordering: state.ui.view is assigned after render in KOS.show (js/core/ui.js:1543), while pageHeader reads it during render.

title: Focus: 'General study — no link' is overridden by About to Study, which silently links the session to the first assignment (even with 'Just start')
detail: On #/focus with subject 'General study — no link' and 'No assignment', pressing Start focus opens About to Study pre-filled with the overdue NEA assignment. Pressing 'Just start' (or Start Focus) starts a session with subject 'compsci' and assignmentId 1. The completed session then banks its minutes on that assignment (invariant 4a) and counts as CS study, i.e. time is misattributed. The only escape in the dialog, 'Change ▾', is a KOS.ui.menu that opens behind the dialog (same z-index bug), so there is no way to keep 'no link' short of turning off About to Study.
evidence: eval: Focus page left on General study/no assignment -> Start focus -> preflight.just-start -> session {subject:'compsci', assignmentId:1}; shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (About to Study shows NEA); js/modules/routineplayer.js:279-287 (taskOf falls back to taskChoices()[0] when ctx has no subject/assignment), 257 (go(skip) merges task even when skip); js/modules/focus.js:2253
fix: taskOf(ctx) must respect an explicit 'no link' from the Focus page: pass ctx.explicit = true from focus.js and return {title:'General study'} without falling back; offer the ladder's suggestion as a 'Use: <task>' choice instead of a default. 'Just start' should start exactly the Focus page's config (ctx without task). Fix the menu z-index too.
rootCause: taskOf() treats an empty subject as 'nothing chosen' and fills it from Today's three/assignments; go(true) still merges the filled task.

title: Running Focus: a long assignment title runs off the screen (left edge on Mac, right edge on iPhone)
detail: The objective/context column on the running Focus screen holds the assignment chip ('課 <title>') with no max width, wrapping or ellipsis. With the NEA assignment the k-fx-ctx box is 616px wide: on the Mac it starts at x=-131 (text cut at the window's left edge: 'tion: stakeholder interviews…'), on iPhone it ends at x=648 in a 402px viewport. The due date is printed raw ('due 2026-10-29'), as are the Focus page's assignment options ('· due 2026-10-29'). On iPhone the context card is also washed out over the bright window art (chips barely legible).
evidence: shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (left edge), shots/productivity/focus-running-iphone.png; eval: .k-fx-ctx rect x=-131..485 (mac), 32..648 (iphone, vw 402); js/modules/focus.js:879-883 (chip('課 '+asg.title), chip('due '+asg.due)), 1018, 2175; css/views/productivity.css:113-114
fix: Give .k-fx-ctx max-inline-size:100% (min-inline-size:0 on the column) and the chip a max-inline-size with text-overflow:ellipsis (title attr for the full name); format due with KOS.ui/hub dayLabel ('due Thu 29 Oct', 'overdue 4 d'). On phone put the context card on a stronger scrim (var(--s1) at ~80%).
rootCause: Chips are nowrap and the flex column is aligned to the end with no width cap, so long content overflows to the left (end-aligned) or right.

title: Afternoon review time strip: end label '22:00 夜' overprints the last hour tick; 30-minute block text wraps to two lines
detail: In the Time left strip the hour ticks are left-anchored at their position and run up to the last hour before the evening review, while the end label is pinned at inline-end. With from=04:46 and until=22:00 the 21:00 tick starts at ~94% of the width, exactly under '22:00 夜' (the screenshot shows '2̶2̶:̶0̶0̶' overprinted). Short free blocks (30 min = ~31px) wrap '30 min' onto two lines and overflow their outline. Same overlap happens at any width; worse on iPad portrait and phone where the strip is narrower.
evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (top-right of strip, and the 08:00 block); js/modules/dayreview.js:593-604 (tick loop t<to; tend appended unconditionally); css/views/routines.css:340-341; shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png (iPad portrait: ticks 20:00/22:00 and '22:00 夜' overprinted, '30 mi' clipped)
fix: Skip any tick whose position is within ~1 label width (e.g. >88%) of the end label, or render the end label as the final tick; thin ticks by available width (every 2h/3h below ~700px). For blocks narrower than the label, show the length only in the aria/tooltip or as a single-line '30m' with white-space:nowrap and no padding.
rootCause: No collision handling between left-anchored ticks and an inline-end end label; fixed hourly tick density regardless of width.

title: Calendar has no Agenda (or Day) view on Mac or iPad; Agenda exists only under 700px
detail: At >700px the Calendar offers only Month and Week (js/modules/calendar.js:1545 mode is 'week'|'month'; buttons at 1589-1591). The Agenda list (renderPhone, the stored 'week' mode) is drawn only when matchMedia('(max-width:700px)') matches (calendar.js:1562-1563, 1613). So the user cannot get the agenda on the MacBook (1470) or iPad (820/1180). There is no Day view at any size. Also the same stored value calMode='week' means 'Week grid' on desktop and 'Agenda' on phone, so an iPad in Split View flipping across 700px silently changes view type.
evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png, cal-week-ipad.png, cal-month-ipadl.png (segmented control: Month | Week only); shots/productivity/calendar-iphone-seed.png (Agenda | Month); js/modules/calendar.js:1545,1562-1563,1589-1591,1613-1620
fix: Make the mode a 3-value per-device setting {month, week, agenda} (+ optional day). Factor the phone agenda list (renderPhone's day lists + agendaRows) into a renderAgenda(board) usable at any width: on desktop/iPad draw it as the board beside the existing Today/Countdowns side column (a 2-week scrolling list grouped by day with time column, hue bar, derived chips). Keep phone default Agenda; migrate stored 'week' on phone to 'agenda'.
rootCause: Agenda was designed as the phone composition (frame 15g) and is hard-wired to the phone branch of render().

title: iPad portrait Calendar: '+ New event' wraps to its own row leaving a full-width empty band
detail: At 820px the header row (‹ title › Today Show Month|Week) fills the width and '+ New event' drops alone to a second line at the left, leaving ~600px empty beside it and pushing the grid down ~60px.
evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-ipad.png (y≈235)
fix: Below 1080 put Today/Show on a second toolbar row with New event at its end, or collapse '+ New event' to the '+' icon button used on phone; or let the title shrink (clamp font-size) so the row fits.
rootCause: .k-cal-head is a wrapping flex row with no layout tier between desktop and phone.

title: Routine offer checkboxes render as 22x44 tall pills on touch devices
detail: In 'Start with these?' (Routines Today/Routines/Templates tabs) each pick box (.k-rt-check, routine.offer-pick) keeps its 22px width while the coarse-pointer rule raises its height to 44px, so on iPad and iPhone each checkbox is a white 22x44 capsule instead of a square. Invariant 69: a control raised for touch must raise its width too.
evidence: measure: 'SMALL button.k-rt-check[routine.offer-pick] 22x44' on ipad and iphone; shots/productivity/routines-iphone-seed.png (tall white capsules)
fix: Give .k-rt-check an explicit aspect-ratio:1 / inline-size equal to block-size under (pointer:coarse), or keep the visual 22px box and grow the hit area with the whole row as the label (the row is already a button-like card).
rootCause: Global coarse-pointer min-block-size for buttons without a matching min-inline-size on this control.

title: Routines 'Start with these?' card leaves ~400px dead on the right on Mac
detail: The offer card spans the full content width (1210px) but the illustration + a ~560px text/list column use only the left two thirds; the right ~400px is empty. Violates the no-dead-space rule.
evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png
fix: Either cap the card's width and place a second card beside it (e.g. Today's reviews), or lay the three template picks out as three columns across the width (they are short), or move the illustration to the right edge so the text sits between.

title: Reminders: the right inspector column is a small hint card over a dead column
detail: With nothing selected, the 320px right column holds only 'Select a reminder to edit…' (120px tall) and is empty below for the whole list length.
evidence: shots/productivity/reminders-mac-seed.png, rem-today-mac.png
fix: When nothing is selected, collapse the inspector and let the list widen, or fill it with useful context (Today's count, upcoming this week, 'From your plan' summary, quick-add with date).

title: Reminders 'Today' leaves out overdue reminders
detail: Today shows 2 items while 8 reminders are overdue; they are only under Overdue/All. A user working from Today never sees what slipped. Most reminder apps (Apple Reminders) show overdue at the top of Today. Also 'From your plan' rows each carry a '↻ From your plan' chip under a 'FROM YOUR PLAN' heading (redundant), and the 'Open plan' links and priority chips sit on different right edges (≈1082 vs ≈1056).
evidence: shots/productivity/rem-today-mac.png; js/modules/reminders.js:334-349
fix: Include overdue items in Today under an 'Overdue' group (count it in the Today badge or show '2 + 8 overdue'); drop the per-row chip in the plan group; align the trailing column.

title: Focus page while a session is minimised is one banner over an empty page
detail: With a session running and minimised, #/focus shows only 'Session in progress — Computer Science' and 'Return to the stage →'; the rest of the 1210x500 content area is blank (Your record, The deal, today's sessions all disappear). Dead space and a lost chance to show live context (objective, cycle progress, notes, today's total).
evidence: shots/productivity/focus-page-minimised-mac.png
fix: Keep the idle page's right column (Your record with today's live total, The deal with the running session's live award preview from KOS.governor.focusAward) and in place of the setup card show a compact live card: clock, cycle bar, objective, Switch…, notes, End early/Return to the stage.

title: Pacing week: lesson ticks (18x18) and lesson-day selects (62x24) are far below the 44px touch minimum on iPad/iPhone
detail: Every class lesson row's tick input (.k-pace-tick-in) measures 18x18 and its day <select> (pace.lesson-day) 62x24 at 820px and 402px with a coarse pointer; the week strip's scroller arrows are 32x32. On the iPad (the user's study device) these are the main controls of the page.
evidence: measure prod/m-ipad-__pacing.json, m-iphone-__pacing.json: 'SMALL input.k-pace-tick-in 18x18', 'SMALL select.k-pace-lesson-day 62x24', 'SMALL button.k-scroller-arrow 32x32'; shots/productivity/pace-week-iphone.png
fix: Make the whole lesson row a <label> for its tick (hit area = row height ≥44) and raise the day select to min-block-size 44px under (pointer:coarse) (or use the dense 24px-with-spacing exception explicitly, invariant 69).

title: Daily Review marks sit in the Week view's all-day row and their time is truncated away
detail: Review marks carry a time (Morning review · 07:00 etc.) but Week view lists them in the all-day row, where the 115px column truncates them to 'Morning revie…', so the time never shows; they also push every day's all-day row to 5-6 lines, shrinking the timed grid.
evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png (all-day rows 5-6 chips tall); eval: 21 review chips at y 297-401; js/modules/calendar.js:600-606, 1799-1801
fix: Draw timed derived marks (reviews, routine windows) as thin dashed markers in the timed grid at their time, or as one compact '朝 昼 夜' glyph row per day with the times in the tooltip/aria.

title: Routines: page-header 'Templates' button duplicates the Templates tab 60px below
detail: The page header's actions are 'Templates' and '+ New routine', and the tab strip right under it has a Templates tab going to the same place. Invariant 50b: never offer the same destination twice in-page.
evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed.png; js/modules/routines.js (routine.templates button)
fix: Drop the header 'Templates' button (keep + New routine), or drop the Templates tab and keep the button.

title: Daily habits card repeats the page sub-line, truncated, and has no add button when empty
detail: Routines Today: the Daily habits card heading's sub-line 'a habit is a routine with one …' is the page header's sub-line again and is ellipsised; empty it shows a paragraph and only a small 'Add habits ›' text link at top-right (on iPhone the link overlaps the truncated sub-line per measurement). Card height then leaves a dead lower half.
evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png (Daily habits card); measure iphone: 'OVERLAP span.k-rt-hd-m.k-ellipsis x button.k-link[routine.habits-edit]'; measure mac DEADH routine.habit-card used 95/244
fix: Remove the sub-line (or make it unique, e.g. 'tick-only, auto-tracked'), and in the empty state put a primary '+ Add a habit' button in the body.

title: Session review repeats '36-day streak' four times and hides what the bonus gold was for
detail: Ending a Pomodoro paid +59 gold (5 for the session + 3+7+14+30 streak milestone bonuses that had not been recorded). The review and the toast print the note list '36-day streak · 36-day streak · 36-day streak · 36-day streak' and a single '+59 gold' while The deal had promised +5 gold, so the user cannot tell why. Each milestone pushes the CURRENT streak length as its note instead of the milestone it paid. The toast also sits over the review's 'Save review' button on Mac.
evidence: shots/productivity/focus-review-mac.png, focus-review-iphone.png; eval KOS.governor.lastAward() = {gold:59, notes:['36-day streak'×4]}; js/core/governor.js:330-338 (notes.push(stk + '-day streak'))
fix: Push one note per milestone: ms + '-day streak bonus +' + ms + ' gold' (or merge into one: 'Streak bonuses 3·7·14·30 days +54 gold'); show the session's own award and bonuses as separate lines in the review. Keep toasts above the dialog footer (offset by the footer height when a dialog is open).

title: Reminders: complete circles are 32x32 on touch
detail: The round complete button (rem.check) stays 32x32 with a coarse pointer on iPad and iPhone (invariant 69 asks 44 for coarse pointer, raising width with height for a circle). The sort/priority pill selects are 30px tall on iPad.
evidence: measure m-ipad-__reminders.json / m-iphone-__reminders.json: 'SMALL button.k-rem-check 32x32' (×28), 'SMALL select.k-pill-select 161x30'
fix: Under (pointer:coarse) give .k-rem-check a 44x44 hit box (visual circle can stay 22-24px via an inner span) and the pill selects min-block-size 44px.

title: Daily Review step tabs: the active tab's focus ring is clipped to two vertical crimson bars
detail: After a step tab is clicked, its focus outline renders only as two vertical crimson lines at its left and right (top and bottom are clipped by the step strip's overflow), which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a focus ring. Seen on Mac and iPad, in Afternoon and Evening reviews.
evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (around 'Time left'), dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png, dr-evening1-mac.png (around 'Tomorrow')
fix: Use :focus-visible only (no ring after a pointer click) and an inset ring (outline-offset negative or box-shadow inset) so the scroller's overflow cannot clip it.

title: Evening review: 'Tomorrow's first task' says nothing is due while overdue plan rows exist; lesson rows show bare dashes
detail: In the evening review the first-task card reads 'Nothing is due soon, so tomorrow starts wherever you like.' although the afternoon review and Reminders list overdue carried-over plan rows; the candidates leave out Pacing rows. The card is then a tall empty box beside the timetable. Tomorrow's lessons with no class time print '–' in the time column.
evidence: shots/productivity/dr-evening1-mac.png; js/modules/dayreview.js:585 (empty-candidates text)
fix: Feed carried-over plan rows (KOS.pacing.dueThisWeek().carried) and the Focus ladder's next into the candidates; omit the time cell (or show 'lesson') when a lesson has no time.

title: Running Focus in a break: red 'End early' stays in the header beside 'End session'
detail: Once a Pomodoro cycle is banked, the stage shows '✓ End session' (pays +35 XP…) but the header still offers a red 'End early', so there are two end controls with conflicting wording and colour.
evidence: shots/productivity/focus-stage-break-mac.png
fix: Hide 'End early' (or relabel it 'End' in neutral style) when canComplete() is true.

title: Routines Today: three equal columns stretch the reviews and habits cards to the routine card's height
detail: With a routine due, Today's reviews (3 rows, ~200px of content) and Daily habits (one paragraph) are stretched to the Morning Routine card's ~460px, leaving large empty lower halves; the routine card's header is cramped ('Leave by 07:45 / 163 min from now' wraps to 4 lines while the side cards are empty).
evidence: shots/productivity/rt-today-mac.png
fix: Give the routine card 2 of 3 columns (or a full row) and stack reviews + habits in the third column; align-items:start for the side cards.

title: Duplicate transactions after re-importing: de-dupe key includes payee, so a second import mapped differently is all 'new'
detail: Exactly the user's screenshot: the same Heron Foods row twice, once titled with the payee and once titled 'Other' with the bank text as the subtitle. Reproduced: import a statement with Description->Payee, then the same file with Description->Note (or payee unmapped); preview reports 0 duplicates and every row imports again. The key is date|minor|payee.lower(), and an empty payee never equals the first import's payee. The second row reads 'Other' because txRow falls back to the category name when payee is empty and shows the note as the sub-line.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1025-1031 (key), js/modules/money.js:587,591 (title/subtitle fallback); shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png; eval repro: second preview {dups:0}
fix: Key duplicates on date+amount+kind+normalised bank text (payee OR note OR raw description, stored as tx.raw), with the bank's own id (OFX FITID / balance-chain) when present; keep the raw description on every imported row; offer 'Replace the previous import of this period' in the preview when a batch overlaps.
rootCause: Dedupe depends on user-chosen mapping; raw source text not kept.

title: Santander midata CSV is refused: 'Merchant/Description' and 'Debit/Credit' headers are not recognised
detail: The midata export's header 'Date,Type,Merchant/Description,Debit/Credit,Balance' maps only Date; GUESS has no pattern for 'Merchant/Description' (payee) or 'Debit/Credit' (signed amount), so read() fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' before the user ever reaches the column mapper, even though the mapper could have fixed it by hand. Reproduced through KOS.money.csv.parse/guess on money-samples/midata-comma.csv: mapping {date:0}, dialogAccepts false.
evidence: js/core/money.js:970-977 (GUESS), js/modules/money.js:937-940 (hard refusal before the mapper); repro: scratchpad/qa/money-samples/midata-comma.csv, scratchpad/qa/mg-import.js
fix: Add patterns (merchant/description, debit/credit, 'amount (£)', 'money in/out (£)'); and never hard-fail on unguessed headers: open the Columns step with the unmatched columns and let the user map them.
rootCause: Exact-match header regexes plus a hard gate before the manual mapper.

title: Import only reads the first line as the header: midata with a leading blank line or a semicolon delimiter, and Online Banking CSV with an account preamble, all fail
detail: parseCSV picks the delimiter from line 1 only (a leading blank line forces ','), and takes rows[0] as the header. Santander midata variants (';' delimited, trailing ';', blank first line) parse into one column; the Online Banking CSV/Excel export starts with 'Account:'/'From:' preamble lines so the header is 'Account:,Santander…'. All refused with the same generic message.
evidence: js/core/money.js:947-969; browser repro of 6 sample files (midata-semicolon.csv delimiter ',' header one cell; santander-online-excel.csv header ['Account:',…]); all dialogAccepts=false
fix: Detect the delimiter over the first ~10 non-empty lines; scan the first 20 rows for the first row that matches date+amount header patterns and treat everything above as preamble (show it as 'Skipped: 3 header lines'); drop trailing empty columns.
rootCause: Header = rows[0], delimiter sniffed from text.split(/\r?\n/)[0].

title: Santander's other exports (.txt, QIF, OFX) are not supported at all; the picker accepts .txt but cannot read it
detail: Online Banking 'Download transactions' offers text (Date:/Description:/Amount:/Balance: blocks with non-breaking spaces), Excel CSV, Quicken QIF and Microsoft Money OFX. The importer is CSV-only, yet the file input accepts text/plain, so the user's .txt is taken and fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' OFX would also give a stable FITID for exact de-duplication.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:889 (accept .csv,text/csv,text/plain), js/core/money.js:947; repro: money-samples/santander-online.txt, santander.qif, santander.ofx all refused
fix: Add format sniffing: OFX/QFX (parse STMTTRN, use FITID as the dedupe key, LEDGERBAL to reconcile), QIF (D/T/P/M/^ records), the Santander .txt block format; name the format detected in the Columns step. Keep CSV for everything else.
rootCause: Single CSV parser path.

title: No way to see, undo or replace an import after the result dialog closes
detail: Each import has a batch id, but 'Undo this import' exists only on the Done step of the dialog (money.js:915). Once closed there is no import history, no filter by source/batch in Transactions (list() filters kind/cat/tag/search only), and bulk select has no 'select all' over a range, so removing a bad 200-row import means ticking rows one by one.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:915-917; js/core/money.js:1050-1056 (undoBatch only caller), list() keep() js/core/money.js:~700-712
fix: An 'Imports' list (Transactions › Imports or Settings): file name, date range, rows, when imported, with Undo/Delete and 'Replace with a new file'. Store {batch, fileName, from, to, n, at} in state.money.imports. Add a Source filter and Select all in view.
rootCause: Batch metadata is not stored anywhere but on rows; UI only exposes it in a transient dialog.

title: Unquoted thousands separators shift columns: '£1,234.56' imports silently as £1.00
detail: A comma-delimited bank file that writes amounts like £1,234.56 without quotes (common in hand-rolled UK exports, and what users get after re-saving midata in a text editor) splits the amount into two cells. The parser never checks a row's cell count against the header, so the Student Finance row imported as +£1.00 and the balance column swallowed '234.56'. No warning in the preview.
evidence: js/core/money.js:947-969 (no per-row width check), 1005-1013; eval repro: row ['2026-10-27','in',100,'STUDENT FINANCE ENGLAND SLC']; shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png shows +£1.00
fix: Flag rows whose cell count differs from the header ('Row 3 has 6 cells, the header has 5'), and for the known Santander layout re-join a split £n,nnn.nn amount; show the running Balance column so a mismatch is visible.
rootCause: Parser trusts column positions without validating row width.

title: A recurring rule's 'Confirm' and an imported bank row for the same payment double-count
detail: Confirming an occurrence (Google One £1.59, Phone £10) writes its own transaction r:<rule>:<date> with payee = rule name; importing the bank statement then adds 'GOOGLE *Google One, ON 27-10-2026' £1.59 as a separate row. Neither side looks at the other: preview's dedupe compares payee text ('google one' vs the bank string) and confirm() never searches existing transactions. Spend, budgets, Safe to spend and Reports count the payment twice. This is a second path to the duplicates the user saw.
evidence: js/core/money.js:414-433 (confirm creates tx unconditionally), 1025-1031 (dedupe by exact payee); recurring page shows Google One 'Due' for Sep/Oct even though the user has bank rows for them (shots/money-goals/recurring-mac.png)
fix: On import, match rows to due occurrences (same amount ±0, date within ±3 days, payee alias set on the rule) and MARK the occurrence done pointing at the imported tx instead of creating a new one; on Confirm, offer 'Use the bank entry from 27 Oct' when one matches.
rootCause: Rules and imports are two independent writers of the same real-world payment.

title: Imported rows are unusable as information: raw bank strings, everything in Other, Type and Balance columns discarded
detail: Every imported row lands in Other/Other income (preview opts.outCat), payee is the raw bank text ('HERON FOODS HOYLAND (VIA APPLE PAY), ON 29-10-2026', 'CARD PAYMENT TO …,3.45 GBP, RATE 1.00/GBP ON …'), so Overview's 'This month by category' is one 'Other' bar, the Selected card shows a 4-line shouting title, spend-by-merchant is impossible and nothing learns from the user's re-categorising. The bank's Type (DEB/DD/FPI/FPO/SO) and Balance columns are dropped, so direct debits are not detected and the import cannot be reconciled. There is no merchant normalisation, no payee->category memory and no recurring detection anywhere in money.js.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1019-1021 (cat = other), 1041; grep of money.js/modules/money.js finds no merchant/auto-category code; shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png
fix: Revamp (see summary): store raw text, derive a clean merchant (strip 'CARD PAYMENT TO', '(VIA APPLE PAY)', ', ON dd-mm-yyyy', ',n.nn GBP, RATE …', store numbers, title-case); payee rules {match -> merchant, category} learned when the user sets a category ('Always put Heron Foods in Food?'); a built-in UK merchant table (Tesco, Heron Foods, Greggs, Stagecoach, Google, Spotify, SLC…); Type DD/SO -> suggest a recurring rule; Balance -> reconcile and show 'Matches the bank: £120.10'.
rootCause: Import engine was built as a column copier ('the pages are phase 2' comment at money.js:946).

title: iPhone: Money's Transactions, Month and year, Import/Export CSV and Goals' This week/This month/Done are unreachable
detail: Under 700px the page's section tabs ([data-phone-tabs]) are hidden on the promise that the title bar's switch offers them, but mobile-shell's destinations() only falls back to page tabs when the section has no subnav. Productivity has a subnav, so the 'Switch within Productivity' sheet lists Focus Timer…Money, Goals, and Money's six views and Goals' four views vanish. On the Money overview the only visible links are Budgets →, Recurring →, Pots →; there is no way to open Transactions (where Import CSV lives) or Month and year. Goals: This week/This month/Done tabs measure 0x0.
evidence: css/components.css:652-654; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:457-463 (subnav wins); js/modules/money.js:128, js/modules/goals.js:303; eval at iphone size: visible controls on #/money list no Transactions/Import; goals tabs 0x0; shots/money-goals/overview-iphone.png, goals-iphone.png
fix: In destinations(), when the page carries [data-phone-tabs] list those tabs in the sheet (as a second group under the section list), or keep the page tabs visible as a k-scroller strip under the title bar for Money and Goals.
rootCause: Phone title bar prefers the section subnav and the CSS hides page tabs unconditionally.

title: Import preview hides the payee and amount, and the Import button is below the fold
detail: On the Mac (1470x832) the import dialog is 760px wide (it borrows Goals' --gl-dialog-w), the Columns card takes --mn-map-w, and the Preview card gets 264px. Its 4-column row grid (150px chip, 74px date, 1fr payee, 90px amount) leaves the payee 0px wide and pushes the amount to x=1148, outside the card (right edge 1087) — the preview shows only '+ New' and a date, so the user cannot check what will be imported. The 'Cannot read' row's reason is hidden the same way. The dialog body scrolls (907 > 713) and the footer with 'Import 4 entries' sits at y=860, off screen.
evidence: shots/money-goals/import-preview-mac.png; eval: pvcard w=264, pv grid '150px 74px 0px 90px', amount x=1148, foot y=860; css/views/money.css:135,169,176
fix: Give the import dialog its own wide token (~1080px, full sheet on iPad), stack Columns above Preview below ~900px, shrink the state chip to its content, pin the footer (sticky) so Import is always visible.
rootCause: Dialog width token from Goals + fixed grid columns.

title: Month and year: 'In' shows expected income as if received
detail: For the current month the side card's In figure is ins.planned (received + still expected), e.g. 'IN £450.00 · £450.00 still expected' when nothing has come in yet. The headline figure should be what came in, with expected as the sub-line.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1695-1697; shots/money-goals/month-mac.png
fix: fig('In', cur.income, expected ? '+' + said(expected) + ' still expected' : null).
rootCause: inFig uses ins.planned

title: 'Never printed' card shows designer rules to the user
detail: Month and year's side column contains a card titled 'Never printed' explaining 'Never a bare 0 or +∞%' — an implementation rule from the design notes, meaningless to the user and violating invariant 50a (rules belong in Help & Guide).
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1698; shots/money-goals/month-mac.png
fix: Remove the card; use the column for something useful (top merchants this month, biggest change, the month's subscriptions).
rootCause: Design annotation shipped as UI copy.

title: Money's section tabs jump between pages (Add entry button appears on some pages only)
detail: On Overview/Transactions/Recurring the tab strip spans x≈617–1180 with '+ Add entry' after it; on Budgets/Pots/Month and year there is no Add entry and the strip sits at x≈742–1305 and vertically centred differently (y 183 vs 204). Switching tabs makes the control you just clicked move under the pointer. The strip and Hide amounts pill also sit over the painted header band, Hide amounts touching its right edge on Budgets/Pots.
evidence: shots/money-goals/overview-mac.png vs budgets-mac.png, pots-mac.png, month-mac.png
fix: Keep Add entry (or a placeholder of equal width) on every Money page, or put the section tabs on their own row left-aligned under the title as other Productivity pages do.
rootCause: header() actions differ per view in js/modules/money.js

title: Pots: empty right column beside the pot cards, and Move money's tabs/select clipped
detail: With two pots the grid shows Emergency and the 'Saving for something?' tile, leaving a ~410px empty column on the right (x 1036–1446). The Move money card clips 'Between pots' at its right edge and the To select shows 'New laptop fc'.
evidence: shots/money-goals/pots-mac.png
fix: Use auto-fill grid with minmax so cards stretch (or put Move money in the empty column); let the Move money segments wrap and put From/To on separate rows under ~360px.
rootCause: Fixed-column pot grid; segmented control without wrap.

title: iPhone Recurring: the third occurrence tile is cut off at the card edge
detail: At 402px each due rule shows three occurrence tiles in a row; the third (Sat 28 Nov · Upcoming) runs to x=410, past the card and viewport, reading "Upcomi" / "Sat 28 No". It is not a declared scroller (invariant 50). The New rule form is also always expanded at the bottom of the phone page and the + FAB covers its Next-dates line.
evidence: DOM measure iphone #/money/recurring: k-mn-occ-i right=410; shots/money-goals/recurring-iphone.png
fix: Under 560px show two tiles (last + next) or wrap them; make the tile row a KOS.ui.scroller if three are needed; collapse New rule behind the + New rule button on phone.
rootCause: Fixed 3-column occurrence grid without a phone tier

title: Goal page: status chip unreadable on the painted band, and a mostly empty page
detail: On #/goals/<id> the 'Too early to call' chip sits on the header painting at very low contrast (grey text on mid-tone art). The page body is one stats card and two small side cards; for a Collection titles goal it never lists which titles count or what to read next, and it does not link to them, leaving ~400px of empty page at 1470x832. Fractional 'The line says 0.3 titles' for a count of titles reads oddly.
evidence: shots/money-goals/goal-detail-mac.png
fix: Give band chips a solid scrim background (as the Hide amounts pill has); for count goals list the counted/remaining items with links into the vault (connected OS); round the line for integer units ('on pace: 0 of 12 by today').
rootCause: Detail page draws only aggregate facts.

title: Painted page header shows the PREVIOUS page's picture (Goals shows Money's jar, Money shows Goals' mountain)
detail: KOS.ui.pageHeader picks its art from KOS.store.state.ui.view, but KOS.show only sets ui.view AFTER the view function has rendered. So the first render of any page that relies on PAGE_ART draws the art of the page you came from; a redraw on the same page then corrects it. Reproduced: money -> goals gives app.hero.page.money.webp on Goals; goals -> money/budgets gives app.hero.page.goals.webp on Money. Affects every page in PAGE_ART (Review, Assignments, Exams, Pacing, Calendar, Reminders, Routines, Goals, Money, Wishlist, Governor, Reports, Archive...).
evidence: js/core/ui.js:589-592 (reads ui.view), js/core/ui.js:1540-1543 (view set after render); eval sequence output: '#/goals => app.hero.page.money.webp', '#/money/budgets => app.hero.page.goals.webp'; shots/money-goals/goals-mac.png (jar on Goals)
fix: Set KOS.store.state.ui.view (or a transient KOS.ui.rendering = viewId) before calling KOS.views[viewId], or have pageHeader take the view id from the router's current call.
rootCause: Ordering in KOS.show: state.ui.view assigned after render.

title: CSS class collision: first-run steps and the import stepper share .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step, breaking both
detail: css/views/money.css defines .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step/.k-mn-step-n twice: once for the import dialog's horizontal stepper (158-163) and again for the first-run checklist (319-321). The later column layout makes the import stepper a vertical centred list that eats ~170px of the dialog; the earlier align-items:center leaks into the first-run list, so its numbered circles sit at different x (906/934/910) because each step is centred by its own width.
evidence: css/views/money.css:158-163 vs 319-321; shots/money-goals/import-midata-fail-mac.png (vertical stepper), money-empty-mac.png (misaligned 1/2/3)
fix: Rename one set (e.g. .k-mn-istep for the import stepper) and set align-items: stretch on the first-run list.
rootCause: Duplicate selectors in one view stylesheet.

title: Transactions 'This view' totals cover only the rows loaded so far
detail: With range 'Everything' the side card reads '60 entries so far · In +£1,337.80 · Out −£509.51' — totals of the first lazy batch, not of the period. A user checking a month's spend gets a partial figure that changes as they scroll.
evidence: js/modules/money.js drawSide (sums `shown`); shots/money-goals/tx-dawn-mac.png
fix: Compute the range totals with KOS.money.rangeSummary(from,to) (index read, no rendering) and keep the lazy list for rows only.
rootCause: Totals derived from the rendered batch.

title: iPad: Money header wraps Add entry to its own row and clips Hide amounts; filter selects are 30px on touch
detail: At 820x1180 the section tabs + Hide amounts fill the band row, Hide amounts' right border is cut at the band edge (x 804), and '+ Add entry' drops to a second row, making the band 220px tall with a gap. On Transactions the Category and Dates selects are 30px tall and rows 41px, under the 44px touch minimum (invariant 69); Pots' ⋯ menu button is 44x32 and Budgets' month-start select 70x30.
evidence: shots/money-goals/tx-ipad.png; DOM measure ipad: money.tx-cat 165x30, money.tx-range 144x30, money.tx-row 696x41, ui.menu-button 44x32
fix: Move section tabs to their own row below the title at <=1080px; apply the coarse-pointer 44px rule to .k-pill-select and menu buttons.
rootCause: Header actions row not tiered for 701-1080; pill-select lacks coarse-pointer sizing.

title: Phone section sheet stays open across navigation and shows the wrong page ticked
detail: Opening 'Switch within Productivity' on Goals and then navigating (back gesture / hash change) leaves the sheet over the new page with 'Goals ✓' while Money is shown; it even survived a viewport change to iPad width.
evidence: shots/money-goals/overview-dawn-mac.png and first tx-ipad attempt showed the stale sheet after two navigations
fix: Close activeSectionOverlay on every KOS.show / hashchange in mobile-shell.js.
rootCause: mobile-shell openSection overlay not tied to navigation.

title: Goals: zero counts printed and empty-state card leaves a dead half
detail: This week with no goals shows the filter pill 'All 0' (invariant 77) and an empty-state card whose picture and one line sit in the left 60% with no action, next to the 'Aim at something new' card. 'Your run' paints '0 behind this week' in the alarm colour even when nothing is behind.
evidence: shots/money-goals/goals-week-ipad.png, goals-mac.png
fix: Hide the count at 0 (or the whole domain pill row when empty); put New goal / templates in the empty card; use muted tone for a zero 'behind'.
rootCause: Pill count and stat tone not zero-aware.

title: UR-20 verified: Collection goal types read the whole vault, so a goal starting today is Met at once and pays the Goal getter badge
detail: Fixture on the seeded account (today Thu 5 Nov): goals with startDate 2026-11-05 and deadline 2026-12-15 measured titles-completed 222/10 (completed), library-size 1880/100, episodes-watched 13326/100, chapters-read 21735/100, game-hours 3115/100 (all 'completed' on the day they were made); favourites 82, purchases 7 and routes-cleared 16 are all-time counts too. Six seeded goals were completed on first compute, wrote six completionLedger receipts and earned achievement goal-getter tier 1 at once (state.achievements.earned['goal-getter']). Because remove() leaves the ledger entry and the badge counts ledger rows, creating and deleting such goals farms Goal getter's 10 and 50 tiers, which invariant 162 never takes back. The editor still offers Starts and Deadline and draws a pace line for these types, promising a range. Of the 13 Collection types only spend-below reads the range (specific-title/finish-series read one title by design).
evidence: eval fx1/seed compute: rows 'titles-completed | 222 | 10 | completed', 'library-size | 1880 | 100 | completed', 'episodes-watched | 13326 | 100 | completed'; completionLedger ids 1,2,4,5,6,9; achievements.earned goal-getter tier 1; js/core/goals-collection.js:49-53,54-57,87-94 (mods() reads mediadb.stats aggregate); js/core/goals.js:438-441 (receipt + achievements.touch); js/modules/goals.js:892 (Starts/Deadline offered for every non-repeat type); js/core/achcatalogue.js:461-462; after deleting and recreating fixture goals the ledger held 13 receipts for 2 live goals and Goal getter II (10 goals) unlocked (screenshot shots/goals/routine-days-saved-mac.png)
fix: Measure the period from the media activity journal (mediadb journal [ts,kind,from,to], invariant 99): completions/status->completed, progress/volume/hour deltas and favourites added with ts in [start, deadline]; purchases by purchasedAt (as spend-below already does); library-size by createdAt. Then mark these types repeat-capable. Until then, record a baseline at creation (onCreate, as topics-green does) and measure the delta. Decide with the user whether goal-getter earned this way is revoked (needs an explicit exception to invariant 162).
rootCause: goals-collection.js types were moved unchanged from Collection Goals v2, which measured vault state, while the v3 editor gives every type a start date and a pace line

title: 'Keep a routine on N days' and 'A routine's streak' can never be linked to a routine: the editor has no routine field
detail: Both routine goal types are offered under Productivity in New goal, but goalDialog draws no routine picker (nothing in js/modules/goals.js reads or writes params.routine), so Save stores params {} and the goal measures 'No routine linked' forever (current null, status active). Reproduced: with two routines (Stretch habit, Evening wind-down) the routine-days editor shows Title, Target, Repeats, Starts, Deadline and Milestones only; the saved goal computes [null, 'No routine linked', 'active']. No other surface (Routines pages) creates these goals either (grep routine-days/routine-streak: only js/core/routines.js:752-764).
evidence: eval: editor text 'Keep a routine on N days ... Title Target Repeats ... Starts Deadline · optional Milestones' and saved params '{}'; compute -> ['Keep a routine on N days', null, 'No routine linked', 'active']; js/core/routines.js:750-764; js/modules/goals.js:828-902 (no routine field)
fix: Add a fields.routine flag to both types and a Routine select (KOS.routines.all(), including Daily habits) in goalDialog that writes params.routine; refuse Save without one. Offer 'Make this a goal' from a routine's page.
rootCause: types registered by routines.js after the editor was built; the editor only knows fields it hard-codes

title: 'A habit's streak' lists habits from the frozen pre-Routines store, so habits made in Routines can't be picked
detail: The Habit select is filled from store.state.todo.habits (js/modules/goals.js:878-881), which invariant 142 freezes once Habits move into Routines. With a habit added through KOS.routines.addHabit('Stretch'), the select had zero options; saving stores params.habit undefined and the goal reads 'No habit linked'. For the user (migrated 26 Oct) the list shows only the habits frozen at migration, including ones since removed, while the measure resolves through KOS.routines (goals.js:641-646). habit-streak also duplicates routine-streak.
evidence: eval: routines ['r_hf2bclf7m:habit:Stretch','r_zzd3e2f7u:evening:Evening wind-down'], todo.habits [], editor select 'Habit' options []; shots/goals/editor-habit-streak-mac.png; js/modules/goals.js:878-881; js/core/goals.js:638-655
fix: Fill the select from KOS.routines.habitsView() (or all routines of kind habit) and store params.routine; better, retire habit-streak in favour of routine-streak with a routine picker (keep old records readable).
rootCause: editor reads the legacy habit list; measure reads Routines

title: UR-22 verified through Goals: one 0% quiz per topic turns five topics Green and completes 'Move topics to Green' at once
detail: Empty account: a 'Move topics to Green' goal on five Maths leaves (baseline 0). Logging one quiz attempt at 0% on each leaf makes KOS.rag.effective return band 'g' for all five (auto() starts at 100 and the quiz penalty is capped at 25, so 0% -> 75 = Green), and the goal computes 5/5 'completed' with an activity-only receipt and an achievements touch. Exam goals 'Topics green or covered' (scopeCount) and Exams readiness coverage read the same band, so they are met by failing quizzes too.
evidence: eval fx8: bands ['g','g','g','g','g'] after study.quiz[k]={attempts:1,lastPct:0}; goal '5|5|completed'; completionLedger receipt {type:'topics-green',payout:'activity-only'}; js/modules/rag.js:29-90 (score from 100, quiz cap 25, Green >= 70); js/core/goals.js:534-546, 574-581; js/core/goals-exams.js:58-66
fix: Fix RAG as UR-22 proposes (evidence-weighted score, minimum evidence before any band, Green only when recall and practice both clear their bar). In Goals, count a leaf only when its band rests on enough evidence (e.g. rag.auto(...).evidence >= threshold) and judge topics-green on the deadline (hold) rather than on first touch.
rootCause: rag.js auto() subtracts capped penalties from 100 with no evidence floor

title: Editing a title goal silently relinks it to another title; only the first 60 in-progress titles can ever be linked
detail: The Linked title select of 'Complete a specific title' / 'Finish a series' lists only titles with status inProgress, alphabetically, capped at 60. Editing a goal whose title is now completed (or planned, on hold, or past the 60th) leaves its own title out of the list, so the browser selects the first option and Save rewrites linkedEntryId. Reproduced: goal 'Finish Zzz' linked to entry 2 (completed); Edit then Save without touching anything -> linkedEntryId 1 ('Aaa Watching'). It also means a planned title can't be a goal ('finish X before December') and a user with more than 60 titles in progress can't pick most of them.
evidence: eval: options ['1:Aaa Watching'], selected '1', goal.linkedEntryId 2 -> 1 after Save; js/modules/goals.js:864-871, 955
fix: Always include the goal's current title as the selected option; replace the capped select with a search picker over the whole vault (any status), as the Collection's own pickers do.
rootCause: select filled from a filtered, capped query without the current value

title: Repeating goals count activity from before the goal started in their first period (week and month)
detail: A weekly Study-hours goal (target 2 h, week Mon-Sun) started Wed 14 Oct: its first outcome is the week of Mon 12 Oct and it was judged MET from 2 h logged on Tue 13 Oct, the day before it existed. A monthly goal started 20 Oct judged October as 15 h, counting 10 h from 5 Oct and 2 h from 13 Oct. closePeriods begins at periodOf(g, g.startDate) and measures the whole period, and the live period's measure does the same. Same UR-20 class: things done before the start count.
evidence: eval fx2: weekly outcomes {'2026-10-12':{met:true,value:2}} with startDate 2026-10-14 and the only Oct 12-18 session dated 2026-10-13; monthly outcomes {'2026-10':{met:true,value:15}} with startDate 2026-10-20; js/core/goals.js:379-397 (closePeriods), 418-419 (from = per.from)
fix: Clamp each period's from to max(per.from, g.startDate) when measuring (and prorate or mark the first partial period 'partial' so a 3-day first week is not judged against a 7-day target), or start the first period at the next boundary.
rootCause: period ranges ignore startDate

title: Changing a repeating goal's 'week runs' or its repeat keeps the old periods: history fills with overlapping weeks and months
detail: Editing a weekly goal from Monday-weeks to 'From the day it starts' (Wednesday) kept the three Monday-keyed outcomes and added three Wednesday-keyed ones, so 'Every week so far' shows six periods for three weeks (2026-10-12, -14, -19, -21, -26, -28) and the run is computed across both. Switching the same goal from Every week to Every month kept all six week keys and added '2026-10'. update() only merges outcomes when repeat is unchanged, but normalise keeps raw.outcomes whatever the repeat, and weekFrom changes are not considered at all.
evidence: eval fx2 wStart.outcomes (6 keys); eval fx3 after repeat:'month' -> keys ['2026-10-12','2026-10-14','2026-10-19','2026-10-21','2026-10-26','2026-10-28','2026-10'], run 2; js/core/goals.js:162-168 (normalise keeps outcomes), 266 (merge on same repeat)
fix: When repeat or weekFrom changes, drop (or archive under a separate key) outcomes whose keys do not match the new period grid, and re-judge from startDate; say so in the editor ('the history restarts').
rootCause: outcomes keyed by period start are carried across a change of period grid

title: A met goal stays 'Met' after its target is raised or a manual count is lowered (10% shown as Met)
detail: A manual goal nudged to 3/3 completes; nudging to 1 keeps 'completed'; editing the target to 10 keeps 'completed' with _pct 10, so Done lists it as Met at 1 of 10. derive() returns 'completed' whenever g.status==='completed' && completedAt, and update() never clears it when the target, type link or dates change. The same holds for an auto goal edited after completion (e.g. a UR-20 goal whose target the user raises to fix it stays Met). There is also no -1 or undo for a manual goal's +1 (only '+1' in actionFor) and no Reopen in the UI (G.reopen is unused), so a mis-tap cannot be corrected except by Restart, which wipes the start date.
evidence: eval fx2: man {st:'completed'} -> after nudge -2 {st:'completed',cur:1} -> after target 10 {st:'completed',cur:1,tgt:10,pct:10}; js/core/goals.js:305 (sticky completed), 259-272 (update), js/modules/goals.js:243 (+1 only); grep: reopen not referenced in js/modules/goals.js; tick(): notice 'goal:3:done | Goal reached — Finish Zzz | 0 of 1 title' after the goal's link changed
fix: In update(), if target/type/links/startDate/deadline change on a completed goal, re-derive (clear completedAt; keep the ledger receipt so nothing is paid twice). Give manual goals a stepper (-1/+1 or a 'Set count' field in Edit) and an Undo toast after +1.
rootCause: completion is sticky by design for evidence types but edits are not treated as a new judgement

title: Stay-under goals on live state (No overdue assignment, Carry-overs cleared, Subscriptions below) flip between Missed and active and are judged only at the moment they are looked at
detail: Fixture: a 'No overdue assignment' goal for 1-30 Nov with 3 overdue assignments is 'failed' the moment it is made (before its deadline), then goes back to 'active' (failedAt cleared) once overdue reads 0, then, with the deadline moved to yesterday while overdue was 0 for one compute, becomes 'completed' and stays completed (sticky) after overdue returns to 3. So a month with overdue work every day except the last look is Met, and a breach early in the month is forgotten. The measure reads KOS.assignments.counts() / pacing.dueThisWeek() / subscriptions() NOW, not over [start, deadline]; derive() treats current<=target at the first compute after the deadline as success. add() also gives every such goal a deadline of month end silently.
evidence: eval fx5: a '3|failed|failed|1' -> b (overdue 0) '0|active|active|0|under' -> c (deadline 2026-11-04) '0|completed' -> d (overdue 3 again) '3|completed'; js/core/goals.js:656-674 (live measures), 307-311 (under-direction derive), 251 (month-end default)
fix: For live stay-under types, record a breach (first day current>target inside the range) into params and judge from it: failed once breached (or 'held N of M days'), completed only if never breached by the deadline. Alternatively derive from history: assignments' due/submitted dates give overdue days in the range.
rootCause: state types are judged like range counts

title: 'Review flashcards' and 'Keep recall' offer Japanese, Mind and Code but never count their reviews
detail: The subject select of cards-reviewed and recall-rate lists every subject (All, CS, Maths, IT, Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives), but the measure reads only ledger entries of type 'flashcards' or 'due-review'. Japanese reviews are logged as type 'ja' and Mind's review blocks as type 'mind' (with metrics.cards), Code's retrievals as type 'code', so a 'Review 200 Japanese cards this week' goal stays at 0 forever, and 'All subjects' silently leaves those reviews out.
evidence: eval: cards-reviewed editor subject options [':All subjects','compsci','maths','it','code','ja','mind','creatives']; js/core/goals.js:557-571 (type filter); js/core/ja.js:228, js/core/mind.js:272 (their session types)
fix: Count review sessions by kind across owners (flashcards, due-review, ja reviews, mind reviews, Code retrievals) or restrict the select to subjects whose reviews the measure reads; the same review-log rows (KOS.reviewLog, src per owner) could be the single source.
rootCause: measure hard-codes two session types while the editor lists KOS.subjects.ids()

title: iPhone: 'Aim at something new' template rows are 180px tall for one line of text
detail: On the dense Goals page at 402px each of the three template rows in the 'Aim at something new' tile is 322x180 with a single 12.5px line, so the tile is ~650px of mostly empty boxes. The flex-basis var(--gl-tpl-min) meant as a row WIDTH becomes the row HEIGHT once the phone rule turns the list into a column.
evidence: shots/goals/dense-all-iphone.png (bottom); eval: .k-gl-tplrow sizes ['322x180','322x180','322x180']; css/views/goals.css:122 (.k-gl-tplrow flex: 1 1 var(--gl-tpl-min)) with 207/226 (flex-direction: column)
fix: Reset flex: 0 0 auto on .k-gl-tplrow when the list is a column (phone rule), or set the basis only in the row layout.
rootCause: flex-basis applies on the main axis, which flips to vertical

title: iPhone: goal cards hide the deadline, the pace chip and the action button
detail: Under 700px the card's band top (pace chip: Behind / Too early / Display only) and footer ('3 days left · by Sun 8 Nov', and the action: Start focus, Review, Today's Daily 20, +1 for a manual goal) are display:none. On the phone list a goal therefore shows neither when it ends nor whether it is behind, and a manual goal's +1 is only reachable by opening it. Only the hero keeps them.

fix: Keep a compact one-line foot on phone (pace chip + 'n days left') and the action as an icon button, instead of hiding both.

title: iPhone: the goal's pace chart labels shrink to about 6px
detail: On #/goals/<id> at 402px the pace chart SVG is scaled to the card width, so its axis labels (10 h, 5 h, Mon…Sun) render with an 8px box (≈6px glyphs), far under the 11px label floor of invariant 63 and unreadable on the phone.

title: Goal editor: 'Every month' is cut off in the Repeats control beside a money amount (mac)
detail: In the New goal editor for a money type (Spend below an amount, Earn at least) at 1470x832, the Repeats segmented control shares a row with the amount field and is 210px wide for 281px of content; 'Every month' runs from x=968 to 1073 while the control ends at 1007, so it reads 'Ever' and is clipped by the dialog. The count stepper row of other types has the same two-column layout.

fix: Put Repeats on its own row (or let the row wrap when the segment's min-content exceeds its track); k-seg--fill should never shrink below its content.

title: Editing a 'Move topics to Green' goal's subject or topics keeps the old baseline, so it can be met instantly
detail: topics-green records params.baseline (green topics at creation) in onCreate, and update() only re-runs onCreate when the TYPE changes. A goal made for IT (baseline 0) and edited to Maths, where 5 leaves are already green, reads 5 new green topics and completes 5/3 on the spot; the reverse edit leaves it unreachable. Same for exam_recall/exam_topics_green baselines when relinked to another exam (linkExam does not re-baseline).
evidence: eval fx8: g2 baseline 0 (IT) -> update links {subject:'maths'} -> '5|3|completed|5 green now|0'; js/core/goals.js:268 (onCreate only on type change), 574-576; js/core/goals.js:849-855 (linkExam)
fix: Re-run def.onCreate (re-baseline) in update()/linkExam whenever links, refs, subject or params that the measure reads change, before computing; tell the user 'counting from now'.

title: Projected-recall goal with too little data shows '–' and a meaningless 'The line says 4.3%', without saying why
detail: A template-made 'CS Paper 1 mock recall ≥ 95%' goal on an account with no rated cards: recallNow() is thin, so onCreate stores baseline 0 and the page shows SO FAR '–' beside THE LINE SAYS '4.3 % by today' (a straight line from 0% to 95% across the weeks), which no recall figure can follow. The reason the measure is empty ('Appears after 20 rated cards in scope…', the measure's meta) appears nowhere on the goal page, and the page has no action (the list card's 'Review' button is not repeated here).
evidence: shots/goals/detail-exam-mac.png; eval: page text has no 'Appears after'/'20 rated cards' and no 'Review'; js/core/goals-exams.js:111-121 (baseline 0 when thin), js/core/goals.js:474 (_expected drawn whenever reach + not noPace); js/modules/goals.js:548-560
fix: When the baseline is unknown (thin), store null and draw no line until the first measured figure becomes the baseline; print _meta under '–' on the goal page and add the type's action (examAction/actionFor) to the page header.

title: First-goal template grid leaves an empty sixth column at 1470 (auto-fill)
detail: On an empty account, #/goals at mac width shows the five templates in a grid of six 186px tracks, so a sixth empty track (~196px) sits at the right of the card: dead width the user standing rule forbids.
evidence: shots/goals/empty-all-mac.png; eval: .k-gl-tpls gridTemplateColumns = 186px x6 with 5 children; css/views/goals.css:138 repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--gl-tpl-min),1fr))
fix: Use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...,1fr)) so the five tiles stretch across the card (or cap columns at the template count).
rootCause: auto-fill keeps empty tracks; auto-fit collapses them

title: Reports drop repeating-goal periods that straddle a report boundary (weeks from a weekday, payday months)
detail: goalFacts counts an outcome in the report whose range holds the period's START key. A weekly goal whose week runs from its start day (e.g. Wed-Tue) has key Wed 4 Nov; the week report for 2-8 Nov is built on Mon 9 Nov, before that period ends (Tue 10), so it has no outcome yet, and the 9-15 Nov report skips the key because 4 Nov is outside it: that period is never reported. A Money goal's month follows Money's month start (periodOf uses KOS.money.periodRange), so a payday month starting the 25th has the same gap in month reports. Read from code; not reproduced in a saved report.
evidence: js/core/report.js:698-711 (day = period key, kept only if p.start<=day<=p.end); js/core/goals.js:63-81 (weekFrom 'start' keys, money periods)
fix: Attribute an outcome to the report whose range holds the period's END (or the judgement date at), so every period lands exactly once after it has been judged.
rootCause: outcome keyed by start, report built when the period may still be open

title: A stay-under goal breached early never sends its 'Goal missed' notice
detail: tick() only pushes ':missed' while now - failedAt < 2 days (NEWS_MS). A stay-under goal (spend below, no overdue) is marked failed the day it goes over, but notices() only emits ':missed' once the deadline has passed; by then failedAt is usually more than two days old, so the notice is dropped and the month-end miss is silent. Similarly, a goal restarted after completion reuses the id 'goal:<id>:done', so its second completion is deduped by the ledger within 45 days.
evidence: js/core/goals.js:818-820 (missed only after deadline), 864-873 (at = failedAt, dropped when older than NEWS_MS); fx5 shows failedAt set on creation day for no-overdue
fix: Use the deadline (or max(failedAt, deadline)) as the news time for ':missed'; key ':done' by completedAt day or the restart's startDate.
rootCause: news window measured from the status change, not from the event the notice reports

title: iPhone: Domain filter pills overflow the screen edge as an undeclared, scrollbar-less scroller
detail: The Domain pills (All 13, Study 5, Productivity 1, Money 1, Code 1, Collection 4, Governor 1) run past the 402px viewport (pills at right=422, 522, 619) with overflow-x:auto and scrollbar-width:none on a plain div, so 'Code' is cut at the edge and nothing says the row scrolls. Invariant 50 asks for KOS.ui.scroller (edge cues, keyboard). Also: on mac these pills are 29px tall (<32) and counts print 'All13' to a screen reader.
evidence: shots/goals/dense-all-iphone.png; eval iphone over: k-gl-domain r=422/522/619; mac small: goal.domain 58x29; css/views/goals.css:235; js/modules/goals.js:358-363
fix: Wrap the pills in KOS.ui.scroller (or let them wrap to two lines on phone); raise pill height to 32px (44 on touch).

title: A custom manual goal is filed under Collection
detail: New goal offers 'Custom manual goal' as its own section, but the type registers with domain 'collection' (goals.js:548), so 'Read three papers on memory' wears the 蒐 Collection mark and pill, counts in the Collection domain filter and its action fallback is the Collection page.
evidence: shots/goals/dense-all-mac.png (card 'Read three papers on memory', pill 'Collection'); js/core/goals.js:548; js/modules/goals.js:711-712, 244
fix: Give manual goals their own 'Personal' domain (or let the user pick the domain in the editor) and a neutral mark.

title: 'Every week so far' history bars overflow and are cut off at the card edge on iPhone
detail: The history list (.k-gl-hist, 8 periods) is 728px wide in a 326px card; it scrolls horizontally with overflow:auto but is not a declared KOS.ui.scroller, has no edge cue, and the fourth bar ('2.5', '5') is sliced at the right edge.
evidence: shots/goals/detail-weekly-iphone.png; eval: hist width 326, scrollWidth 728, overflowX auto; js/modules/goals.js:613-636
fix: Use KOS.ui.scroller with reveal of the open period (newest at the right), or compress the bars to fit (12 periods at 24px).

title: Spend-below goals are judged Met for months with no Money records at all
detail: A monthly 'Spend below £60' goal started 1 Sep on an account with no transactions shows two met periods (✓✓) and 'Under'. The measure returns 0 spent whenever the range has no rows, so months before Money was used, or when nothing was imported, count as kept; the 'Under budget' badge logic and Reports' periods met read the same outcomes. Invariant 76 asks for no claim without evidence. money-no-spend has the same flaw: every day without a recorded 'out' transaction counts as a no-spend day, so a user who does not log daily meets 'No-spend days' automatically (js/core/goals.js:700-710).
evidence: shots/goals/dense-all-ipad.png (card 'Eating out under £60', ✓✓ and 'Under'); js/core/goals.js:680-689 (no-rows -> 0); closePeriods writes met:true
fix: Treat a period with no transactions (or before the first one) as 'no evidence' (current null) so it is not judged; say 'No spending recorded' instead.

title: Hero's 'behind / on track / met this week' counts every open goal, not this week's
detail: On This week (filter shows All 3) the hero says '4 behind this week · 4 on track this week · 1 met this week', i.e. nine goals, including goals that end in December and display-only ones. hero(lead, open) is passed every open goal instead of the tab's goals, so the counts disagree with the page they sit on and change nothing when the tab or domain filter changes.
evidence: shots/goals/week-mac.png (All 3 vs 4/4/1); js/modules/goals.js:322 (hero(lead, open)), 388 (counts over open)
fix: Pass the tab's goals (shown) and label the counts by tab ('this week' / 'this month' / 'open'); skip display-only goals.

title: Home's Goals card: an unlabeled number in each ring and doubled units ('5 blocks of 30 blocks')
detail: Each Home goal row shows a ring with a bare number (3, 3, 25) that is the days left while the ring's fill is the progress; the number is aria-hidden and nothing on screen says 'days'. The sub-line repeats the unit: '5 blocks of 30 blocks', '0 cards of 400 cards'.
evidence: shots/goals/home-goals-mac.png; eval (iphone) rows '3 / 10 hours of study a week / Behind / 1 h 6 m of 10 h · by 8 Nov', '25 / 400 cards this month / … 0 cards of 400 cards'; js/modules/hub.js:1414-1425
fix: Label the ring ('3d' / 'days left' under it) or put the percent in it; print the unit once ('5 of 30 blocks').

title: Phone search sheet files Goals under Collection
detail: The phone search sheet's domain chips map the 'goals' result group to 'Collection' (SEARCH_SECTION.goals), though Goals is a Productivity page (rail and section strip) since roadmap 5.4; searching a study goal and tapping 'Productivity' hides it.
evidence: js/modules/hub.js:3592-3593
fix: Map goals to 'Productivity'.

title: Met and missed goals stay pinned to the Morning Review and Home, using up the three pin slots
detail: pin() refuses only archived goals, and nothing unpins a goal when it is met or missed; KOS.today's goals() lists every pinned goal for the reviews. The goal page even offers 'Pin to the morning' on a Met goal. A finished goal therefore keeps one of the three slots until the user notices, and pinning a new goal fails with 'Three goals are pinned already.'
evidence: shots/goals/detail-collection-met-mac.png ('Met' chip beside 'Pin to the morning'); js/core/goals.js:215-225; js/core/today.js:169-178; js/modules/goals.js:541-546
fix: Exclude completed/failed goals from pinned() (keep the flag for history) and hide the Pin button on a finished goal; unpin on archive/complete.

title: Marks by question: a question added with '＋ Question' can't be given its Max or its topic
detail: On #/exams/attempt/<uid>/marks the ＋ Question button adds a row whose only controls are Got and Redo: Max prints '—' and Topic is an empty read-only span. Only questions filled from the past-paper index carry max/refs. For a school mock, class paper or any paper not in the index (the common case) there is no way to record the out-of, so 'full marks', 'untagged · n', the total check and the post-mortem can't work, and a Redo on such a question has no leaf to be scheduled on (invariant 124 says a redo item is due on its question's leaf). Reproduced: clicking ＋ Question gave a row with inputs ['Got, question Q5', 'Redo question Q5'] and text 'Q5 | / | — | Redo'. The Topic column is therefore empty for every hand-logged attempt (dead column).
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-addq-ipad.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-ipad.png; js/modules/examprac.js:410 addRow pushes {max:null, refs:[]}; :436-438 the row renders node title (read-only) and q.max as text; js/modules/tracker.js:192 questions only come from an index fill
fix: Make Max a small number input on rows without an index max, and the Topic cell a KOS.topicPicker button (scoped to the assessment's leaves) on every row; keep index-filled values as defaults.
rootCause: Marks page was built around index-filled questions; addRow never got editors for max/refs

title: Exam Room on iPhone: the 'Before you go in' checklist is drawn on top of the rapid-recall list
detail: At 402px the room's body (ring, plan, five recall facts, blacklist) is taller than the screen, but .k-exr-body is a shrinkable flex item with min-block-size 0 inside the fixed, scrolling .k-exr column. It is squeezed to the leftover height and its content overflows visibly, so the checklist chips ('Black pens', 'Candidate number', 'Phone off and away') sit over facts 3–5 and both are unreadable; the blacklist is pushed off below. This is the screen meant to be used minutes before an exam on the phone.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-room-iphone.png; css/views/exams.css:505 (.k-exr flex column, overflow-y auto) and :513 (.k-exr-body flex: 1 1 auto; min-block-size: 0); phone rules :933-937 don't change it
fix: Give .k-exr-body flex-shrink: 0 (or min-block-size: auto) so the room scrolls instead of overlapping; at phone width also consider putting the checklist right under the ring.

title: On iPhone the floating ink palette is 500px wide on a 402px screen: Undo and Redo are off-screen
detail: Under 700px the palette always floats in one row (the docked bar isn't offered). At 402px it measures 500px (x 20→520): grip 32, six tools at 44, the colour button still showing its text 'Ink · Mediu…' at 76, Undo and Redo at 44, plus gaps. The colour menu is cut and Undo/Redo are unreachable; dragging can't help because place() clamps x to max(20, W−w−20) = 20. Every pad, Handwritten tab, sketchbook and drill on the phone is affected.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-ink-iphone.png; eval at iphone: ink.palette rect [20,716,500,62], scrollWidth 500, buttons '32x32 44x48 ×6 76x50 44x48 44x48'; js/core/inkui.js:1146-1171 (six tools + colour + history), css/views/ink.css:201-203 ('icons' state hides tool labels only)

title: Timed paper: the question navigator's squares are crushed to 7px slivers on iPad and iPhone (17px on Mac)
detail: Start timed on any predicted/practice paper (#/exams/<id>/paper/1 > Start timed). The navigator holds one 30px square per question (51 here) in a flex row inside a scroller, but the squares are allowed to shrink, so instead of scrolling they are squeezed: 1-9 measure 7x44 on touch (the touch min-height makes them tall slivers with the digits overflowing into each other), 10+ 14x44; on Mac 17x30. The numbers are unreadable and the targets far below 44px wide, on the primary iPad flow for timed practice.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-timed-reload-ipadl.png, /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-timed-iphone.png; measured .k-ex-tnav-b: ipadl '1:7x44 … 10:14x44', iphone same, mac '17x30' (n=51); css/views/exams.css:741-742 (.k-ex-tnav display:flex; .k-ex-tnav-b inline-size var(--ex-tnav-b) with no flex-shrink:0); css/tokens.css:1229 (--ex-tnav-b 30px)

title: A transparent PNG pasted or dropped onto an ink page gets a black background
detail: readImage() in inkui.js draws every picture (paste, drop, Image… from the palette) onto a canvas and keeps it as toDataURL('image/jpeg'). JPEG has no alpha, so every transparent pixel becomes black: a diagram, a screenshot with transparency or a cut-out pasted onto a lined page shows a black box behind it on the paper.
evidence: js/core/inkui.js:1400-1413 (c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86) with no fill first); compare js/core/imagecrop.js:110-124 which keeps PNG/WebP or fills a background before JPEG
fix: Keep image/png when the source is PNG/WebP/GIF (or when the canvas has any alpha < 255), or fill the canvas white before drawImage when JPEG is chosen.
rootCause: Unconditional JPEG encoding of user pictures

title: Readiness band line on iPhone squeezes the sentence into a ~80px column, one word per line
detail: On #/exams/readiness at 402px the band chip and 'limiting: RAG' take the left of the bandline and the explanation ('SAMPLE — Mock exam (edit me) · Sat 7 Nov · 5 days. RAG is holding it at Not enough evidence.') is crushed into a narrow right column running nine lines, beside empty space under the chip; 'Plan the gap' drops to its own row.

title: Files list is one big aria-live region: every keystroke in search re-announces up to 300 cards
detail: The Files list container carries aria-live='polite' and paint() empties and refills it on every debounced search input, filter change and index event, so VoiceOver reads out the whole result list (names, kinds, sizes, links) after each letter typed.

detail: The ten 'Why marks went' tags are the main input of this page and sit in a dense 24px-tall wrap; the Got number field is 64x28. On the iPad (the device used for marking with a paper beside it) these are below the 44px touch minimum (invariant 69) and easy to mis-hit (adjacent chips 4px apart).

'The plan: About 1.5 min a mark…' under the ring and 'Leave the Exam Room' are similarly faint on iPad and Mac.

title: Timed paper with Rest breaks off: Pause hides the clock as 'Paused' while the paper's time keeps running, and time-up never fires while paused
detail: With Exams settings > Rest breaks off (the default), Pause logs a pause and the paper's clock keeps running (used() = now - started), but the clock text changes to 'Paused' so the remaining time disappears, and tick() skips the time-up check while s.paused. A learner can sit 'paused' past the end of the paper; on Resume the tally opens at once as 'Time is up'. Either the clock should keep counting visibly ('Paused · 1:12:04 left, the clock keeps running') or time-up should fire.
