title: Start-by is too strict: a one-topic test 3 days away needing 30 minutes is born 'Start-by passed · 7 days ago' and lands in Needs attention
detail: KOS.exams.startBy rounds the run-up up to whole weeks (weeks = ceil(hoursNeeded / share)) and then adds the tier's buffer, so any non-zero need costs at least 7 days + buffer. Fixture (empty account, scope = the single leaf compsci:4.10.1): topic test in 3 days → start-by 30 Oct (passed; 0.5 h needed at 2.3 h/week); retrieval quiz in 2 days → 31 Oct (passed; 0.2 h); mock in 10 days → 2 Nov (passed; 0.6 h). Only a real exam 30 days out is not already late. The red '▼ Start-by passed · N days ago' chip and the Needs attention card therefore greet almost every short-notice assessment the moment it is created (the Calendar's sample mock shows '58 days ago' on a brand-new account), which trains the learner to ignore the alarm; the plan says start-by is advisory.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-timetable-dawn-ipad.png; eval fixture {topic_test:{days:3,startBy:'2026-10-30',passed:true,why:'3 days of buffer + 0.5 h at about 2.3 h a week'}, retrieval_test:{days:2,passed:true}, mock:{days:10,passed:true}}; js/core/exams.js:543-544 (Math.ceil to weeks, then + buffer), :549 (passed); js/modules/exams.js:110, :458
fix: Compute the run-up in days (hoursNeeded / (share/7)), never put start-by before the assessment's creation date, and say 'Start now · 30 min needed' instead of 'passed' when the need still fits before the date.
rootCause: week-granular ceiling plus fixed buffer, and no floor at the creation date

title: Exam Room's keep-awake is lost after the iPad is switched away and back
detail: The Exam Room requests a screen wake lock once on render. The browser releases a wake lock whenever the page is hidden (app switch, Control Centre, a notification opened); nothing re-requests it on visibilitychange, so after one switch the screen dims and locks during the countdown. KOS.desk (Focus) handles this by re-syncing on visibilitychange.

fix: Reuse KOS.desk's wake-lock helper, or listen for visibilitychange while the room is connected and re-request.

title: '+1' on a card deep in the grid re-sorts it to the top under the default 'recently updated' sort, so it vanishes from under the pointer
detail: Anime vault, default sort 'Sort: recently updated', 240 cards loaded and scrolled ~10,600 px: pressing +1 on a card re-renders the grid and the card moves to position 1 (its top goes from on-screen to -9,892 px); the user sees the card they just logged disappear and a different card under the finger, with only the Governor toast as feedback. Logging several episodes in a row means hunting for the title again each time. Same in Books (+1 ch) and Games (+1 hr).
evidence: eval on slot 17: n0 240 / n1 240 cards, scrollTop 10667 unchanged, bumped card top 0 -> -9891.8, first titles after bump ['Collection entry 457','QA XML Show']; js/modules/anime.js:281 (onBump -> bumpProgress(e, rerender)); js/modules/medview.js:576-600 (bumpUnit saves and calls done -> full rerender)
fix: After a bump update the card in place (re-render that card only, keep the list order until the next deliberate refresh/navigation), or pin the bumped card in place for the visit; announce the new count through KOS.a11y.announce.
rootCause: bumpUnit re-queries and repaints the whole sorted grid; the sort key (updatedAt) is the field the bump changes.

title: Deleting a vault entry has no undo and leaves its Wishlist purchase pointing at nothing ('⇄ Collection' still offered, then 'That collection entry no longer exists.')
detail: Games › open 'Wishlist title 3' (created by Mark purchased) › Delete record › Delete: the toast says 'Deleted.' with no Undo, and the confirm does not mention that a Wishlist purchase links to it. The Wishlist's Purchased row keeps linkedEntryId 1881 and still shows the '⇄ Collection' button; pressing it only toasts 'That collection entry no longer exists.' — a dead button with no way to relink from there. All of a title's personal layer (notes, quotes, routes, physical volumes) is lost in one tap.
evidence: eval on slot 17: confirm text 'Delete “Wishlist title 3” from the collection?', toast 'Deleted.', no toast action; state.wishlist.items[id 3].linkedEntryId 1881 after deletion; Purchased tab row text '… GBP 10.00 ⇄ Collection'; click -> toast 'That collection entry no longer exists.'; js/modules/medview.js (record section Delete), js/modules/wishlist.js ('That collection entry no longer exists.')
fix: Offer Undo on the delete toast (re-put the row with its syncId and drop the tombstone), mention linked Wishlist items in the confirm, and on delete clear linkedEntryId (or render the row's link as 'Link to vault' when the entry is gone).
rootCause: Vault delete knows nothing about the Wishlist's linkedEntryId; Wishlist renders the link from the stored id without checking it exists.

title: iPad landscape (1180): the vault toolbar overflows leftwards over the title count; search squeezed to 112px ('Search bc')
devices: iPad Air 11 landscape (1180x820); any width 1081-~1300 with the rail open
detail: In every vault at 1180 px the toolbar's fixed controls (sort, Filters, layout, Actions, Find new/Add) plus the search's 7rem minimum are wider than the space beside the count. Because .k-mtoolbar is justify-content:flex-end with min-inline-size:0 and its children flex-shrink:0, the overflow spills to the LEFT and the search pill is painted over the count: '739 series' shows as '73', the search placeholder is cut to 'Search bc'.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-ipadl.png; eval at ipadl: count 448-507 vs search 461-573 (Books), 448-503 vs 461-573 (Anime), 448-504 vs 499-611 (Games), 448-534 vs 451-563 (VN)
fix: Let the toolbar wrap (flex-wrap: wrap with the search taking a full row) or move the count onto its own line from the 1240 breakpoint; never use flex-end on a row that can overflow (use margin-inline-start:auto on the first item instead so overflow goes right and wraps).
rootCause: css/views/collection.css:62-65 (flex-end + no-shrink children + min 7rem search); the wrap rule at 975 only starts at 860px.

title: Find new (Anime/Books) without AniList connected lets you search and pick, then toasts a self-contradicting message: 'added locally only. Nothing was added'
detail: Anime › Actions › Find new titles… searches AniList fine while signed out of AniList; choosing a status ('Plan to watch') then toasts 'AniList isn't connected — added locally only. Nothing was added — the vault mirrors your AniList list, so add it there or reconnect and retry.' The first sentence (from the shared VNDB/AniList connect check) says it was added, the second that it was not; nothing is added (invariant 92). The dialog never says up front that AniList must be connected, so the user does the whole flow before finding out.
evidence: eval on slot 17: search 'Frieren' → 6 results; + Add → 'Plan to watch' → toast text as quoted, no new row; js/modules/mediasearch.js:93 ("added locally only" reason) concatenated with :139 ("Nothing was added…")
fix: Give the AniList path its own reason ('AniList isn't connected.') and, better, show a 'Connect AniList to add titles' banner with a Sync & Import link in the Find new dialog when there is no token, disabling + Add.
rootCause: Reason string written for the VN fallback (which does add locally) reused for the mirror path that refuses.

title: No link out to the title's AniList/VNDB page, and nowhere to keep 'where I watch/read it' (QoL)
detail: The editor shows 'Linked to AniList' and knows anilistId/malId/vndbId, but only Games has an outbound link ('View on Steam ↗', games.js:333). Anime/Books/VN have no 'Open on AniList/VNDB' and no personal 'Where I'm watching/reading' URL. Proposal for the watch link: a manual-layer field `links: [{label, url}]` (or a single `watchUrl`) added in mediadb.normalise (js/core/mediadb.js:542, sanitised to http(s) only, no index so no DB version bump — like physical.seriesTotal), preserved in merge() beside notes/tags (mediadb.js ~1062: `inc.links = old.links.length ? old.links : inc.links`), unioned in foldLocal (mediadb.js:934) and covered by materialJSON automatically; never pushed (invariant 13 payloads stay status/progress/score) and excluded from search (71). UI: an input on 'Your layer' with a 'Use clipboard' helper; a '▶ Watch' / '📖 Read' button beside '+1 ep' on the card hover row, the Spotlight hero and the editor header, opening in a new tab (rel=noopener). The provider page link (AniList/VNDB) can be derived from the ids and shown on the Record tab.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-layer-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-record-mac.png; grep: only js/modules/games.js:57,333 build an outbound title URL
fix: Add the field to normalise/merge/foldLocal as above, a URL input in the shared editor's personal layer (KOS.mediaEditors), and a Watch/Read action in medview's card and hero.

title: Favourite heart on vault cards is a generic 'Toggle favourite' with no visible label and an easy mis-tap
detail: The heart button on every card is labelled 'Toggle favourite' (aria-pressed is set, good) but sits at the card's top-right where a tap meant to open the card toggles the favourite instantly with no toast/undo; a Shrine membership changes silently. Measured 34x34 (below 44 on touch).
evidence: eval: card button aria-label 'Toggle favourite', aria-pressed 'false', 34x34; reproduced an accidental favourite by clicking the card's first button
fix: Label as 'Favourite <title>' / 'Remove <title> from favourites', show a toast with Undo ('Added to the Shrine'), and give it 44px on coarse pointers.

title: Spotlight says 'the last one is next' when every route/episode is already done
detail: A VN in progress at 2/2 routes reads '2 routes in — the last one is next.' The branch fires when left === 0, i.e. nothing is left; 'the last one is next' describes left === 1. Same for an anime/book at its final episode/chapter count.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-vn-mac.png (hero: '2 routes in — the last one is next.', chip 2 / 2 routes)
fix: left === 0 → 'All N in — ready to mark it complete?' (offer a Complete action); left === 1 → 'the last one is next.'
rootCause: js/modules/medview.js:1318

title: Seasonal hero's art credit is unreadable on the painted scenery (Mac/iPad)
detail: The credit 'art · kamo_nasus' is 11.5px muted grey (oklch 0.62) laid straight over bright foliage with no scrim, jammed against the Art menu button; at 1x it is close to invisible (on iPhone it sits on a darker patch and reads). The credit is a licensing obligation for hot-linked scenery (invariant 94).
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-seasonal-credit-zoom.png; eval: anime.season-credit 90x17 at 1269,300, colour oklch(0.62 0.012 265), next to Art button at 1369
fix: Put the credit on the same dark pill as the Art button (or a local gradient scrim) and use --text-2 colour; keep 8px from the button.

title: Seasonal controls on iPhone wrap into a ragged block (segmented control alone, right-aligned)
detail: Season select and year field share row 1 (year field stops at 279 leaving 107px empty), the In progress/Everything switch sits alone right-aligned on row 2 with the left half empty, then Refresh airing/Anime vault on row 3. Three rows of controls and a dead half-row before the first title.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-seasonal2-iphone.png
fix: Under 560px make season+year one row at full width and the In progress/Everything switch full width (k-seg--grid) on the next, or move Refresh airing/Anime vault into the page's ⋯ menu.

title: AniList profile action row wraps 'Avatar' onto its own line on iPhone
detail: At 402px the row 'Refresh · Updated hh:mm:ss · Banner · Avatar' wraps so '✎ Avatar' sits alone on a second line at the left, under Refresh, ragged against 'Banner' at the right.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-aniprofile-analytics-iphone.png; js/modules/aniprofile.js:133-140 (actionRow)
fix: Group Banner and Avatar in one nowrap cluster (or a ⋯ menu) so they wrap together; or drop the 'Updated' time to the second line on phones.
rootCause: flex-wrap row with independent children

title: Want to buy rows label the purchase action 'Purchased' (reads as a status) while the hero and dialog say 'Mark purchased'
detail: Each queue row's action button says 'Purchased', beside a 'Link to vault' text and a ✎; it reads as the row's state, not an action. The hero button and the dialog title/confirm say 'Mark purchased'.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-wishlist-dawn-mac.png (row right edge); js/modules/wishlist.js:1019-1022
fix: Label it 'Mark purchased' (or 'Bought…') like the hero.
rootCause: label drift

title: Books card prints '0 ch' for a series read by the volume; long-form progress says '1 of 1 routes' / '1 hours'
detail: Books overrides the shared progress grammar with its own progressText that falls back to the literal '0 ch' whenever the shared text is empty, so a light novel tracked by volumes reads '0 ch · 3 / 10 vol' (a zero-only supporting fact, invariant 77). Separately the shared long form always pluralises: a VN with one route cleared of one reads '1 of 1 routes', one hour reads '1 hours'.
evidence: eval on slot 17: card text for fixture {books, progress {current 0, volumes 3, totalVolumes 10}} = 'QA Volume Novel | 0 ch · 3 / 10 vol'; KOS.media.progressText(vn 1/1 route,{long:true}) = '1 of 1 routes'; js/modules/books.js:195-201 (|| "0 ch"); js/core/media.js:489 (opts.long ignores the count); shots/collection/c4-books-volnovel-mac.png
fix: Drop the '0 ch' fallback (show only the volume half when chapters are 0) and move the volume half into KOS.media.progressText so Books stops keeping a second grammar; in the long form pick singular when the count is 1.
rootCause: Second progress formatter in books.js duplicating media.js (invariant 63 owner); LONG_UNIT has no singular.

title: Editor header shows the browser's broken-image glyph when a cover URL fails (cards fall back to the kanji placeholder)
detail: Open any vault entry whose coverUrl no longer loads (a hot-linked AniList/VNDB cover that moved, or a dead URL): the card shows the placeholder kanji because medview.cover() listens for 'error', but the editor's header art is a bare KOS.imageCrop.image with no error handler, so an empty grey tile with the broken-image icon in its corner is drawn.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-vn-editor-mac.png (top-left of the cover tile); eval: dialog img naturalWidth 0, display block; js/modules/medview.js:918-920 vs the card's handler at js/modules/medview.js:64-71
fix: Reuse medview.cover() (or the same load/error settle) for the editor header so a failed cover falls back to the module kanji.
rootCause: Two cover renderers; only the card one handles load errors.

title: VN 'What counts as progress' offers no Percentage option, so the % mode the schema and editor support is unreachable for new titles
detail: mediadb's VN_MODES include 'percent' and the editor builds a 'How far through (%)' field, but the radio list only offers Automatic / Routes / Chapters / Hours, and the % field is shown only when Automatic already resolves to percent (an old entry carrying progressPercent and nothing else). A new VN, or one that has any hours, can never be switched to a percentage, contradicting the comment above the control ('routes, chapters, or a percentage').
evidence: js/modules/vn.js:261-273 (radio options, no percent), 317 (pctField.hidden unless src/mode is percent); js/core/mediadb.js:323 (VN_MODES includes percent); shots/collection/c4-vn-editor-mac.png (four options)
fix: Add a 'Percentage through' radio (value percent) and show the % field whenever it is chosen; or retire percent from VN_MODES with a migration.
rootCause: Radio list (11e) dropped the percent choice while the schema kept it.

title: Score lives in a different place in each vault editor: Books puts an unlabelled '– / 10' box in the header, the others a 'Score /10' field that shows 0 when unscored
detail: Books' editor carries the score as a small unlabelled number input beside Favourite in the header (placeholder '–'); Anime, VN and Games put 'Score /10' in the first tab's grid, and VN/Games print '0' for a title with no score while the card corner shows '★' (unscored). Same concept, three treatments, and an unscored title reads as scored 0.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-phys-mac.png (header '– / 10'), c4-vn-editor-mac.png and c4-game-editor-mac.png ('Score /10' field = 0 / 2); eval: VN entry with no score -> editor score input value '0'; Books header input aria-label 'Score out of 10', data-ui vault.editor-score
fix: Use one score control in the same place for every module (the header pattern with a visible label, or the field) and show an empty value/placeholder for unscored instead of 0.
rootCause: Each module editor builds its own score control (books.js header vs vn.js/games.js/anime.js fields).

title: Import and sync reports count every matched row as 'updated', even when nothing changed
detail: Re-importing the same MAL XML (or any pull) reports 'N updated' for every matched row: bulkUpsert increments `updated` on every put, including the no-op merges whose updatedAt it deliberately keeps (invariant 36a). A user re-running an import or 'Sync now' sees e.g. '0 added, 1100 updated' and cannot tell whether anything moved.
evidence: eval on slot 17: bulkUpsert of an unchanged XML row -> {added 0, updated 1}, updatedAt unchanged 1793940090274, journal 0; js/core/mediadb.js:1166-1170 (updated++ regardless of sameMaterial); js/modules/mediasync.js:55-59 (doneWording prints it)
fix: Count `unchanged` separately when sameMaterial() holds and word the result '3 updated, 1,097 already up to date' (or skip the put entirely for an unchanged row).
rootCause: Counter not tied to the sameMaterial branch.

title: Autonomous sync card says 'On' and runs cycles with no provider connected, and prints the last cycle twice
detail: On an account with neither AniList nor VNDB connected the Autonomous sync card shows the switch On, 'Pulls every 15 minutes and on reconnect', a status line 'Last cycle 06/11/2026, 04:40:22 — nothing to reconcile' AND a separate 'Last cycle 04:40' figure beside it (two lines on iPhone). Nothing is being synced, so the card should say so and point to Connect; the time should appear once. The AniList token placeholder is also cut off ('The token AniList showe') at Mac width.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-sync-mac.png, shots/collection/c4-sync-iphone.png; js/modules/mediasync.js:422 (status line) and 432 (k-sy-auto-last duplicate)
fix: When no provider is connected render the card as 'Nothing to sync yet — connect AniList or VNDB' with the switch disabled; keep one 'Last cycle' (the right-hand figure) and drop it from the status sentence; shorten the placeholder to 'Access token'.
rootCause: renderAuto() ignores connection state; two renderers of the same timestamp.

title: XML-imported Anime rows can never be deleted without AniList, and a Completed show with no episode total still offers '+1 · Log episode 31'
detail: A MAL/AniList XML import lands anime rows with syncSource 'import'. The Anime editor follows the AniList-mirror rule (invariant 92: no Delete), so with AniList not connected a wrongly imported row has no way out except a 'Replace' re-import. In the same editor, a Completed title whose total is unknown (AniList total 0) still shows the primary '+1 · Log episode 31' bump, because the cap only applies when max is known.
evidence: eval on slot 17 after importing a 3-title XML fixture: editor buttons for 'QA XML & Done' = ['+1 · Log episode 31','♥ Favourite',…,'Cancel','Save'] (no Delete, Record tab read-only); js/modules/medview.js:943-947 (capped only with b.max); mirror rule js/modules/anime.js editorModal
fix: Offer Delete for anime rows whose syncSource is not 'anilist' (they are outside the mirror); hide or demote the bump when status is Completed.
rootCause: Mirror read-only rule keyed on module rather than on syncSource; bump ignores status.

title: Bar charts clip the value label of the tallest bar (Score distribution '168', medium charts '222')
detail: KOS.charts.barChart reserves only padT = 12 above the plot and draws each value label at y - 5, so the tallest bar's label starts above the SVG's top edge (bbox y -3.8) and the SVG clips it; the tallest bars' labels look cut and crowd the card header (Books '222' under 'Books 1108 titles'). Every barChart and smallMultiples user (Collection Analytics, Reports, Money) inherits it.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-matrix-analytics-mac.png (Score distribution '168' labels; Books small multiple); eval: getBBox of the '168' label y = -3.79, svg overflow hidden; js/core/charts.js:84 (padT 12), 122-124 (label at y - 5)
fix: Raise padT to FONT + 8 when value labels are drawn (or compute the plot from max + label height) so the tallest label sits inside the viewBox.
rootCause: Top padding does not account for the value label above a full-height bar.

title: Wishlist 'Purchased' tab is still laid out as a buy queue: priority ranks #1–#8, 'AVAILABLE NOW' / 'PRE-ORDER · IN 30 DAYS', sorted by priority
detail: Purchase history reuses the Want-to-buy row: every bought item keeps a Priority badge (#1…#8), the Release column still says 'AVAILABLE NOW' or 'PRE-ORDER · IN 45 DAYS' for things already bought, and the default sort is 'Priority order', while the purchase date is shrunk to a 'bought 2026-11' chip (month only). The questions a history answers (when, how much, in which vault) are de-emphasised; a wide empty gap sits between the Collection column and the ✎ button.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-wishlist-purchased-mac.png; js/modules/wishlist.js:1015 (bought chip = monthKey), row builder ~990-1025 shared across tabs
fix: On the Purchased tab drop the priority column and release countdown, show the full purchase date and paid amount as the leading facts and sort by purchasedAt (newest first).
rootCause: One row renderer for every tab.

title: Renaming or deleting a custom list that came from AniList is undone by the next pull (and a rename leaves both names)
detail: Manage custom lists offers Rename/Delete for every list, including Anime/Books lists that AniList owns. rewriteLists only rewrites local rows and the kv registry and pushes nothing (list membership is never pushed, invariant 13). On the next AniList pull, bulkUpsert treats every list name AniList passes as AniList-owned (mirrorOpts lists) and re-adds the original membership, while the renamed name is now 'only this app' and unions — so a rename yields two lists and a delete comes back. The dialog gives no hint that the list belongs to AniList.
evidence: code read: js/core/media.js:434-456 (rewriteLists, local only), js/modules/medview.js:1755-1770 (Rename/Delete for every name), js/core/mediadb.js:1089-1093 (owned AniList list names re-applied from the pull, others unioned); not reproduced end-to-end (no AniList account in the harness)
fix: Mark lists that AniList carries (the mirror's list names, kept per module) as read-only in Manage ('Rename it on AniList'), and only offer Rename/Delete for app-only lists.
rootCause: Manage lists does not know which list names the AniList mirror owns.

title: Quote → flashcard writes the card at once while the quote itself waits for the editor's Save; Cancel keeps a card for a quote that no longer exists
detail: In any vault editor's Quote log, a newly logged quote lives only in the editor draft (comment: 'The draft's quotes change only when the editor saves'), but '⇢ flashcard' › '+ Add to Personal deck' calls KOS.srs.addCustom immediately. Pressing Cancel (or Back) discards the quote and keeps the card. The success toast also tells the user to go 'Due Today → Personal deck' instead of offering that route as a toast action.
evidence: js/modules/medview.js:722-746 (addCustom on press), 789-793 (quote pushed to the draft e.quotes, saved only with the editor)
fix: Either save the quote together with the card (put the row when the card is made), or queue the card until the editor saves; add a 'Open Personal deck' action on the toast.
rootCause: Two write timings inside one editor.

title: Books 'Owned vs read' bars have no visible track (track colour = box colour) and the two 'one scale' bars get different lengths
detail: In the Physical vault tab the bar track and the k-bk-box behind it are the same colour (both oklch(0.93 0.01 80) in Dawn), so each bar reads as a floating stub with no scale; on iPhone the two bars are 111 px and 103 px long because the track sits in an auto grid column sized by the detail text, so '1 of 10' and '3 of 10' are not drawn on the same scale the code comment promises.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-iphone.png; eval (Dawn): bar bg oklch(0.93 0.01 80) == .k-bk-compare.k-bk-box bg; bar widths iPhone [111,103], Mac [373,365]; js/modules/books.js:300-312
fix: Give the k-bar track a token one step off the box (e.g. --s3/--line) inside .k-bk-box, and lay the rows out on a shared grid (label | 1fr bar | fixed-width detail) so both tracks are equal.
rootCause: Box and track share the same surface token; the detail column is auto-sized per row.

title: Vault editor's section tabs overflow on iPhone with no scroller affordance: 'Quote lo…' cut, 'Identity' off-screen
detail: The editor's tab row (Reading state · Physical vault · Shelves & tags · Quote log · Identity for Books; VN has six) is a plain overflow-x:auto segmented control (scrollWidth 438 > 362). The last tab is clipped mid-word and nothing indicates more tabs; it is not a declared KOS.ui.scroller (invariant 50: horizontal overflow must be declared, with edge marks).
evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-iphone.png; eval iPhone: tablist .k-seg.k-medit-tabs scrollWidth 438 / clientWidth 362, overflow-x auto, no ui.scroller ancestor; tab right edges 104/208/316/393/458
fix: Wrap the tab row in KOS.ui.scroller({keep, reveal}) so the active tab is revealed and the edge fade shows more, or shorten labels ('Shelf', 'Tags', 'Quotes') under 560px.
rootCause: Editor tabs built as a bare k-seg instead of the shared scroller.

title: Games copy contradicts itself about importing, and the Steam dialog signed out is a dead end with no button to sign in
detail: The Games empty state says 'There's no import API a browser is allowed to use; this is the whole toolkit, honestly stated' and Bulk add's subtitle says 'no game API allows a browser import' — yet the same Actions menu offers 'Steam library… import what you own' and 'Find new titles… Search IGDB'. Signed out of cloud, 'Steam library…' opens a dialog whose only content is 'sign in from Archive → Account & Cloud Sync first' with no button to get there (only ✕).
evidence: shots/collection/c4-steam-mac.png; js/modules/games.js:746 (empty-state copy), 479 (bulk add subtitle), 547-624 (Steam dialog)
fix: Rewrite the empty state and bulk-add subtitle to name the three ways in (paste, IGDB search, Steam import); add an 'Open Account & Cloud Sync' primary button in the signed-out Steam dialog.
rootCause: Copy predates the Steam/IGDB features.

title: Dialogs opened from a vault's Actions menu return focus to the top of the page ('Skip to content') when closed
detail: Games › Actions › The numbers (or Steam library…, Paste a list…) › Close: focus lands on the document's first element, 'Skip to content', instead of the Actions button, because the dialog records the menu item as its return target and the menu has been torn down by then. A keyboard or VoiceOver user is thrown to the top of a long page after every Actions dialog (invariant 49: focus restore).
evidence: eval on slot 17 after closing 'Games — the numbers': document.activeElement text 'Skip to content', Actions aria-expanded 'false'; shots/collection/c4-numbers-mac.png
fix: In KOS.ui.menu, when an item runs, hand openDialog the menu's trigger as the restore target (or restore to the trigger when the remembered element is disconnected).
rootCause: openDialog restores to document.activeElement captured at open time — a menu item that is removed when the menu closes.

title: 'Genres' charts list tags truncated to identical labels ('Protagonist with a Tra…' ×7)
detail: The Games numbers dialog's 'Genres — where your taste actually lives' and the Overview Analytics 'Top genres' rank tags as well as genres and cut every label at ~24 characters, so several distinct long tags render as the same 'Protagonist with a Tra…' row distinguishable only by a hover title (none on iPad/iPhone touch). VNDB/AniList tags are routinely that long.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-numbers-mac.png (7 identical rows), shots/collection/c4-matrix-analytics-mac.png ('Protagonist with a Tra…'); js/core/charts.js:187 (row title on hover only; label cut by CSS ellipsis)
fix: Wrap hbar labels to two lines (wrapLabel already exists) or widen the label column, add a <title> with the full name, and either rename the card 'Genres & tags' or keep genres only.
rootCause: hbarChart truncates instead of wrapping; card mixes taxonomy fields.

title: An empty vault still draws the full status rail of zeros and every toolbar control (sort, Filters, layout, search) around the empty state
detail: Empty account, Games/Books/VN: the left rail lists All 0, In progress 0, Planned 0, On hold 0, Completed 0, Dropped 0 (zero-only supporting facts, invariant 77), and the toolbar offers '0 games', search, 'Sort: recently updated', Filters, grid/list and Actions over nothing. Books also shows 'Find new' twice (toolbar and empty state), and Find new cannot add anything until AniList is connected.
evidence: shots/collection/c4-empty-game-mac.png, c4-empty-books-mac.png, c4-empty-vn-mac.png; js/modules/medview.js:1660-1675 (rail rows always drawn), games.js:739-749
fix: While the vault has no rows hide the status counts (or the whole rail) and the sort/filter/layout controls, leaving the empty state's actions; in Books show one 'Sync & Import' primary and drop the duplicate Find new until AniList is connected.
rootCause: Toolbar and rail are rendered before the count is known and never collapse for zero.

title: 'Undoable' Assistant actions cannot be undone: the undo each tool returns is collected and never offered
detail: Permissions labels every reversible tool 'Undoable action' / 'Default · runs, undoable', and the Assistant runs them without asking on that promise. Each such tool hands back an undo ({label, run}); the orchestrator pushes it into req.undos and lastUndos, but no UI ever reads KOS.ai.orchestrator.lastUndos(): the 'Verified action complete' card has only text (no Undo), no toast offers one, and Activity is read-only. Reproduced with a stubbed Ollama returning todo_add_task: the reminder 'Revise BFS and DFS' was created, the card shows 'Add task / done / Target · #1 / todo_add_task' and the thread's only button is Copy. The only way back is to find and delete the record by hand.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png; eval: buttons in .k-asst-thread = ['Copy'], state.reminders.items[0].title 'Revise BFS and DFS'. js/core/aitools.js:1919-1920 (undo returned); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:754 (req.undos.push), :451, :1046 (lastUndos exposed); grep finds no caller of lastUndos/undos outside aiorchestrator.js; js/modules/assistant.js:2518 ('runs, undoable')
fix: Render an Undo button on each verified-action card (and a toast with Undo, as Day Review does) wired to that call's undo.run, marking the card and the audit row 'Undone'. Keep it available until the conversation changes.
rootCause: Undo plumbing finished in the orchestrator but the presentation half was never built

title: Reopened chat starts at the oldest message, and from then on new replies and approval cards land off-screen
detail: The thread only follows the tail when it was already within 60px of the bottom. On first render the scroller is still detached, so render() sets scrollTop on a 0-height box and, once mounted, the thread shows the TOP of the conversation. Every later render measures 'not at bottom' and keeps scrollTop 0: the user's own sent message, Kurenai's reply and the 'Confirm & run / Decline' approval card all appear below the fold while the side panel says 'Waiting for your approval'. Reproduced: leave the Assistant and return (thread scrollTop 0 of 1110, client 617), send a message → scrollTop still 0, scrollHeight 1268; the approval card for todo_delete_task was in the DOM but not visible.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-approval-mac.png (approval pending, card not visible, thread at top); eval {reopen:{st:0,sh:1110,ch:617}, after send:{st:0,sh:1268}}. js/modules/assistant.js:1615-1623 (atBottom measured before the scroller is in the document; no scroll on own send or on a pending card)
fix: Scroll to the end after the first mount (requestAnimationFrame after insertion) and always when the user sends or a confirmation card appears; keep the 'only if at bottom' rule only for streamed additions, and show a 'New message ↓' pill when not following.
rootCause: atBottom computed on a detached node; no explicit scroll on send/approval

title: Composer hint 'Shift + Enter for a new line' floats mid-height while the send button sits at the bottom
detail: The composer row is align-items:flex-end (send docks to the bottom edge) but the hint is align-self:center. With one line the three items already sit on three different centres (placeholder line ~759, hint 769, send 780 in a 60px textarea); as the textarea grows the hint drifts into the middle of the right side, detached from both the text and the send button. It is also shown on iPad (touch, often no hardware keyboard), where Shift+Enter means nothing.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/composer-multiline-crop.png (5 lines: hint y=729, send y=760..800, textarea 675..800); chat-mac.png; chat-ipad.png shows the hint on touch. css/views/assistant.css:214 (.k-asst-composer align-items:flex-end), :220 (.k-asst-hint align-self:center); js/modules/assistant.js:913 (hint omitted only when compact)
fix: Give the hint align-self:flex-end with a margin-block-end that puts its centre on the send button's centre (or move it under the box as a small caption, left of the send). Hide it under (pointer:coarse) / when no hover, not only in compact mode.
rootCause: .k-asst-hint align-self:center inside a flex-end row

title: Opening a Morning/Evening review notification lands on Routines Today and never opens the review
detail: The review notice is pushed with view 'routines' and arg {review: slot}. KOS.notify.open() calls KOS.show('routines', {review:'morning'}), but KOS.views.routines only reads arg.edit or a tab string, so the arg is dropped and the page shows Routines › Today. The review sheet does not open; the user has to find the header chip. The same item reaches the bell, the Notifications page and closed-app pushes (sw notificationclick → kos-open → KOS.show), so all three dead-end.
evidence: eval: clicking the 'Morning review' row on #/notifications → location.hash '#/routines', no dialog open. js/core/dayreview.js:713 (view:'routines', arg:{review:slot}); js/core/notify.js:196-199 (open); js/modules/routines.js:469-473 (arg.review never read); grep finds no reader of arg.review anywhere.
fix: In KOS.views.routines (or better, in notify.open for kind 'review') call KOS.reviewSheet.open(arg.review) after drawing Today, the way the header chip opens it.
rootCause: Producer and consumer of the notification's arg disagree; no handler for {review}

title: History's 'Open Account & Cloud Sync' button opens the Collection's Sync & Import page, which has no sign-in
detail: Assistant › History, signed out, shows 'History is kept after cloud sign-in' with a button 'Open Account & Cloud Sync'. It calls KOS.show('mediasync'), the Collection's Sync & Import page (AniList, VNDB, Games…), which has no email/password fields. The sign-in card lives on Archive › Backup & Restore (#/data). The user lands on the wrong page with no way forward.
evidence: js/modules/assistant.js:2075 onclick KOS.show("mediasync"); eval KOS.show('mediasync') → headings 'Sync & Import, AniList, VNDB, Games…', no input[type=email]; the sign-in form is on #/data (shots/assistant-archive/data-mac.png).
fix: KOS.show('data') and focus the account card's email field (one shared helper, e.g. KOS.cloudUI.openSignIn(), used by every 'sign in first' message).
rootCause: Hard-coded wrong view id

title: Every 'sign in first' message points to 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync', a page that does not exist, and offers no button
detail: The Assistant's failure card (signed out, the default Gemini route), Memory's empty state, cloud.js, gameapi.js and vndb.js all say 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync'. The Archive has no page of that name: the strip reads Backup & Restore, Help & Guide, Notifications, Files, Storage, Pen and ink, Connections; the card is a section inside Backup & Restore. Connections calls it 'Open Backup & cloud'. None of the Assistant's messages is a link. A first-time user who types a question gets 'Kurenai couldn't finish that' with directions to a page they cannot find, while the status pill still says 'Kurenai is with you' with a green dot.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-send-signedout-mac.png; shots/assistant-archive/memory-mac.png; js/core/ai.js:152,154; js/modules/assistant.js:2299; js/core/cloud.js:142-143; js/core/gameapi.js:23,25; js/core/vndb.js:112,281; js/core/ui.js:430-438 (Archive strip names)
fix: Name it as the UI does ('Archive › Backup & Restore › Account & Cloud Sync') and render an inline 'Sign in' action on the Assistant error card and the Memory/History empty states that opens #/data with the email field focused. Signed out with no Ollama model, show a one-line notice above the composer before the first send instead of failing after it.
rootCause: Navigation text duplicated in many string literals instead of one link helper; page renamed in review A

title: Activity (signed out) shows every action as 'Proposed … Started' forever, with no time
detail: Signed out, Activity reads the local audit queue but keeps only the 'insert' rows and drops every 'update' (executed/declined/failed), so an action that ran reads 'Proposed', 'todo_add_task · proposed' and '● Started' in one row. The queued rows have no created_at, so the 'when' column is an empty 100px gap at the row's left. The filters Ran / Declined / Failed never match anything signed out.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/activity-after-mac.png (after a todo_add_task that the chat reported complete). js/modules/assistant.js:2587-2590 (filter r.kind === 'insert'); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:232-250 (status changes are separate 'update' rows; the insert payload has no created_at)
fix: When reading the queue, fold each 'update' patch into its insert by id and use the queue entry's ts as created_at.
rootCause: Queue reader ignores update rows; insert payload lacks a timestamp

title: Assistant's side status card prints the full error as an uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow, cut off mid-word
detail: After a failed request the character panel's state label becomes 'FAILED: SIGN IN TO CLOUD SYNC FIRST (ARCHIVE → ACCOUNT & CLOUD SYNC) — THE ONLINE ASSIST…' in the 11px tracked uppercase eyebrow style across four lines and ellipsed. An eyebrow is for two-word labels; this is a sentence and is the same text the chat already shows in its error card.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-send-signedout-mac.png (bottom-right card); js/modules/assistant.js:724 setVisual('error', 'Failed: ' + clampText(p.message, 80))
fix: Set the label to a short state ('Couldn't finish') and leave the message in the thread.
rootCause: State label fed the provider error text

title: Verified-action card shows internals: raw tool id, 'done', and 'Target · #1'
detail: After a tool runs, the card reads 'VERIFIED ACTION COMPLETE / Add task / done / Target · #1 / todo_add_task'. 'done' is the raw status, '#1' an internal record id, and 'todo_add_task' the function name. The useful fact (the reminder's title 'Revise BFS and DFS', where it went) is missing, and there is no link to open the reminder.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png
fix: Show the human result ("Added 'Revise BFS and DFS' to Reminders") with an Open link to the record and Undo; keep the tool id for Activity only.
rootCause: Card renders the tool result envelope directly

title: No space between consecutive blocks in an Assistant reply (table runs straight into the code block)
detail: In a reply with a table followed by a fenced code block, the table's bottom edge and the code block's top edge touch (both margins 0px), so the two read as one box.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png; eval: table bottom 560.7 = codeblock top 560.7, margin-bottom/top 0px
fix: Give the message body a flow gap (e.g. .k-asst-msg-body > * + * { margin-block-start: var(--sp-10) }) instead of per-element margins.
rootCause: Rich blocks (.k-asst-table, .k-asst-codeblock) carry no block spacing

title: Todoist: a reminder made on one device is duplicated when another device syncs before the state document arrives
detail: The lease serialises Todoist network work between devices, but the LINK (reminder.ext.id) lives in the synced state document, which reaches the other device later. Device A pushes a new reminder (item_add) and links it locally; device B takes the lease next (A releases it at once) while its state still holds the reminder unlinked and its own per-device sync token predates the add. B's incremental pull returns the new Todoist task, finds no local link (byLink) and reconcile() imports it as a SECOND reminder linked to the same Todoist id; the cloud merge then keeps both (different ids/uids). Reproduced in jsdom with the smoke112 fake: after the B-side cycle, two local reminders 'Made on A' are both linked to T3 while Todoist has one task. With a Mac, iPad and iPhone all open this is the ordinary case, matching the user's 'many problems between Reminders and Todoist'.
evidence: exp/td.js twodev → local 'Made on A': [[3,'T3'],[4,'T3']], remote: ['T3']; js/core/exttasks.js:180-187 (import with no matching attempt), js/core/ext.js:306-316 (syncProvider takes the lease without pulling the cloud state first), js/core/exttasks.js:229-237
fix: Make the cycle state-consistent: before taking the lease run a cloud pull (KOS.cloudsync cycle) and push the state right after the cycle; and in reconcile's import path, before adding, look for an existing reminder already linked to that remote id (dedupe byLink after any merge) or an unlinked one in the same list whose uuidOf('add|'+uid) is pending (record pending adds {uid→temp} in state.ext so any device can recognise its own item_add). Also add a boot/merge pass that folds two reminders linked to the same ext.id.
rootCause: Remote link state is replicated asynchronously while the remote cursor (sync token) is per device; import has no identity check beyond byLink.

title: Todoist: a failed second command batch leaves the first batch's tasks unlinked, so the next sync imports them as duplicates
detail: tdPush sends commands in chunks of 90 and runs every 'ok' callback (which writes the link and base) only after ALL chunks succeed. If chunk 2 fails (HTTP 429/5xx, offline, tab suspended), chunk 1's item_add commands have already created tasks in Todoist but nothing local is linked, and the sync token is not saved either. The next cycle pulls those tasks with the old token, finds no local link and imports each as a new reminder; the originals are then re-sent as item_add. Linking a list with ~45+ reminders that have a sub-task each exceeds 90 commands on the first cycle. Reproduced: 60 reminders with one sub each, chunk 2 answered 503 → cycle 2 leaves 105 local reminders (45 duplicates).
evidence: exp/td.js chunk → 'cycle1 false Todoist answered 503 / remote items 45 local linked 0 / cycle2: local total 105 dup local 45'; js/core/exttasks.js:318-335 (ok callbacks only after the reduce over chunks resolves), js/core/exttasks.js:241-243 (token saved only after push)
fix: Apply each chunk's results as soon as it returns (run the after[] entries whose commands are all in that chunk's sync_status), keep an item's parent and sub-task adds in one chunk, and persist the link/temp-id map before the next request; on the pull side, treat an incoming task whose id appears in a stored temp_id_mapping as already linked.
rootCause: Non-atomic multi-request push with all-or-nothing local bookkeeping.

title: First cloud sign-in silently discards a device's reminders, assignments, exams, routines and other data that 'stateMeaningful' does not count
detail: assessLink classifies each side with stateMeaningful(), which only looks at progress, sessions, custom cards, wishlist, tracker entries, goals, non-sample calendar events and Governor xp/gold/owned. A device whose data is reminders, assignments, Exams-hub assessments, routines, Pacing ticks, Money settings, curriculum edits, Code/Japanese/Mind/Creatives evidence or SRS state (without a logged session) counts as EMPTY, so linking it to an account that has data takes the 'remoteOnly' path: adoptRemote → applyRemoteState with no lastPushedHash → dirty = stateMeaningful(local) = false → KOS.store.replaceState(incoming). The local records are replaced without a merge, a toast or a backup. Reproduced in jsdom with smoke17's fake Supabase: a fresh device adds one reminder and one assignment, signs in to an account with history; after syncNow both are gone and the cloud copy never received them. A Home Screen install on the iPad has its own storage separate from Safari, so 'used it a bit before signing in' is a realistic path. The mirror case ('localOnly' when the remote only holds such records) overwrites the remote the same way.
evidence: exp/cs.js → {before:{rem:1,asg:1}, after:{rem:[],asg:[]}, cloudHasLocal:false}; js/core/cloudsync.js:234-251 (stateMeaningful), 975-990 (assessLink), 758-773 (not dirty → replaceState)
fix: Define 'meaningful' as 'differs from a freshly booted DEFAULTS document' (hash syncableState against a boot-time pristine snapshot, ignoring known seeders such as SAMPLE events and pacing seed), or enumerate every record array in cloudmerge RECORDS plus the keyed maps; and on first link always take the no-base three-way merge (union) instead of replaceState when the local side has ANY record. Snapshot the local state into the media kv before any replaceState so it can be restored.
rootCause: A hand-maintained allowlist of 'real data' that was not extended as new domains were added; replaceState used as the adopt path.

title: Two open tabs or windows overwrite each other's saves (last writer wins on the whole state)
detail: Each tab keeps its own in-memory KOS.store.state and save() writes the WHOLE document to localStorage 120 ms later; nothing listens for the 'storage' event, and there is no BroadcastChannel or Web Lock. A change made in one tab is erased by the next save in the other. Reproduced on the slot with an iframe of index.html (same origin, same localStorage): tab B added 'TAB-B reminder' and saved; tab A then added its own reminder; the stored document holds A's and not B's, and tab A never learns of B's. Both tabs also mint the same nextId. With cloud sync the shared IndexedDB meta (seq, lastPushedHash, base) can let the stale tab's CAS succeed and upload a document without the other tab's record. On the MacBook a second window or a PWA window beside a tab is ordinary.
evidence: kos.mjs eval 17 (iframe experiment) → {afterBsaved:true, finalHasA:true, finalHasB:false, inMemA_hasB:false}; js/core/store.js:395-410 (whole-document save), no 'storage' listener anywhere in js/ (grep)
fix: Listen for 'storage' on the state key and, when another tab wrote, three-way merge the incoming document into memory with KOS.cloudmerge (base = last document this tab wrote/read) before the next save; or elect one writer tab with navigator.locks / BroadcastChannel and make other tabs read-only with a banner. At minimum detect a foreign write (compare a per-save nonce) and reload instead of overwriting.
devices: mac (two windows/tabs), iPad Safari with two tabs
rootCause: localStorage used as a single-writer store without cross-tab coordination.

title: Todoist: a full sync drops completed sub-tasks from the reminder (and can re-add them to Todoist as duplicates)
detail: When the linked-project signature changes (linking or unlinking any list) the cycle requests sync_token '*' and resets the mirror. Todoist's full sync returns only active items, so completed sub-tasks are absent from the mirror; the parent's remote subs then differ from base and the pull overwrites the local subs, deleting every ticked sub-task. If the local subs were also edited, local wins, and each local sub whose x is no longer in the mirror is sent again as item_add, duplicating it in Todoist. Reproduced with a fake that, like Todoist, omits checked items from a full sync: 'Plan' (ticked) vanished locally after linking a second list. Depends on Todoist excluding completed sub-items from a full sync (documented behaviour for completed tasks).
evidence: exp/td.js subs → 'after remote sub tick: [[Plan,true],[Draft,false]]' then 'after full sync: [[Draft,false]]'; js/core/exttasks.js:217-220 (token '*' on any link change, mirror reset), 108-113 (childrenOf reads only the mirror), 296-307 (missing x → item_add)
fix: Do not reset the mirror on a full sync triggered by a link change; only drop entries of projects no longer linked. Treat a sub missing from a full sync as 'unknown', not deleted (keep subs whose remote child is not returned unless is_deleted arrives), and never re-add a sub that has an x.
rootCause: Absence in a full sync is interpreted as deletion.

title: Todoist: completing a repeating reminder here sends a new due string instead of closing the occurrence
detail: KOS.reminders.complete() rolls a repeating reminder forward locally (new due, done=false) so the push sees only a 'when' change and sends item_update with due {date: next, string: 'every week', is_recurring}. Todoist never records the completion (no history/karma, completed view empty), and since Todoist parses due.string, the explicit date may be ignored and re-anchored to today, which the next pull brings back. For a Todoist-only rule (ext.rs, e.g. 'every mon, fri') the reminder instead closes locally (recur is null here) and sends item_close, so it shows as completed until the next pull un-completes it with Todoist's new date: two different behaviours for the same action.
evidence: exp/td.js recur → cmds [[{type:item_update,args:{id:T1,due:{date:'2026-11-05',string:'every week',is_recurring:true}}}]]; gym: local done=true, cmds [[item_close]]; js/core/reminders.js:229-236, js/core/exttasks.js:99-107, 282-290
fix: For a linked repeating reminder, push item_close (Todoist rolls the date itself) and let the pull bring the new date back; treat ext.rs rules as repeating in complete() (roll forward with Todoist as the source) so both paths behave alike.
rootCause: Local recurrence semantics duplicated instead of delegated to the provider that owns the rule.

title: An assignment re-keyed by the cloud merge leaves its goals, Exams links, Focus sessions and review picks pointing at another assignment
detail: Ids are per-device counters; when two devices mint the same assignment id between syncs, rekeyCollisions re-keys the local one and rewrites only RECORDS[].refs. For assignments.items that list is calendar.events.assignmentId alone, but assignment ids are also stored in goals (links.assignmentId, js/core/goals.js:130), Exams assessments (links.assignmentId, js/core/exams.js:178, 536, 726), session entries and their segments (metrics.assignmentId, js/core/sessions.js:93-98; Focus banks minutes by it), and Daily Review picks (js/core/dayreview.js:489). After a re-key those references silently follow the OTHER device's assignment: minutes, goal progress and an exam's linked coursework attach to the wrong record. Reminders have the same gap (reminder ids referenced by the review picks).
evidence: js/core/cloudmerge.js:57-58 (assignments refs: calendar.events only), 293-346 (rekeyCollisions rewrites only spec.refs); references listed above
fix: Add every reference to RECORDS[].refs (goals.items links.assignmentId as a nested field, exams.assessments links.assignmentId, sessions metrics.assignmentId and metrics.segments[].assignmentId, dayReview picks), or move assignments/reminders/events to random string ids as Money, Routines and Exams already do (the long-term fix).
rootCause: Counter ids plus a hand-maintained reference list that new features did not extend.

title: A 404 on an update deletes the local event or reminder (e.g. after reconnecting a different Google account)
detail: When a PATCH to Google Calendar or Google Tasks answers 404/410, the cycle deletes the LOCAL record inside inbound(): extgcal.js:421 KOS.calendar.deleteEvent(ev.id), exttasks.js:417 KOS.reminders.remove(it.id). disconnect() (ext.js:241-250) clears only the kv (sync tokens, mirrors) and leaves every record's ext link in place, so connecting a different Google account (or the event being moved to another calendar) turns the next local edit of any linked event or reminder into a silent local deletion, with no undo and no notice. This contradicts the 'never inferred from absence' intent of invariant 158 and is the opposite of Todoist's behaviour (an update to a missing item there is just retried forever, exttasks.js:330-333).
evidence: js/core/extgcal.js:419-421, js/core/exttasks.js:416-417, js/core/ext.js:241-250
fix: On 404 for an update, unlink the record (ext = null, keep it local, count it as 'unlinked' in the status) instead of deleting it; delete locally only from a pull that reports the item cancelled/deleted. Clear (or archive) ext links on disconnect and on connecting a different account (compare the account id).
rootCause: A failed write is treated as proof of a remote deletion.

title: The full backup leaves out saved Reports and snapshots, and builds one giant string that can fail on the iPad
detail: store.snapshotFull collects state, media, attachments (kurenai-os-files, every binary as base64), money, reviews, mind, ink and creatives, but not kurenai-os-reports (saved weeks/months/terms/years, their Kurenai words and the boundary snapshots that status moves need — 'never recomputed', invariant 101/102). Signed out, a restore on a new device loses every saved report and snapshot for good. The backup is serialised with JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) into a single Blob: with a few hundred MB of files (the app asks for persistent storage at 200 MB) the base64 plus indentation is a string of several hundred MB, which risks an out-of-memory reload on iPad Safari, and that failure is silent (no error reaches done()). A failing sub-export (e.g. creatives) aborts the whole backup instead of reporting the missing part.
evidence: js/core/store.js:513-583 (no reportStore step; JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) at 588), js/core/reportstore.js (no exportAll), js/modules/attachments.js:454-480 (base64 for every blob)
fix: Add KOS.reportStore.exportAll/importAll to the snapshot; stream the backup (build the Blob from parts: a JSON head plus one part per file, no indentation) or offer 'backup without files' when files exceed ~100 MB; report per-section failures like importFull does instead of failing the whole export.
rootCause: Backup coverage list maintained by hand; whole-document serialisation.

title: The whole state lives in one localStorage key with no fallback: when it outgrows the quota every later change is lost on reload
detail: Measured on the seeded account: the state document is 372,924 characters in one key (kurenai-os-v1); srs is 110 KB for 675 rated cards (164 B a card), sessions 84 KB for 600 (140 B each, capped at 2,000), pacing 85 KB. The curriculum alone has 5,436 flashcards, so a fully reviewed deck is ~0.9 MB before Code, Japanese facets and Mind cards, and every new domain adds to the same document. Chrome refused the write at ~5.2 M characters total; WebKit's limit is of the same order. When setItem throws, save() shows one toast ('Save failed — storage may be full. Export your data.') and keeps running on the in-memory copy; every later change, and the pagehide flush (which only logs, store.js:417-425), is lost on the next reload or when iOS evicts the page. Reproduced by filling localStorage on the slot: the save failed with QuotaExceededError and the change was not stored. There is no size readout in Archive › Storage for the state document, and no migration of the big parts (srs, sessions, facets) to IndexedDB.
evidence: kos.mjs eval 17 → state 372,924 chars; srs 110,391; sessions 84,052; pacing 84,696; 5,436 curriculum cards; quota experiment → errs ['Kurenai OS: save failed QuotaExceededError…'], stored:false, toast 'Save failed — storage may be full. Export your data.'; js/core/store.js:395-425
fix: Move the large, append-heavy parts (srs/cards, the session ledger, Japanese facets, Mind cards) into IndexedDB records like the review log, or store the document in IndexedDB with localStorage as a small boot cache; show the state size in Archive › Storage with a warning at 60% of quota; on a failed save keep a persistent banner (not a toast) and retry into IndexedDB.
rootCause: Single-key localStorage persistence for an unbounded document.

title: Every replicated store pulls with a strict updated_at > cursor on now() stamps, so a row committed late is skipped forever
detail: Media, files, money, reviews, mind, ink, reports and push all pull 'updated_at > cursor' and then advance the cursor to the largest updated_at seen. The touch trigger stamps updated_at := now(), which in Postgres is the TRANSACTION START time. If device A's upsert (a 500-row media chunk, a money batch) starts at t1 and commits after device B's quicker write stamped t2 > t1, a third device that pulls between the two commits sets its cursor to t2 and never fetches A's rows (t1 < t2). Nothing ever re-reads them: the pulling device silently lacks those transactions/reviews/ink strokes until a restore. With three devices syncing on focus this is a real, if rare, divergence with no symptom.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260716000001_kos_sync_init.sql:26-35 (now()); q.gt('updated_at', …) at js/core/money.js:1126, reviewlog.js:133, mindjournal.js:191, inksync.js:97, reportstore.js:324, cloudsync.js:358/376; cursor = max seen (money.js:1189, 1207)
fix: Stamp with clock_timestamp() in the trigger and pull with an overlap window (gt cursor − 2 minutes) — every store already skips its own echo by stamp or uid, so re-reading a few rows is harmless; or use a monotonic bigserial 'version' column per table as the cursor.
rootCause: Timestamp cursor over transaction-start timestamps.

title: Todoist: a command the server rejects is resent on every cycle forever, with no status shown
detail: tdPush applies a record's bookkeeping only when every command in its group returns 'ok'. A rejected command (item_update or item_delete for a task deleted or moved out of reach in Todoist, an invalid label, a due string Todoist cannot parse) leaves base and the delete queue unchanged, so the same command is sent every cycle (every few minutes and on every focus) and the Connections status still says the cycle succeeded, because sync_status errors are never turned into counts or an error. A partly-applied group (item_update ok, item_close rejected) also re-sends the parts that did apply.
evidence: js/core/exttasks.js:329-334 (only the all-ok case is handled; errors in r.sync_status are dropped), js/core/exttasks.js:256 (delete queue entry kept on error)
fix: Read sync_status errors: for 'not found' (error_code 22) drop the queue entry or unlink the record; for other errors record them in counts and setStatus so Connections shows 'n changes refused' with the reason; apply per-command bookkeeping rather than per group.
rootCause: Error results of batched commands are ignored.

title: An unreadable stored state is replaced by a fresh one and overwritten on the next save
detail: At boot, if JSON.parse or deepMerge of kurenai-os-v1 throws, the app logs a warning and starts from DEFAULTS; the next save() (any render that creates a progress record, the boot seeders) writes the empty state over the unreadable original, so whatever was recoverable from it is gone and the user is not told. With cloud sync the empty-local guard then adopts the cloud copy, but a signed-out user loses everything silently.
evidence: js/core/store.js:382-390 (catch → DEFAULTS, console.warn only), 393 and 395-410 (save overwrites KEY)
fix: On a parse failure copy the raw string to a side key (kurenai-os-v1.corrupt-<ts>) or into IndexedDB before anything saves, and show a blocking notice offering Restore from backup / cloud.
rootCause: No quarantine of the original before the first overwrite.

title: Backup & Restore's 'What a backup covers' list is out of date: half of what the file holds, and everything it leaves out, is unlisted

The closing line points only to 'Sync & Import' for reconnecting, not Connections.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/data-integrity/data-mac.png; list text read via eval; js/core/store.js:513-583 (what snapshotFull includes)
fix: Generate the rows from the same table snapshotFull uses (one row per store with its live count), and add a short 'Not in the file' line naming Reports, the Paper library and connections.

title: Boot loads ~16.6 MB of JavaScript in 340 synchronous script tags, most of it curriculum content no first view needs
detail: index.html lists 340 <script src> tags; only KaTeX, supabase.js and env.local.js are deferred. Summed on disk: 16.64 MB JS (js/data/content 8.28 MB in 126 files, js/modules 3.33 MB, js/core 2.50 MB, js/data 1.67 MB, js/labs 0.60 MB) plus 1.21 MB CSS in 24 sheets. Every topic's notes for every subject (CS, Maths, IT, Code units 1-12, tracks, Japanese, Mind, Creatives), the 567 KB past-paper index, and the 383 KB Rider project scaffolds (code-projects-files.js, needed only when exporting a Rider zip) are parsed and executed before Home renders. In the harness a cold reload of the EMPTY account took 15.0 s to domInteractive with 61 long tasks totalling 15.4 s (max 2.75 s); the CPU profile shows 11 s of (program) (parse/compile) and the top self-time scripts are content files executing their builders (cs-p2-46b.js 746 ms, code.js lesson() 316 ms, cs-p2-411.js 545 ms, cs-p2-410a.js 497 ms, maths-stats-s4 325 ms...). The machine was shared with other audit slots so absolute times are inflated, but the shape is unambiguous: the content payload dominates boot, and on an iPad/iPhone (slower JS, tighter memory, Safari evicting a backgrounded Home Screen app) every cold launch pays it. Heap after boot on the empty account: 68 MB.
evidence: arch20/boot.mjs runs on slot 20 (6 Nov): {jsN:346, jsMB:16.9, domInteractive:53357, longTasks:78, longMs:51726} and {domInteractive:70719, longTasks:87} on Home; python count of index.html <script src> = 346; arch20/trace-boot-dense.txt (script evaluation, achcatalogue.js 943 ms) | earlier: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/arch/prof-boot-empty.txt; index.html lines 48-55 (only defer tags) and the 340-script list; sizes via stat: exam-index.js 566,954 B, code-projects-files.js 382,808 B, it-f204.js 299,469 B, hub.js 232,148 B, aitools.js 208,176 B; Performance API: domInteractive 14,993 ms, longtasks 61 / 15,441 ms; dense account warm reload (SW controlling, V8 code cache): data-shell=ready at 21,064 ms, 35 long tasks totalling 19,166 ms, heap 58 MB (machine shared with other audit slots, load avg ~5)
fix: Keep the script-tag architecture but split content into lazily loaded bundles: KOS.content.get(key) already funnels every read, so make content files register a loader per subject/unit (a tiny manifest listing keys -> file) and inject the script on first open of a topic, a desk or search (search can use a prebuilt title/keyword index). Load exam-index.js only on #/exams, code-projects-files.js only on export, ja/mind/creatives content only when their desk opens. Target: boot payload under ~4 MB. Also add performance.mark('kos-boot-start'/'kos-interactive') in main.js so the cost is tracked by a smoke test budget.
rootCause: Classic script-tag design (chosen so file:// works) with no lazy-loading layer; every new study space appended its whole content to index.html.
devices: all; worst on iPhone 17 and iPad (cold launch of the Home Screen app)
recheck: changed: now 346 scripts (4 defer/async), 16.9 MB JS of which js/data 9.95 MB, 26 stylesheets 1.31 MB (was 340 / 16.6 MB / 1.2 MB). Dense boot on slot 20 at machine load 6-10: domInteractive 53-127 s, 78-106 long tasks totalling 52-125 s; evaluating scripts before main.js took ~18 s, and the first KOS.show after main.js 13.7 s when the restored route was the Wall. Absolute times are inflated by the shared machine, the shape holds.

title: Cold-path cost after boot: the first render of each heavy view takes 0.5-2.8 s on the dense account (Exams, Code map, Due, Pacing, Calendar), then 20-200 ms
detail: Rendering each view three times in a row (via a cheap view in between) on the seeded account gave: exams 2750/589/179 ms, code map 1622/504/355, due 1623/263/22, pacing 1405/51/120, calendar 1015/168/189, japanese 825/59/311, routines 705/11/16, mind 670/171/126, home 205/175/63 (first ever Home after boot was 2.0-3.3 s). Steady state is acceptable; the first visit after a cold launch is not, and on an iPad/iPhone Home Screen app every relaunch after Safari evicts it is a cold launch. Two causes: (1) V8 lazily compiles functions from the 16.6 MB of eagerly loaded script on first use, and (2) the derived reads have no per-render snapshot, so first calls are expensive and repeated: KOS.exams.readiness over 17 assessments measured 3,247 ms then 696/78/55 ms on later runs; KOS.code.unitState (js/core/code.js:888) rescans every lesson and calls stats() (code.js:856) per call, and the Code map (js/modules/code.js:417-490) calls it per unit, per track need (needMet) and per track section (trackState); evidence() re-splits shipped notes with KOS.content.splitPages on every call (code.js:168, 66 ms/call measured). The Calendar month calls dayItems -> derivedOn (37 ms/call warm, calendar.js:563) for each of 35-42 cells, re-reading every Money rule, goal and exam start-by per cell.
evidence: arch20/views.js -> arch20/views-out.txt; eval topic1 6735 ms / topic2 3884 ms | earlier: eval timings above (slot 18, seeded); audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/arch/prof-boot-dense.txt (readiness js/core/exams.js:635 1314 ms self in the boot profile, exams.js:945 predictPass 893 ms), arch/prof-code.txt, arch/prof-calendar.txt; js/core/code.js:166-190, 856-895; js/modules/code.js:417-490; js/modules/calendar.js:546-570, 1762-1800; js/core/exams.js:635-720, 943-960
fix: Add a cheap per-tick memo: a KOS.store revision counter bumped by save(), and memoise the heavy pure reads (exams.readiness/leaves, code stats/unitState/pageCount, calendar derivedOn for a month range, srs.allCards) on (args, revision, day). Shipped content is immutable at runtime (invariant 86), so pageCount/listingsOf can be cached forever. For the calendar, compute derived items for the visible range once and bucket by date. Pair with lazy content loading (boot finding) to cut compile cost.
rootCause: Pure derive-on-read design (a good contract) without any memoisation layer, so composite pages multiply the cost; plus eager loading of all code.
devices: all; most felt on iPhone 17 and iPad cold launches
recheck: holds: first/warm render on slot 20 (load 7-10, so ~2-3x inflated): home 6560/4640 ms, calendar 10362/3683, exams 5393/4926, code 6452/2738, pacing 5929/2574, due 2302/857, a CS topic page 6735 then 3884; new heavy views: governor 3090-6101, governor/shop 7341/3436, governor/edit 7167/829, the Wall 1.9-7.9 s until its badges draw.

title: The four study spaces each re-implement the same lesson machinery (paged reader with dwell, evidence, syncChecks, award, planDay), and the copies have already drifted
detail: Code, Japanese, Mind and Creatives each have their own core model (js/core/code.js 942 lines, ja.js 409, mind.js 633, creatives.js 483), topic module (codetopic.js 718, jatopic.js 387, mindtopic.js 442, crtopic.js 266), desk module and UI helper (codeui/jaui/mindui), 9,644 lines in all. Every core defines its own evidence(), syncChecks(), award(), planDay() and normalise(); every topic module carries its own copy of the paged notes reader with DWELL = 2500 / LEAVE = 1500, a page select, dots, markRead and paint (codetopic.js:26-27/354-397, jatopic.js:22/215-244, mindtopic.js:19/271-302, crtopic.js:16/163). A diff of the Japanese and Mind readers (48 lines each) shows 42 changed lines for the same behaviour, with drift a user can see: Japanese labels the pager 'Note pages' and hides it for one-page lessons, Mind labels it 'Lesson pages' and always shows it; Mind's markRead skips a 'Your notes' page, Japanese's has no such guard. The read-dwell rule is invariant 107's, so four copies mean four places to keep in step, and the next study space (roadmap) will add a fifth.
evidence: grep var DWELL js/modules/*topic.js (6 Nov); grep -l function syncChecks|award|planDay js/core | earlier: grep 'var DWELL' in js/modules/{codetopic,jatopic,mindtopic,crtopic}.js; diff of jatopic.js:213-260 vs mindtopic.js:269-316 (42 differing lines); grep 'function syncChecks|function award|function planDay|function evidence' finds one per space in js/core/{code,ja,mind,creatives}.js
fix: Extract a shared KOS.lessonReader({pages, peekRead, markPage, onChanged, label}) into js/core/ (the pager, dots, dwell/leave timing, 'Your notes' guard, Next/Prev) and have the four topic modules mount it; then a small KOS.studySpace helper for the checks-sync pattern (evidence -> want[] -> store.setCheck diff) that each core calls with its own evidence(). Do it before the next study space rather than as a rewrite: start with the reader, which has the visible drift.
rootCause: Each study space was built in its own release branch by copying the previous one (comments say 'the pager as Code's and Japanese's'), with no shared component extracted afterwards.
recheck: holds: var DWELL in codetopic/jatopic/mindtopic/crtopic (codetopic still differs: no LEAVE); syncChecks, award and planDay each defined in code.js, creatives.js, ja.js, mind.js; jatopic.js:213-260 vs mindtopic.js:269-316 still 42 differing lines.

title: Detached pages leak: global listeners are removed only when their event next fires, so every visited topic/Files/lesson page stays in memory
detail: 15 places add a window/document listener on each render and remove it lazily inside the handler ('if (!node.isConnected) { removeEventListener(...); return; }'): hub.js:2719 and 3169 (kos-ink on every topic page), files.js:283 (paste) and 292 (kos-files-index), attachments.js:736 (paste), inkui.js:1422 (keydown), inktab.js:518, codetopic.js:214/228, jatopic.js:321/334, mindtopic.js:380/395, crtopic.js:246, inksync.js:339. Rare events (kos-ink fires only when ink is written; paste only on a paste) never come, so each closure keeps its whole detached page alive. Measured with forced GC (CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage + Memory.getDOMCounters) on the seeded account: on Files, 9,003 DOM nodes / 886 listeners; after opening 30 CS topic pages and returning to Files, 24,954 nodes / 2,369 listeners (about 16,000 detached nodes retained); dispatching one kos-ink event dropped it to 11,027 / 1,096. Three rounds over 23 views grew nodes from 1,786 to 14,110 and listeners from 157 to 1,795. Opening Files 5 times adds 5 document paste listeners. On an iPad Home Screen app kept open for days this is unbounded growth until Safari kills the page (which then pays the full cold boot).
evidence: arch20/mem2.txt and arch20/mem.txt (this build); grep -rEn isConnected[^;]*removeEventListener js | wc -l = 15 | earlier: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/arch/mem.txt, arch/mem2.txt; eval: 5 paste listeners after 5 Files visits; grep 'isConnected[^;]*removeEventListener' = 15 sites listed
fix: Give KOS.show a teardown hook: views register cleanups via a KOS.ui.onLeave(fn) (or an AbortController per render, passing {signal} to addEventListener) that KOS.show calls before clearing #main; replace the 15 lazy removals with it. Add a smoke check that navigating 20 views leaves the listener count flat (jsdom can count via a wrapped addEventListener).
rootCause: No view lifecycle: KOS.show replaces #main with innerHTML='' and has no unmount step, so each module invented a lazy self-removal.
devices: iPad (long-lived Home Screen app) and iPhone most; all
recheck: holds: still 15 isConnected-lazy removeEventListener sites (inkui, inksync, codetopic, mindtopic, jatopic, files, attachments, hub, inktab, crtopic); on this build 30 CS topic pages left 23,414 nodes / 2,237 listeners on the Files page vs 7,413 / 749 before, released only when a kos-ink event fired (9,487).

The window's KOS namespace has 209 top-level members and about 430 'KOS.x && ...' existence guards in core/modules, which hide load-order mistakes instead of failing.

Split aitools.js by domain (each owner registers its tools, as goals do).
